source: Look for all the channels that fall inside one receiver window on the same transform the panadapter is made from, and only tune to the ones something is on. A list on one band then costs one tune a lap however long it is, instead of a settling time per channel. The scan still listens on each candidate before stopping, so what stops it is unchanged — but the sweep measures through the FFT rather than through the receiver's filter, so check the threshold if it starts stopping on nothing.

source: Five minutes by default, not ADS-B's ten seconds: a vessel at anchor reports once every three minutes, and a shorter window would blank most of a harbour between two perfectly good reports. zh-CN: 本软件中的 AIS 仅接收，并将始终如此。它属于生命安全业务，许可证不允许在其通道上注入虚假船舶通信。

source: Fill in My grid in the digimode setup for ranges and bearings, and so the chart frames itself around where you are rather than around whatever is furthest away.
zh-CN: 在数字模式设置中填写“我的网格定位符”，以计算距离和方位，并使海图围绕你的位置适配，而非围绕最远目标。
正在启动 AIS 解码器…

source: Nothing will be transmitted — no beacon, no message, not even an acknowledgement — until this station has a callsign. Set one under Settings → General, or an APRS-specific one with its SSID under SETUP.
zh-CN: 未设置台站呼号前，不会发送信标、消息或任何确认。请在设置 → 常规中填写呼号，或在本模式设置中填写带 SSID 的 APRS 专用呼号。

source: A beacon needs somewhere to report. Fill in your locator under Settings → General, or give coordinates under SETUP.
zh-CN: 信标需要报告位置。请在设置 → 常规中填写网格定位符，或在本模式设置中填写坐标。

source: Callsign, symbol, digipeater path, position and beacon
zh-CN: 呼号、符号、数字中继路径、位置与信标

source: How often to beacon your position, unattended. `off` — the default — never beacons: selecting a mode must not put a station on the air. Thirty minutes is the convention for a fixed station, oftener for a moving one, and every beacon is somebody else's channel time.
zh-CN: 无人值守时发送位置信标的间隔。默认关闭，不会发送信标；选择模式不应使台站自动发射。固定台站通常每三十分钟发送一次，移动台站更频繁，但每次信标都会占用其他人的通道时间。

source: This station has no callsign — see the warning to the left.
zh-CN: 此台站未设置呼号，请查看左侧警告。

source: This station has no position to report — see the warning to the left.
zh-CN: 此台站没有可报告的位置，请查看左侧警告。

source: Send one position report now, without waiting for the interval. It waits for the channel to be clear like everything else.
zh-CN: 立即发送一次位置报告，不等待定时间隔。与其他发送相同，会等待通道空闲。
正在启动 APRS 调制解调器…

source: The two characters the station sent to say what it is
zh-CN: 台站发送的两个符号标识字符

source: The station that put this object here has cancelled it
zh-CN: 发布此对象的台站已撤销它

source: The sender deliberately reported a square rather than a point. The map draws the square.
zh-CN: 发送者有意报告一个方格而非精确点位，地图按方格绘制。

source: The digipeaters the last frame came through. A `*` marks one that actually repeated it.
zh-CN: 最后一帧经过的数字中继台。`*` 表示实际执行过转发的中继台。

source: Address the message box to this station
zh-CN: 将消息框收件台站设为此台站

source: Put this station in the middle of the map. Double-click the map to hand the view back to the automatic fit.
zh-CN: 将此台站置于地图中心。双击地图可恢复自动适配视野。

source: Frames that arrived and failed their check sequence — a collision, a fade, or a signal too weak to read. A count rising with nothing decoding means the modem *is* hearing the channel: check the level meter, and open the radio's squelch.
zh-CN: 接收到但校验序列失败的帧，可能由碰撞、衰落或过弱信号造成。计数增加但没有解码时，说明调制解调器确实听到了通道，请检查电平表并打开电台静噪。

source: Frames read cleanly off the channel that were not APRS — somebody else's packet session, or a format this build does not decode.
zh-CN: 从通道正确读取、但不属于 APRS 的帧，例如他人的分组会话或此版本无法解码的格式。

source: Every frame on the channel, as it arrived — other people's traffic included, and anything the decoder could not read.
zh-CN: 按接收原样显示通道上的每一帧，包括其他人的通信及解码器无法读取的内容。

source: This station has no callsign, so nothing can be transmitted. Set one under Settings → General, or an APRS-specific one with its SSID under SETUP.
zh-CN: 此台站未设置呼号，无法发射。请在设置 → 常规中填写呼号，或在本模式设置中填写带 SSID 的 APRS 专用呼号。

source: Needs a station to address and something to say.
zh-CN: 需要填写收件台站和消息内容。

source: Send it, and keep retrying until the far end acknowledges. Messages are the one thing on this channel that is answered.
zh-CN: 发送消息，并持续重试直到远端确认。消息是此通道上会得到应答的通信。

source: Stations heard and still inside the window set in APRS Setup, and whether another station is on the channel right now. Nothing will key while it is busy.
zh-CN: 已接收且仍在 APRS 设置保留时间内的台站，以及当前是否有其他台站占用通道。通道忙时不会启动发射。

source: The over in progress, the frames waiting for the channel to clear, or the time until the next scheduled beacon.
zh-CN: 正在进行的发射、等待通道空闲的帧，或距下一次定时信标的时间。

source: Audio reaching the modem. Flat means nothing is arriving at all — check that the radio's data output is the one sdroxide is listening to. It lights up green while the modem hears a carrier.
zh-CN: 到达调制解调器的音频。完全平坦表示没有音频到达，请检查 sdroxide 是否正在接收电台的数据输出。调制解调器检测到载波时显示绿色。

source: Another station is transmitting — the channel is busy.
zh-CN: 其他台站正在发射，频道忙。

source: Station callsign and the virtual-channel address
zh-CN: 台站呼号及虚拟频道地址

source: Work the net over a TCP endpoint instead of the radio — a channel_server-compatible loopback for radio-less development. Off puts the station on the air.
zh-CN: 通过 TCP 端点而非电台加入网络；这是兼容 channel_server 的回环通道，用于无电台开发。关闭后台站将通过无线电通信。

source: {} — last heard {:.0}s ago · click to open a direct-message tab
zh-CN: {} · 最后接收于 {:.0}秒前；点击打开私聊选项卡

source: The common channel — lines here go to everyone (ALL)
zh-CN: 公共频道；此处的消息发送给所有台站（ALL）

source: The station's own on-air activity — master election, roster ageing, ARQ retries
zh-CN: 本站的无线电活动：主站选举、台站列表老化及 ARQ 重试
正在启动 AtCHAT NET 台站…

source: A sent file follows the active chat tab
zh-CN: 文件发送给当前聊天选项卡中的接收对象

source: Send a file or image over the air, block-CRC-ARQ
zh-CN: 通过无线电发送文件或图像，采用数据块 CRC 校验和 ARQ 重传
NET · 多台站文字及文件通信

source: A global convention that the IARU Region {} band plan does not put narrow data on — check your own band plan before transmitting here.
zh-CN: 全球通行约定，但 IARU 第 {} 区的波段规划未将此处划为窄带数据区域；在这里发射前请核对当地波段规划。

source: Amber: outside the Region {} data segment.
zh-CN: 琥珀色：位于第 {} 区的数据频段之外。

source: This dial is already one of your saved frequencies.
zh-CN: 当前拨盘频率已经保存在自定义列表中。

source: This dial is already in the agreed list for this mode.
zh-CN: 当前拨盘频率已经列入此模式的约定频率列表。

source: Remember this dial under {} and offer it here from now on. Saved on the station, so every screen attached to this radio has it.
zh-CN: 将当前拨盘频率保存在 {} 下，今后在此菜单中提供。数据保存在台站端，连接此电台的每个界面都可使用。

source: Decode squelch — raise to stop decoding noise
zh-CN: 解码静噪；提高门限可避免解码噪声

source: The message repeats for as long as transmit is held — a meteor catches whatever part of it is passing.
zh-CN: 只要持续发射，消息就不断重复；流星反射会截获它经过时的任意一段。

source: This turn: {:.1} s of {:.0}. Decodes land at the end of it, and that is when the next transmission may start.{}
zh-CN: 当前周期：{:.1} 秒，共 {:.0} 秒。解码结果在周期结束时显示，下一次发射也可从那时开始。{}

source: The mark is where the burst stops, {:.1} s in.
zh-CN: 标记表示突发信号在周期内第 {:.1} 秒结束。
收发周期 {:.0} 秒，突发信号 {:.1} 秒
没有可保存的解码内容

source: Empty the receive window. Nothing that is on the air stops.
zh-CN: 清空接收窗口，不会停止正在进行的无线电通信。
没有可清空的接收内容

source: Shade the map by where signals are actually getting through, on each band. Every reception is placed at the midpoint of its path — the patch of ionosphere that bent it — not at the far station, so this is a map of the sky rather than of where radio amateurs live. Built from paths this station has taken part in, plus — when the Reverse Beacon Network is switched on under Settings → Spots — what the world's skimmers are hearing, which covers the bands this radio is not on.
zh-CN: 按各波段信号实际通过的区域为地图着色。每次接收标在传播路径的中点，即使信号弯折的电离层区域，而非对方台站的位置。因此这显示的是传播环境，而非业余无线电爱好者的分布。数据来自本站参与的传播路径；若在“设置 → 接收报告”中启用反向信标网络，还会加入全球自动监听站收到的信号，覆盖本电台当前未监听的波段。

source: Shade where the Sun is down, and the twilight between, so the grey line shows on the map. Low bands go long and high bands close on the night side of it, and the terminator itself is where the DX is.
zh-CN: 为日落后的区域及其间的曙暮光区域着色，在地图上显示灰线。夜侧的低波段适合远距离传播，高波段则趋于关闭；晨昏线本身也是远距离通信值得关注的区域。

source: Every band at once, one hue each — overall conditions.
zh-CN: 同时显示所有波段，每个波段一种色调，呈现整体传播状况。

source: One band, cold to hot: blue, green, yellow, red.
zh-CN: 显示一个波段，由冷到热依次为蓝、绿、黄、红。

source: The frequency you are actually working: the dial plus the tone offset beside it. This is what goes in the log — the dial alone is that much low.
zh-CN: 实际通信频率：拨盘频率加上旁边的音调频偏。日志记录此频率；单独使用拨盘频率会少算这段频偏。

source: No frequency is agreed for {} — open this to save the one you are on
zh-CN: {} 尚无约定频率；打开此菜单可保存当前频率

source: The {} frequencies for {} — picking one tunes the dial, and you can save your own
zh-CN: 共有 {} 个 {} 频率；选择后会调谐拨盘，也可保存自定义频率

source: Nothing agreed for this mode — save your own below.
zh-CN: 此模式尚无约定频率，可在下方保存自定义频率。

source: Sending speed read off the signal
zh-CN: 从信号读取的发送速度

source: Signal to noise in 500 Hz — the same figure a report quotes
zh-CN: 500 Hz 带宽内的信噪比，与信号报告使用的数值一致

source: How far off the cursor the signal actually is. The decoder follows it; the passband does not, so nudge the cursor if it grows.
zh-CN: 信号实际偏离光标的幅度。解码器会跟踪信号，通带不会，因此偏移增大时请微调光标。

source: Learn Morse: read characters and words, play them at your own speed, and a Koch drill that adds a character at a time. It plays here, through this computer's speakers — nothing keys the radio.
zh-CN: 学习摩尔斯：阅读字符与单词，按自己的速度播放，并使用每次增加一个字符的 Koch 训练。声音只通过此电脑扬声器播放，不会启动电台发射。

source: Type a line, Return sends it…
zh-CN: 输入一行，按 Enter 发送…

source: Hold the key bound to CW straight key — Space by default, and any key you like in Settings → Controls — as a straight key: down while it is held, up on release, instead of typing text. The transmit box is locked while it is on, and the whole keyer is handed to the key: whatever text was queued is dropped.
zh-CN: 将绑定“CW 直键”的按键作为直键使用，默认空格，也可在设置 → 控制中选择其他按键。按住时键下，松开时键上，取代键盘文本输入。启用时锁定发射文本框，整个电键器由此按键控制，并清除已排队文本。

source:
This radio sends from its own keyer: the text goes over the control port and the rig times the elements, so there is nothing between the straight key and the air for a hand to drive.

To hand-key it, set CW keying to "Sound card (MCW)" in Settings → Radio. The rig is then held on a sideband and the keyer's own sidetone is transmitted as audio, which is the route the straight key drives.
zh-CN:
此电台使用自身电键器：文本通过控制端口发送，由电台决定点划时序，无法由手动直键直接控制射频。

若需手动键控，请在设置 → 电台中将 CW 键控设为“声卡（MCW）”。电台会保持在边带模式，将电键器侧音作为音频发射，直键控制此路径。

source: The straight key was held down too long — a lost key-up rather than a hand — so the carrier was dropped and transmit switched off. Press the key again to carry on.
zh-CN: 直键按下过久，可能丢失了键上事件，因此已停止载波并关闭发射。再次按键可继续。

source: Send what is in the box now, without waiting for Return
zh-CN: 立即发送框内内容，无需等待 Enter

source: Hold the key down between characters, so nothing typed waits
zh-CN: 字符之间保持发射，使键盘输入无需等待

source: Stop sending and drop whatever has not gone out. With the straight key on, the read-back over what you keyed goes with it.
zh-CN: 停止发送，清除尚未发出的内容。启用直键时，也会清除对已键控内容的回读。

source: Play the keyed tone through this computer's speakers as well as sending it, so you hear what you are sending. On `Sound card (MCW)` the tone goes out to the rig and nowhere else, so without this you send in silence. Off where the rig's own monitor or an off-air copy already does the job.
zh-CN: 发射时也通过此电脑扬声器播放键控音调，以听到正在发送的内容。“声卡（MCW）”音调只送往电台，不在其他位置播放，因此不启用此项时会无声发送。若电台自身监听或实际接收监听已能提供侧音，可关闭。

source: Your own message buttons — a contest exchange, a name-and-QTH reply, TNX 73 GL. Each sends its whole text in one go, and F2–F10 press the first nine. They travel with the station's configuration, so a remote client has them too.
zh-CN: 自定义消息按钮，可填写竞赛交换、姓名和 QTH 回复，或 TNX 73 GL。每个按钮一次发送全部文本，F2–F10 对应前九个按钮。消息保存在台站配置中，远程客户端也可使用。

source: The tone being copied, and the tone transmitted — in CW they are the same frequency. Click the waterfall to move it onto a signal.
zh-CN: 当前解码及发射的音调，CW 中两者频率相同。点击瀑布图可将其移至信号。

source: Empty the receive window and the straight key's read-back. Nothing that is on the air stops.
zh-CN: 清空接收窗口和直键回读，不会停止正在发射的信号。

source: Decode at the speed set here instead of reading it off the signal. Helps a signal too weak for the speed search to settle.
zh-CN: 按此处设定速度解码，而非从信号估计。适用于信号过弱、速度搜索无法稳定的情况。

source:
{}

Click for the {} decoder. The neural one copies further down and reads hand-sent CW a timing fit will not accept; the timing one is the only one that copies the accented letters — Ä, Ö, Å, Ü, É — because the model has no output class for them.
zh-CN:
{}

点击切换至{}解码器。神经网络解码器可接收更弱信号，并解码时序拟合无法接受的手发 CW；只有时序解码器支持 Ä、Ö、Å、Ü、É 等重音字母，因为模型没有相应输出类别。

source: Farnsworth: send the characters at full speed and stretch only the gaps between them, so they are heard at the right rhythm but arrive slowly enough to write down.
zh-CN: Farnsworth：字符按完整速度发送，只延长字符之间的间隔，使点划节奏正确，同时留出足够时间抄写。

source: How long transmit is held after the last character, or after the straight key is let go, before the carrier drops. Longer bridges a slow typist's pauses; shorter gets off the frequency sooner; Off drops it as soon as everything queued has gone out.
zh-CN: 最后一个字符结束或直键松开后，继续保持发射到载波停止的时间。较长可跨越慢速打字者的停顿，较短可更快释放频率；关闭时，在所有排队内容发完后立即停止。

source: QRG: the main readout and the tuning line are on the frequency being worked. Click for the dial instead, a sidetone pitch below it — what most radios show.
zh-CN: QRG：主读数与调谐线位于实际工作频率。点击可改为显示调谐频率，比实际工作频率低一个侧音频率，这是大多数电台的显示方式。

source:
Put the main readout and the tuning line on the signal rather than on the dial, so the frequency shown is the one both operators would quote and the tuning line sits in the middle of the passband. Tuning is unchanged; only the numbers move.

Clicking a signal lands it on the cursor only as closely as the click step allows — Controls → click-to-tune rounding, 10 Hz by default. A coarse step leaves the signal off the pitch by up to half of it, and the readout will say so.
zh-CN:
让主读数和调谐线位于信号频率，而非调谐频率。显示的频率与双方操作者报告的一致，调谐线也位于通带中心。实际调谐不变，只改变读数。

点击信号时，定位精度受点击步进限制，可在控制 → 点击调谐取整中设置，默认 10 Hz。较粗步进会使信号偏离音调频率，最大达半个步进，读数会显示此偏移。

source: QSOs worked since sdroxide was started
zh-CN: sdroxide 启动以来完成的通联数

source: Save the whole logbook ({logged} QSO) as ADIF
zh-CN: 将整个日志（{logged} 次通联）保存为 ADIF

source: Save the whole logbook ({logged} QSO) as text
zh-CN: 将整个日志（{logged} 次通联）保存为文本

source: The contact is complete and in the log. It is held here for a few minutes so the final message can be re-sent if the other station repeats theirs — nothing more is owed.
zh-CN: 通联已完成并写入日志。此处保留几分钟，便于对方重复消息时重发最后一条；无需再继续交换。

source: DXpedition mode. The transmit frequency is held out of the Fox's half of the passband (below 1000 Hz) until the Fox answers.
zh-CN: DX 远征模式。Fox 回复前，发射频率保持在 Fox 使用的半侧通带（低于 1000 Hz）之外。

source: Transmitting stopped: no reply and no action for the watchdog period. Call CQ or pick a message to resume.
zh-CN: 发射已停止：看门狗时限内没有回复或操作。呼叫 CQ 或选择消息可恢复。

source: You transmit {:.1} s {} everyone else — the usual reason calls go unanswered. Sync your computer clock.
zh-CN: 你的发射时间偏差为 {:.1} 秒，{}其他台站，这是呼叫无应答的常见原因。请同步电脑时钟。

source: no active QSO — pick a decode to reply, or Call CQ
zh-CN: 没有进行中的通联，请选择解码回复，或呼叫 CQ

source: Every decode in one list, newest turn first, instead of odd/even turn blocks. The Sort chips then order the whole list rather than each turn, and each row carries its slot time — cyan for an even slot, gold for an odd one.
zh-CN: 全部解码放在同一列表，最新时段在前，不再按奇偶时段分块。排序控件作用于整个列表而非各时段，每行显示时隙时间，偶数时隙为青色，奇数时隙为金色。

source: Only stations calling CQ — and only the calls you may answer: a directed CQ (DX, EU, JA, POTA, TEST …) is listed when it names you and hidden when it names someone else.
zh-CN: 仅显示呼叫 CQ 且你可以回复的台站。定向 CQ（DX、EU、JA、POTA、TEST 等）指向你时显示，指向其他对象时隐藏。

source: Only stations that would be new: entity, band-slot, grid, or call
zh-CN: 仅显示新的实体、波段时隙、网格或呼号

source: Overridden by Hold TX. Lift the hold to choose which way the transmit frequency moves.
zh-CN: 被“保持发射频率”覆盖。解除保持后，可选择发射频率的调整方式。

source: Pick our transmit frequency automatically: the quietest spot in the period we transmit in, rather than the frequency of whoever we are answering — they transmit in the other period, so theirs says nothing about who is there when we key. Off does NOT hold the frequency: it answers on the frequency of the station being called. To hold, use Hold TX.
zh-CN: 自动选择我方发射时段内最安静的频率，而非被回复台站的频率：对方使用另一时段，其频率不能说明我方发射时那里是否有人。关闭并不保持频率，而是按被呼叫台站的频率回复。若需固定，请使用“保持发射频率”。

source:
Pin the transmit tone where it is. Nothing moves it: not answering a station, not the call queue, not calling CQ, not a click on a decode or on the waterfall. Turn it off to move, then on again.

Changing band is the one exception, and it is your own act: the offset you last set on the new band comes back with it, so a 60 m figure is not carried onto 20 m and 20 m's is not carried onto 60 m.

For where the licence is narrower than the band plan — on a UK 60 m dial of 5357 kHz the allocation ends at 5358.0, so the tone has to stay under 1000 Hz, and either automatic mover will walk out of the band between one over and the next.
zh-CN:
固定当前发射音调。回复台站、呼叫队列、呼叫 CQ、点击解码或瀑布图，都不会移动它。需要移动时先关闭，调整后再启用。

唯一例外是你主动换波段，会恢复新波段上次设置的偏移，避免将 60 m 设置带到 20 m，或反之。

适用于许可证范围窄于波段规划的情况：例如英国 60 m 调谐频率为 5357 kHz，分配上限为 5358.0 kHz，音调必须低于 1000 Hz，否则两种自动调频方式都可能在相邻发射之间移至带外。

source: Type the transmit offset in Hz, then press Enter. Where your licence is narrower than the band plan the whole range below the edge is yours to pick from, so nothing is suggested here.
zh-CN: 输入发射偏移，单位为 Hz，然后按 Enter。许可证范围窄于波段规划时，你可在上限内自行选择，因此此处不建议具体值。

source: Empty the decode list. Nothing that is on the air stops.
zh-CN: 清空解码列表，不会停止正在发射的信号。

source: Work this station after the current one
zh-CN: 当前通联结束后与此台站通联

source: Save the {n} decodes in the list as ADIF — received reports, not contacts. Decodes that name no sender are left out.
zh-CN: 将列表中的 {n} 条解码保存为 ADIF，属于接收报告而非通联。未指明发送者的解码不会导出。

source: Save the {n} decodes in the list as CSV, one row each
zh-CN: 将列表中的 {n} 条解码保存为 CSV，每条一行

source: Forget the pictures received so far
zh-CN: 清除目前已接收的图像

source: Callsign for directed (FSQCALL) messages; defaults to your callsign
zh-CN: 定向 FSQCALL 消息使用的呼号，默认采用你的呼号

source: Forget the selected station — the composer goes back to @ALLCALL
zh-CN: 取消选中的台站，消息接收对象恢复为 @ALLCALL

source: Every speed is being decoded; ▸ marks {}, the one you transmit at
zh-CN: 正在解码所有速率；▸ 标记你用于发射的速率 {}

source: Every speed is being decoded. Click to transmit at {} instead
zh-CN: 正在解码所有速率。点击可改用 {} 发射

source: Decode every JS8 speed, not only the one you transmit at. The four speeds share the sub-band and are four different waveforms, so without this a station on another speed is invisible — and an exchange between two speeds cannot happen at all. Costs about four times the receive CPU.
zh-CN: 解码所有 JS8 速率，而非仅解码发射所用速率。四种速率共用同一子波段，但采用四种不同波形；关闭后无法看到其他速率的台站，也无法在不同速率之间通信。接收端的处理器开销约为原来的四倍。

source: Beaconing every {hb_min} min — click to stop
zh-CN: 每 {hb_min} 分钟发送信标；点击停止

source: Turbo does not beacon — it is the local and VHF speed
zh-CN: Turbo 不发送信标；它用于本地及 VHF 通信

source: Beacon your callsign and grid every 15 minutes
zh-CN: 每 15 分钟发送包含呼号和网格定位的信标

source: The last beacon went out at {hz:.0} Hz — a free slot in the {:.0}–{:.0} Hz heartbeat sub-band, chosen so it lands clear of the signals being decoded.
zh-CN: 上次信标在 {hz:.0} Hz 发出；该频率是 {:.0}–{:.0} Hz 心跳子波段内的空闲位置，选择时避开了正在解码的信号。

source: Each button sends its whole text in one go. F2–F10 press the first nine, so long as nothing on screen has the keyboard.
zh-CN: 每个按钮一次发送全部文本。当屏幕上的控件没有占用键盘输入时，F2–F10 可触发前九个按钮。

source: {MYCALL} and {MYGRID} are filled in as the message goes out.
zh-CN: 发送消息时会自动填入 {MYCALL} 和 {MYGRID}。

source: nothing yet — a station transmits for ten minutes every four hours
zh-CN: 尚未收到消息；每个台站每四小时发射十分钟

source: Time of day stated in the message (UTC): display only
zh-CN: 消息正文中标明的 UTC 时间；仅用于显示
显示全部解码内容，无论是否构成消息

source: The character phase is locked — a signal is being read.
zh-CN: 字符相位已锁定，正在读取信号。

source: No character phase yet: no signal, or not this one.
zh-CN: 尚未锁定字符相位：没有信号，或信号不属于此模式。
已修复 {} 个 · 丢失 {} 个

source: Characters whose first copy was corrupt and were taken from the repeat five slots later, and those where both were bad. A NAVTEX character is sent twice; that is the whole of its error correction.
zh-CN: 首次接收损坏、由五个时隙后重复发送的副本修复的字符数，以及两次接收均损坏的字符数。NAVTEX 的每个字符发送两次，这就是它的全部纠错机制。

source: Swap the mark and space tones, for a signal received on the other sideband. Off is upper sideband on the channel frequency, which is what every published tuning instruction for the service says.
zh-CN: 交换传号与空号音调，以接收另一边带上的信号。关闭时按公布的调谐说明，在频道频率上使用上边带。
正在启动 NAVTEX 接收机…

source: Extended sequence numbers — a window of up to 127 frames.
zh-CN: 扩展序号，支持最多 127 帧的窗口。

source: Frames sent and not yet acknowledged by the far end.
zh-CN: 已发送但尚未得到远端确认的帧。

source: Retries against this link's limit. A count climbing while the unacknowledged frames stay put is what a fading path looks like from this side.
zh-CN: 重试次数与此链路上限。计数持续增加、未确认帧没有减少，是链路衰落时本端常见的表现。

source: The MAIL window is using the link.
zh-CN: 邮件窗口正在使用链路。

source: One radio, one channel, one link. A Winlink session and this terminal are two ways to use it, and whichever asks first gets it.
zh-CN: 一台电台、一个通道、一条链路。Winlink 会话与此终端是使用同一链路的两种方式，先请求的一方获得使用权。

source: Digipeaters, nearest first, separated by commas — OE3XLR-1,OE3XMS-1. Leave it empty for a station you can hear directly, or to use the default path from the packet settings.
zh-CN: 数字中继台按由近到远排列，以逗号分隔，例如 OE3XLR-1,OE3XMS-1。直接可接收的台站可留空，也可留空使用分组设置中的默认路径。

source: Hang up properly, and wait for the far end to agree. Changing mode instead ends the session without telling anybody.
zh-CN: 正常断开，并等待远端确认。直接更换模式会结束会话，但不会通知对方。

source: The MAIL window has the link. Finish or stop that session first.
zh-CN: 邮件窗口占用链路，请先完成或停止该会话。

source: This station has no callsign yet — set one under SETUP, above the monitor pane. Nothing transmits until it is set.
zh-CN: 此台站尚未设置呼号，请使用监听面板上方的设置入口。设置前不会发射。

source: Call this station in connected mode — a node, a BBS, or another operator.
zh-CN: 以连接模式呼叫此台站，可连接节点、BBS 或其他操作者。
需要填写被呼叫台站的呼号。

source: Empty the transcript. The link is untouched — a connected station stays connected.
zh-CN: 清空终端记录，不影响链路，已连接的台站仍保持连接。

source: Not connected. Type a callsign above and press CONNECT to call a node or a BBS.
zh-CN: 未连接。在上方输入呼号，点击“连接”可呼叫节点或 BBS。

source: Send the line. A node or a BBS reads one line at a time.
zh-CN: 发送此行。节点或 BBS 每次读取一行。

source: Frames that arrived but failed their check sequence — a collision, a fade, or a signal too weak to read.
zh-CN: 接收到但校验序列失败的帧，可能由碰撞、衰落或过弱信号造成。

source: Station callsign, speed, TX delay, the digipeater path, the beacon and the KISS server
zh-CN: 台站呼号、速率、发射延迟、数字中继路径、信标及 KISS 服务器
正在启动分组调制解调器…

source: Time left in this one-minute beacon cycle. The PI4 message is searched for once the window has had time to fill past where it would end.
zh-CN: 当前一分钟信标周期的剩余时间。当接收窗口积累的数据已超过 PI4 消息的预期结束位置时，开始搜索消息。

source: Receive only. Tune so the beacon's CW identification sits at 800 Hz audio — the network's own convention — and the four PI4 tones fall where this decoder searches for them by default.
zh-CN: 仅接收。调谐至信标的 CW 识别信号位于 800 Hz 音频处；这是该网络的通行约定，也会让四个 PI4 音调落入解码器默认的搜索位置。

source: Save the PI4 reception list as CSV
zh-CN: 将 PI4 接收列表保存为 CSV

source:
The callsign the station put in its End-of-Over frame — the only point in a RADE over at which one is sent. It is also what is reported to FreeDV Reporter, so a station you hear appears on qso.freedv.org as heard by you.

Held for a minute after the signal goes, and dropped when you start an over of your own: it names the station on frequency, not every station the receiver has ever heard.
zh-CN:
对方在发话结束帧中发送的呼号；这是 RADE 一次发话中唯一发送呼号的时刻。此呼号也会报告给 FreeDV Reporter，因此你接收到的台站会在 qso.freedv.org 上显示为被你接收。

信号消失后保留一分钟，开始自行发话时清除：它表示当前频率上的台站，而非接收机曾收到的所有台站。

source: Open or close a RADE over. The modem needs ~120 ms of speech before the first frame goes out, and sends an end-of-over frame when you stop, so transmit runs on a little past the button.
zh-CN: 开始或结束一次 RADE 发话。调制解调器需要约 120 ms 的语音才能发出第一帧，停止时还会发送发话结束帧，因此松开按钮后发射会继续片刻。

source: RADE V1 occupies roughly 1060–1880 Hz of the passband — upper sideband, or lower on 160, 80 and 40 m, where RADE keeps phone practice and sdroxide switches for you. Put the signal inside the shaded band on the waterfall; the modem finds it from there.
zh-CN: RADE V1 约占用通带中的 1060–1880 Hz。通常使用上边带；160、80 和 40 米波段沿用语音通信惯例，使用下边带，SDRoxide 会自动切换。将信号置于瀑布图的阴影区域内，调制解调器会自行捕获。

source: ⚠ {} samples dropped between the receiver and the decoder — this machine is not keeping up with the neural decode.
zh-CN: ⚠ 接收机与解码器之间丢失了 {} 个采样；本机处理速度跟不上神经网络解码。

source: Mute the demodulated audio, so only decoded speech is heard. The raw signal is otherwise passed through whenever the modem has nothing to play — that hiss is how you find an over before it syncs, so leave this off while tuning.
zh-CN: 将解调后的音频静音，只播放解码出的语音。否则，当调制解调器没有语音可播放时，会直接播放原始信号；这段噪声可帮助你在同步前找到对方的发话，因此调谐时请关闭此选项。

source: How far the received signal sits from where the modem expects it. Large values still decode — the acquisition loop tracks them — but nudging the dial to bring this near zero gives the best margin.
zh-CN: 接收信号偏离调制解调器预期频率的幅度。偏差较大时仍可解码，捕获环会跟踪信号；但微调拨盘、使此值接近零，可以获得最大的解码余量。

source: How fast the text/image is scanned onto the waterfall. Lower is slower and more legible; 100% = base rate, 25% (centre) is the default.
zh-CN: 将文字或图像扫描到瀑布图上的速度。数值越低，速度越慢，也越清晰；100% 为基准速率，25%（中央位置）为默认值。

source: 9600 needs the radio's data port. A microphone and speaker path destroys it at both ends — that is the radio, not sdroxide.
zh-CN: 9600 需要电台的数据端口。麦克风和扬声器路径会在两端破坏信号，这是电台的限制。

source: Flags sent before a frame, so the far end can hear us and lock its clock. On a CAT rig sdroxide alone spends 165–240 ms getting on the air, and the rig's own transmit-ready time is on top of that.
zh-CN: 帧前发送的标志，使远端能够检测信号并锁定时钟。使用 CAT 电台时，仅 sdroxide 启动发射就需 165–240 ms，此外还需电台自身准备时间。

source: The most a single frame carries. Shorter frames survive a marginal path — only the frame that was hit is resent — and cost more overhead. 128 on HF, 256 where the path is solid.
zh-CN: 单帧携带的最大数据量。较短的帧更能适应不稳定链路，只需重发受损帧，但开销更大。HF 通常使用 128，稳定链路使用 256。

source: Frames sent before waiting for an acknowledgement. More fills a good path; on a bad one it is more to resend.
zh-CN: 等待确认前发送的帧数。增大可充分利用良好链路，但较差链路上需要重发的帧也更多。

source: Extended sequence numbers, for a window bigger than seven. Many nodes refuse the request with a DM, which looks exactly like a station that would not talk to you — so leave it off unless you know the far end wants it.
zh-CN: 扩展序号，支持超过七帧的窗口。许多节点会以 DM 拒绝请求，看起来与不愿建立连接相同。因此除非确定远端支持，否则保持关闭。

source: Off for a Winlink client, which dials out and has no reason to answer. On to be reachable as a peer: a call arrives in the terminal pane and you talk to whoever made it. A station whose link is already busy with a Winlink session refuses calls until that finishes.
zh-CN: Winlink 客户端主动呼出，无需接听，应关闭此项。若要作为可连接的对等台站，可启用：呼叫显示在终端面板中，可与呼叫者交流。链路正用于 Winlink 会话时，会拒绝呼叫，直到会话结束。

source: what a caller is greeted with
Sent to a station that connects to us, once the link is up. Empty sends nothing — which looks broken to whoever called.
zh-CN: 远端连接且链路建立后发送的文本。留空则不发送，对呼叫者可能看起来像连接故障。

source: The digipeater path the terminal starts with. The path to your local node is the same every time, and retyping it is how a hop gets left off.
zh-CN: 终端初始使用的数字中继路径。本地节点路径每次通常相同，反复手填容易漏掉一跳。

source: Offer this modem as a KISS TNC on a socket, so Pat, an APRS client or the Linux AX.25 stack can use the radio.
zh-CN: 通过套接字将此调制解调器作为 KISS TNC 提供给 Pat、APRS 客户端或 Linux AX.25 协议栈，以使用电台。

source: The callsign this station beacons under, with its SSID — OE3JJS-9 for a car, -10 for an I-gate, -5 for a phone. Leave it empty to use the callsign above.
zh-CN: 此台站发送信标使用的呼号及 SSID，例如汽车用 OE3JJS-9，I-gate 用 -10，手机用 -5。留空时使用上方呼号。

source: No callsign: this station will not transmit at all — not a beacon, not a message, not an acknowledgement.
zh-CN: 未设置呼号：此台站完全不会发射，包括信标、消息和确认。

source: The two characters as the protocol carries them: a table (`/` or `\`) and a symbol code. A digit or a letter in the first position is an overlay, drawn on top of the alternate table's icon.
zh-CN: 协议中的两个字符：符号表（`/` 或 `\`）和符号代码。首位若为数字或字母，则作为叠加标识，绘制在备用符号表图标上。

source: How far you ask to be repeated. This is the single most consequential setting on the channel: every hop multiplies the transmissions the whole network makes on one shared frequency.
zh-CN: 请求转发的范围。这是通道上影响最大的设置：每增加一跳，都使整个网络在同一共享频率上的发射次数成倍增加。

source: Beacon the centre of the locator above, reported with the ambiguity a locator actually has — a six-character one is a couple of kilometres across, and saying so is honest. Untick to give exact coordinates instead.
zh-CN: 发送上方定位符中心的位置，并按定位符实际精度报告位置模糊度。六位定位符覆盖约几公里，应如实表示。取消勾选后可填写精确坐标。

source: Decimal degrees, negative for {hemi}. Paste one straight off a map.
zh-CN: 十进制度数，{hemi} 使用负值。可直接从地图粘贴。

source: 0 — the default — never beacons on a timer. Thirty minutes is the convention for a fixed station; a moving one beacons oftener, but every beacon is somebody else's channel time.
zh-CN: 默认 0 表示不定时发送信标。固定台站通常每三十分钟发送一次，移动台站更频繁，但每次信标都会占用其他人的通道时间。

source: The compressed position format: a third of the air time and more precise. Every receiver since the 1990s reads it.
zh-CN: 压缩位置格式，占用约三分之一的发射时间，且更精确。自 1990 年代以来的接收机均支持。

source: The first goes out one interval from now, not immediately.
zh-CN: 首次发送在一个间隔之后，不会立即发送。

source: Answer messages addressed to you. An acknowledgement is a transmission this station makes without being asked, so a receive-only setup should turn it off — and the beacon then stops claiming to be reachable too.
zh-CN: 确认发给你的消息。确认是台站自动发起的发射，因此仅接收配置应关闭此项；信标也将不再声明台站可被联系。

source: Flags sent ahead of every frame, so the far end's modem hears the carrier and locks its clock before the data starts. It has to outlast everything between pressing transmit and radiating: sdroxide alone spends 165–240 ms of it on a CAT rig, and a radio taking audio over a network buffers more on top. Too little and the far end never locks — the transmission is there and nothing decodes it.
zh-CN: 每帧前发送的标志，使远端调制解调器在数据开始前检测载波并锁定时钟。时长必须覆盖从启动发射到实际射频输出的全部延迟：CAT 电台上仅 sdroxide 就需 165–240 ms，通过网络接收音频的电台还会增加缓冲时间。过短时远端无法锁定，虽有发射却无法解码。

source: How long a station stays on the map after it was last heard. Also what the map's fade is measured against, so a short window shows only what is live.
zh-CN: 最后一次接收后，台站在地图上的保留时间。地图淡出也以此为基准，较短的时间窗只显示当前活动台站。

source: Answer a direct question addressed to you or to @ALLCALL, with the answer rather than an acknowledgement. Never answers another station's traffic, and never answers itself.
zh-CN: 对于直接发给你或 @ALLCALL 的询问，发送答案而非确认。不会回复其他台站之间的通信，也不会回复自己。

source: Turbo does not beacon — it is the local and VHF speed.
zh-CN: Turbo 不发送信标；它用于本地及 VHF 通信。

source: Sends your callsign and grid so others know you are receivable. The first goes out one interval from now, not immediately.
zh-CN: 发送呼号和网格定位，让其他台站知道能接收到你。首次发送将在一个间隔后进行，不会立即发送。

source: Move each beacon to a free slot in the heartbeat sub-band, the way JS8Call does: it is where stations watching for beacons look, and it keeps an unattended transmitter off somebody else's QSO. The slot is chosen when the beacon actually goes out, clear of everything being decoded.
zh-CN: 与 JS8Call 相同，在心跳子频段中为每次信标选择空闲位置。监测信标的台站会关注这里，也能避免无人值守发射占用他人通联。实际发送时才选择频率，避开所有正在解码的信号。

source: Beacon where you are working instead. Against the band convention, but it keeps everything you transmit in one place.
zh-CN: 改为在当前工作频率发送信标。虽不符合波段惯例，但能让所有发射集中在同一位置。

source: Answer heartbeats with a signal report

Tell a station that beaconed how well you copied them. Off by default: a busy band carries a heartbeat every slot, and answering all of them would flood exactly the band heartbeats exist to keep quiet. Rate-limited to one answer per station every 15 minutes, and never while a message is still arriving or while you have something queued to send.
zh-CN: 告诉发送信标的台站你接收得如何。默认关闭：繁忙波段可能每个时隙都有心跳，全部回复反而会占满心跳旨在保持安静的波段。每台站最多每 15 分钟回复一次，且收到的消息尚未结束或有待发队列时不会回复。

source: Choose the transmit frequency automatically: the quietest spot in the period you transmit in, rather than the frequency of the station you are answering. Off does NOT hold it — it answers on the frequency of the station being called. To hold, use Hold TX.
zh-CN: 自动选择发射时段内最安静的频率，而非被回复台站的频率。关闭并不表示保持频率，而是按被呼叫台站的频率回复。若需固定频率，请启用“保持发射频率”。

source: Pin the transmit tone where it is. Nothing moves it: not answering a station, not the call queue, not calling CQ, not a click on a decode or the waterfall. Overrides Auto TX frequency. Changing band is the one exception: the offset you last set on the new band comes back with it. For where your licence is narrower than the band plan — on a UK 60 m dial of 5357 kHz the allocation ends at 5358.0, so the tone must stay under 1000 Hz.
zh-CN: 固定当前发射音调。回复台站、呼叫队列、呼叫 CQ，以及点击解码或瀑布图，都不会移动它。此项优先于自动选择发射频率。唯一例外是换波段，会恢复该波段上次设置的偏移。适用于许可证范围窄于波段规划的情况：例如英国 60 m 调谐频率为 5357 kHz，分配上限为 5358.0 kHz，音调必须保持在 1000 Hz 以下。

source: Stop transmitting after this long with no reply and no action from you. 0 disables it.
zh-CN: 在此时间内没有回复且没有你的操作时停止发射。0 表示禁用。

source: Unanswered calls to one station before moving on. Calling CQ is exempt. 0 disables it.
zh-CN: 对同一台站无应答呼叫达到此次数后转向下一台站。呼叫 CQ 不受限制，0 表示禁用。

source: The everyday exchange: grid, report, RR73.
zh-CN: 常规交换：网格定位、信号报告、RR73。

source: European VHF contests: send a signal report, a serial number and your SIX-character locator, in the message layout WSJT-X calls EU VHF Contest. CQ goes out as CQ TEST.
zh-CN: 欧洲 VHF 竞赛：发送信号报告、序号和六位网格定位，使用 WSJT-X 称为 EU VHF Contest 的消息格式。CQ 以 CQ TEST 发出。

source: The serial number the next exchange will carry. It advances by itself as each contact is logged and is remembered between sessions — set it by hand only to start a contest, or to pick up where a paper log got to.
zh-CN: 下次交换使用的流水号。每次记录通联后自动递增，并在会话之间保存。仅在开始竞赛或接续纸质日志时手动设置。

source: EU VHF Contest messages carry a six-character locator (JN88DD, not JN88). Until My grid has one, the ordinary exchange is sent instead.
zh-CN: 欧洲 VHF 竞赛消息使用六位定位符，例如 JN88DD，而非 JN88。“我的网格定位符”未设置六位值前，发送普通交换消息。

source: Calling a DXpedition running Fox mode: call from above 1000 Hz, move down onto the Fox when it answers, and log on its RR73 without sending 73.
zh-CN: 呼叫使用 Fox 模式的远征台：从 1000 Hz 以上呼叫，对方应答后移至 Fox 的频率；收到 RR73 后记入日志，不再发送 73。

source: Run the pile-up: several signals at once, a queue of callers, worked strongest and rarest first. CALL CQ starts it, STOP QSO stands it down.
zh-CN: 处理集中呼叫：同时发送多个信号，将呼叫台站排入队列，优先联络最强信号及最稀有台站。“呼叫 CQ”开始运行，“停止通联”结束运行。

source: Simultaneous transmissions, spaced 60 Hz apart. They share the transmitter's power, so more signals means each is weaker.
zh-CN: 同时发送的信号数，各相隔 60 Hz。它们共享发射功率，因此信号越多，每个越弱。

source:
How loud this mode's burst is handed to a radio that modulates it itself — and on FM that is the deviation, because an FM transmitter turns audio level into frequency swing and has no ALC to catch it. 1200 baud packet wants about 3 kHz where voice wants 5, so full scale into a data input set for voice over-deviates — which sounds completely normal to a listener and decodes for nobody. Turn it down until other stations report you, or set the level at the radio.

This level belongs to this mode alone. A mode you have never set starts from the FM figure, and the sideband modes start from their own — so a deviation set for 1200 baud never lands on FT8.
zh-CN:
将本模式的突发信号送入自行调制的电台时的音频幅度。在 FM 上，它决定频偏，因为 FM 发射机会把音频电平转换为频率摆幅，且没有 ALC 来限制。1200 波特分组通信需要约 3 kHz 频偏，而语音需要 5 kHz；将满幅音频送入按语音配置的数据输入会导致过大频偏。听起来可能完全正常，其他台站却无法解码。逐步降低电平，直至其他台站能收到并报告你，或在电台端设置电平。

此电平仅属于当前模式。未设置过的模式以 FM 电平为初值，边带模式则使用各自的初值；1200 波特的频偏设置不会影响 FT8。

source:
How loud this mode's over is handed to a radio that modulates it itself — a CAT rig on its sound card, a FLEX, an Icom on its network port. On sideband this is drive into the modulator: bring it down until the rig's ALC is barely moving and set the power at the radio, because ALC riding on a constant-envelope mode is what splatters. Drive reaches the rig's power register here, not its audio, so this is the level.

This level belongs to this mode alone: FT8, RTTY, PSK and MCW each keep their own, because they do not load a modulator the same way. The same rail is on the transmit strip, where you can reach it while you are transmitting.
zh-CN:
将本模式的发话送入自行调制的电台时的音频幅度，例如使用声卡的 CAT 电台、FLEX 或通过网络连接的 Icom。在边带模式下，这是调制器的驱动电平：降低到电台 ALC 几乎不动作，并在电台端设置功率；恒包络模式下 ALC 持续动作会导致频谱扩散。此处的驱动控制作用于电台的功率寄存器，而非音频，因此应在这里调整音频电平。

此电平仅属于当前模式。FT8、RTTY、PSK 和 MCW 各自保存设置，因为它们对调制器的负载不同。发射控制栏上也有同样的滑轨，可在发射期间调整。

zh-CN: 每张图像后以音调发送呼号，供 SSTV 中继及其他软件识别。约增加 2.5 秒；未设置呼号时不发送任何标识。

zh-CN: 自定义消息按钮，可填写工作条件、天气或常用回复。每个按钮一次发送全部文本，F2–F10 对应前九个按钮。消息保存在台站配置中，远程客户端也可使用。

source: This goes out in the message, and everyone who hears you judges the path by it — so an optimistic figure here makes their measurements wrong as well as yours.

source: Pick a different offset inside the 200 Hz window for every transmission. This is the convention: two hundred hertz shared by everyone only works if nobody parks in the middle of it. Off holds where the cursor is.
zh-CN: 每次发射在 200 Hz 窗口内选择不同的频偏。这是通行做法：所有台站共用这 200 Hz，只有大家都不长期占据中央频率，才能正常共享。关闭后保持在光标所在频率。

source: Move the dial from band to band between slots, so one receiver samples the whole spectrum instead of one slice of it. Turning the VFO yourself pauses it — press this twice to resume.

source: Send what this station decodes to wsprnet.org. Reporting what you hear is what makes a WSPR receiver part of the network; it puts nothing on the air.
zh-CN: 将本站解码的接收报告发送至 wsprnet.org。报告你收到的信号，才能让 WSPR 接收机成为网络的一部分；此操作不会进行射频发射。

source: Ask wsprnet.org every few minutes which stations decoded this one. WSPR has no acknowledgement of any kind, so this is the only way a beacon learns anything about its own reach.
zh-CN: 每隔几分钟向 wsprnet.org 查询哪些台站解码了本站信号。WSPR 没有任何确认机制，因此这是信标了解自身覆盖范围的唯一方式。

source:
Extra gain on everything this radio sends to the speakers, on top of the volume control. Leave it at 0 dB unless the radio is quiet at full volume: the volume rail's top is the audio as it arrives, so it can turn a radio down but never up, and some transceivers' USB sound output sits well below full scale.

Go up 6 dB at a time. Too much clips — the audio is limited at full scale rather than allowed to wrap round, so overdoing it sounds harsh rather than loud. Recordings are taken ahead of this and are not affected.
zh-CN:
在音量控制之外，为本台送往扬声器的音频增加增益。除非音量调至最大仍偏小，否则请保持 0 dB：音量滑条上限对应原始输入音量，只能减小音量，不能放大；有些收发机的 USB 音频输出明显低于满量程。

建议每次增加 6 dB。增益过大会削波：音频会限制在满量程，不会溢出回绕，因此声音会刺耳，而不只是更响。录音在增益处理之前采集，不受此设置影响。

source:
Stops the transmission when the radio reports an SWR at or above this figure, and keeps transmit locked out until you acknowledge it. Catches a disconnected antenna, a failed feeder, or a switch left on the wrong port.

Tuning is treated differently, because feeding a mismatch is the point of it: an antenna tuner gets double the limit and about five seconds before the guard applies at all. A manual tuner that takes longer than that wants the guard switched off for the session.

Needs a rig that reports SWR over CAT. Ignores the first fifth of a second of each transmission, and does not wait for high power.
zh-CN:
电台报告的驻波比达到或超过此值时停止发射，并锁定发射功能，直到你确认解除。可用于发现天线未连接、馈线故障或开关接错端口。

调谐载波采用不同规则，因为天线调谐器需要在失配情况下调整：阈值提高到两倍，且约五秒后保护才开始生效。若手动调谐耗时更长，可在本次调谐期间关闭保护。

需要电台通过 CAT 报告驻波比。保护忽略每次发射的前 0.2 秒，且不以高功率作为触发前提。

zh-CN: 与 SDRoxide 保存的其他密码一样，这些凭据以明文存储在 config.toml 中。

source:
How far a converter moves the signal on its way to the receiver, in Hz — the same number and sign every converter's documentation and every other SDR program states. The radio ends up on dial + offset: positive for an upconverter (a Ham It Up is 125000000), negative for anything that brings a band down to an I.F. — a satellite LNB, or a 2 m transverter on a 28 MHz I.F., which is -116000000 (28 − 144). 0 = no converter.

Drag to trim it a hertz at a time, which is what a converter whose oscillator is slightly off wants.

This is the receive path. What is in the transmit line is the row below.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
变频器将输入信号平移的频率，单位为 Hz，符号约定与变频器文档及其他 SDR 软件相同。电台实际频率为“读数 + 偏移”：上变频为正，例如 Ham It Up 为 125000000；变换至中频为负，例如卫星 LNB，或将 2 m 变换到 28 MHz 中频的收发器，其偏移为 -116000000（28 − 144）。0 表示不使用变频器。

拖动可按 1 Hz 微调，以补偿振荡器误差。

此项用于接收路径；发射路径在下一行设置。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
What is in the transmit line while a converter is set.

Off while converting: nothing is transmitted — the safe default, and right for a receive-only accessory.

Through the same converter: one box converts both ways, a transverter. Transmit takes the offset above and follows it when it is trimmed.

Its own offset: the transmit line is different from the receive one. Nought is the common case — a converter (an LNB, a Ham It Up) on receive with the transmitter on its own antenna, which is the QO-100 station.

The amateur-band check still applies, on the frequency you are transmitting on.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
使用接收变频器时，发射路径的设置。

变频时禁止发射：不发射，默认选择，适用于仅接收的附件。

通过同一变频器：同一设备进行双向变频。发射使用上方偏移，并跟随其微调。

独立偏移：发射路径与接收路径不同。常见值为 0，即接收端使用 LNB、Ham It Up 等变频器，发射端使用独立天线，QO-100 台站即属此类。

业余波段检查仍按实际发射对应的频率进行。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
How far the transmit line moves the signal, in Hz, on the same sign rule as the receive offset: the radio transmits at dial + offset.

0 = the transmitter is wired to its own antenna and works on the frequency the dial says — a QO-100 station's 2.4 GHz uplink.

A transmit converter that takes an I.F. *up* is a negative number: the radio works below the dial.
zh-CN:
发射路径的频移，单位为 Hz，符号约定与接收偏移相同：电台发射频率为“读数 + 偏移”。

0 表示发射机使用独立天线，实际频率与读数一致，例如 QO-100 台站的 2.4 GHz 上行。

将中频上变频的发射变频器应填负数，因为电台本身工作在低于读数的频率。

source:
Where this radio listens from.

At the station: the antenna is yours, so your own locator says where it is. The default, and right for everything in the shack.

Somewhere else: an online receiver, or your own set up on a hilltop. What it hears is reported to PSK Reporter, WSPRnet and FreeDV Reporter from the locator beside this, never from yours — and ADS-B places aircraft against it too.

Picking a receiver under "Public SDRs" fills this in for you.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
此电台的接收位置。

本站：使用本站天线，以本站网格定位符表示位置，适用于电台室内设备，默认选择。

其他位置：在线接收机，或位于山顶等处的自有接收机。PSK Reporter、WSPRnet、FreeDV Reporter 及 ADS-B 使用旁边填写的接收机定位符，不使用本站定位符。

从“公共 SDR”选择接收机时会自动填写。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
The receiver's Maidenhead locator — JN88ec, DO30db. Four or six characters.

Leave it empty if you do not know where the receiver is: nothing is then reported at all, which is the only honest answer. Reporting from your own square would put somebody else's reception on the wrong continent.
zh-CN:
接收机的 Maidenhead 网格定位符，例如 JN88ec、DO30db，长度为 4 或 6 个字符。

未知接收位置时请留空，程序将不上传接收报告。填入本站位置会将其他接收机的接收结果错误定位。

source: Ranges are in MHz, low-high, separated by commas: 144-146, 430-440 — that is 144000000-146000000 Hz and 430000000-440000000 Hz. They are dial frequencies: a converter offset does not move them. The converter offset above is the field in hertz. Leave a range empty to use whatever the device reports about itself; a device that reports nothing is taken at its word.
zh-CN: 范围单位为 MHz，格式为下限-上限，多段用逗号分隔，例如 144-146, 430-440，对应 144000000-146000000 Hz 和 430000000-440000000 Hz。这里是频率读数范围，不受变频偏移移动；上方偏移才使用 Hz。留空时采用设备报告的范围；设备没有报告范围时，不额外限制。

source: Careful on an RTL-SDR: the Blog V4 upconverts on its own below 28.8 MHz, so a negative offset that lands the hardware there shifts twice.
zh-CN: RTL-SDR 用户注意：Blog V4 在 28.8 MHz 以下自行上变频。若负偏移使硬件频率落入此范围，可能产生两次频移。

source: A 3-band parametric EQ on the microphone audio, ahead of the modulator. Voice modes only (SSB/AM/FM); digital modes and CW carry synthesized or keyed audio that never reaches it. Off by default and flat when turned on, so enabling it changes nothing on the air until a band below is actually moved. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 调制器前端的三段参数均衡器，处理麦克风音频，仅用于 SSB／AM／FM 话音模式。数字模式与 CW 使用合成或键控音频，不经过此均衡器。默认关闭；启用时各段为平直响应，在实际调整下面某一段之前不会改变发射音频。立即生效。

source: Read the world's CW/RTTY skimmers and feed the propagation map with them. This is what makes the map show bands this radio is not listening to. On by default: it puts nothing on the air, needs no account, and uses the callsign from the General tab. RBN spots do not appear in the spot list — they are measurements, not invitations.
zh-CN: 接收全球 CW／RTTY 扫描解码器的通报，供传播地图显示本站当前未监听波段的情况。默认启用，不发射无线电信号，无需账户，使用“常规”页的呼号。RBN 通报是测量结果，因此不显示在邀请通联的通报列表中。

source: 7000 is the CW/RTTY feed, 7001 the FT8/FT4 one
zh-CN: 7000 为 CW／RTTY 数据源，7001 为 FT8／FT4 数据源

source: Sent after login. The place to narrow the feed — without a filter this is every skimmer on Earth.
zh-CN: 登录后发送。可在此设置过滤条件；不设置则接收全球扫描解码器的通报。

source: RBN paths are placed from country centres, not locators — accurate for a small country, out by a long way for a large one. They are a separate layer on the propagation map and can be switched off there.
zh-CN: RBN 路径按国家中心位置估算，不使用网格定位符。小国误差较小，大国可能偏差较大。传播地图将其作为独立图层，可在地图中关闭。

source: Report what this station hears to pskreporter.info, so it appears there as a receiver. Uses the callsign and grid from the General tab.
zh-CN: 将本站收到的电台报告至 pskreporter.info，使本站显示为接收台。使用“常规”页的呼号与网格定位符。

source: 4739 is the live collector, 14739 the test one
zh-CN: 4739 为正式收集服务器，14739 为测试服务器
上传本站 WSPR 解码结果

source: Send every WSPR reception to wsprnet.org. On by default: it puts nothing on the air, and reporting what you hear is what makes a WSPR receiver part of the network rather than a private curiosity. A slot that decoded nothing is reported too, which is how the network tells a shut band from a receiver that was switched off.
zh-CN: 将每条 WSPR 接收结果发送至 wsprnet.org。默认启用，此项不发射无线电信号，上传所听结果可参与 WSPR 接收网络。没有解码结果的时隙也会报告，以便网络区分传播关闭与接收机关闭。

source: Ask wsprnet.org which stations decoded this one. WSPR has no acknowledgement of any kind, so this is the only way a transmitting beacon learns anything about its own reach.
zh-CN: 向 wsprnet.org 查询哪些电台解码了本站信号。WSPR 协议没有确认信息，这是发射信标了解覆盖范围的方式。

source: The Winlink account password, not the gateway password. It is case-sensitive — enter it exactly as it was issued.
zh-CN: 填写 Winlink 账户密码，非网关密码。密码区分大小写，请按原样输入。

source: Forward with the CMS over the internet
zh-CN: 通过互联网与 CMS 转发邮件

source: Call an RMS gateway on the air. The radio must be in PACKET or PACKET-HF.
zh-CN: 通过无线电呼叫 RMS 网关，电台需处于 PACKET 或 PACKET-HF 模式。

source: Digipeaters, in order, separated by spaces. Usually empty — a gateway you can hear directly is a gateway you should call directly.
zh-CN: 按顺序列出数字中继呼号，以空格分隔。通常留空，能够直接接收的网关应直接呼叫。

source: Most RMS gateways answer at 1200. Calling a 1200 gateway at 9600 sounds exactly like a gateway that is off the air, so set this from what the gateway's owner publishes rather than guessing. 9600 also needs the radio's data port at both ends. 300 is HF.
zh-CN: 多数 RMS 网关使用 1200 波特率。用 9600 呼叫 1200 网关时，表现与网关停机相同，请按网关公布的信息设置。9600 在两端均需使用电台的数据端口，300 用于 HF。

source: Zero leaves the dial alone, which is what you want when you park on one channel. Anything else tunes the radio when the session starts.
zh-CN: 0 表示保持当前调谐频率，适用于固定信道。其他值会在会话开始时调谐电台。

source: Winlink's published gateway list needs an API key sdroxide does not have, so keep your own. The two or three gateways reachable from one location are learned by trying, and they rarely change.
zh-CN: Winlink 公共网关列表需要 SDRoxide 未持有的 API 密钥，因此请维护自己的列表。同一地点可达的少数网关通常需实际尝试后确定，且很少变化。

source: Winlink's production servers only accept client names they know, and answer an unknown one with "Unknown client types are not allowed on production servers". Until sdroxide is registered with the Winlink Development Team, connecting needs a name they recognise.
zh-CN: Winlink 正式服务器只接受已登记的客户端名称，未知名称会收到“Unknown client types are not allowed on production servers”。SDRoxide 尚未向 Winlink 开发团队登记时，连接需填写服务器认可的客户端名称。

source: One HamQTH account does both — this login is the one the HamQTH upload tab uses.
zh-CN: HamQTH 的同一账户可同时用于呼号查询和上传。此处与 HamQTH 上传页共享登录信息。

source: The master switch. Which services a QSO goes to is set on each tab below.
zh-CN: 总开关。每条通联上传到哪些服务，由下方各页设置。

source: Turn on "Auto-upload each new QSO" above first — a service ticked here is not pushed until it is.
zh-CN: 请先启用上方“自动上传每条新通联”，否则此处勾选的服务不会自动收到上传。

source: Auto-upload is off above, so the service ticks are disabled and nothing is pushed automatically yet — the per-QSO UP button in the logbook still works.
zh-CN: 上方自动上传已关闭，各服务选项不可用，暂不自动上传；通联日志中每条记录的“上传”按钮仍可使用。

source: The QRZ logbook API key from your QRZ logbook settings — not the XML-lookup login.
zh-CN: QRZ 日志设置中的日志 API 密钥，不是 XML 呼号查询的登录信息。

source: The same login as the HamQTH callsign lookup — filling in either one fills in both.
zh-CN: 与 HamQTH 呼号查询共用登录信息，任一处填写都会同步到另一处。

source: The developer API key from World Radio League → Integrations → Developer API. It is shown once when you generate it, so copy it then. Contacts go to your default logbook — set one in WRL if you keep more than one.
zh-CN: World Radio League → Integrations → Developer API 中的开发者 API 密钥。生成时只显示一次，请及时复制。记录上传到默认日志；若 WRL 中有多个日志，请先设置默认日志。

source: LoTW upload uses TQSL — export ADIF from the logbook and sign it. LoTW/eQSL confirmations are downloaded here to mark worked-vs-confirmed.
zh-CN: LoTW 上传需使用 TQSL：从日志导出 ADIF 并签名。此处下载 LoTW／eQSL 确认，用于标记“已通联”与“已确认”。

source:
Its spectrum, its waterfall and everything read off them are on that radio's tab, which is why it has none of its own. The interface settings above are still this radio's and still apply — press Apply / reconnect after changing them and both radios come back up together.

To use it on its own again, clear the Panadapter receiver box on that radio's page.
zh-CN:
其频谱、瀑布图及相关测量均显示在所服务电台的标签页，因此本页没有独立频谱。上方接口设置仍属于此接收机；修改后点击“应用／重新连接”，两台设备会一起重新打开。

若要恢复独立使用，请在所服务电台页将频谱接收机设为“无”。

source: Give this radio a wideband panadapter by borrowing another radio's receiver — an SDR on the same antenna, or one fed from this radio's I.F. output. The spectrum, the waterfall, the sub receiver, the digital modes and the skimmer all come from that receiver; the dial, the mode, the filter and the transmitter stay here.
zh-CN: 借用另一台电台的接收机，为本电台提供宽带频谱：可使用共用天线的 SDR，或连接中频输出的接收机。频谱、瀑布图、副接收机、数字模式及扫描解码器来自借用接收机；频率读数、模式、滤波器和发射机仍由本电台控制。

source:
Which radio receives for this one. It leaves the tab strip while it is lent — its front end belongs to this radio's engine — and comes straight back when this is set to None.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
选择为本电台接收的设备。借用期间，它会从标签栏隐藏，其前端由本电台引擎控制；设为“无”后立即恢复。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
How far above this radio's dial the receiver sits, in hertz. 0 for a receiver on the same antenna; the intermediate frequency for an I.F. tap — 9000000 for a 9 MHz I.F., 70455000 for a 70.455 MHz one.

This is not the Converter field above, which retunes the radio, and not the CAT tab's I/Q centre offset, which is about this radio's own sound card. Nothing typed here is ever sent to either radio.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
接收机中心相对本电台读数的偏移，单位为 Hz。共用天线接收机填 0；中频抽头填写中频，例如 9 MHz 填 9000000，70.455 MHz 填 70455000。

此项既不是上方会改变电台调谐的变频器偏移，也不是 CAT 页针对电台自身声卡的 I/Q 中心偏移。这里的数值不会作为命令发送到任何电台。

点击“应用”后生效。

source: Keep the receiver on this radio's dial, and move the dial when you tune on the panadapter. Off parks the receiver where it is — a fixed watch on one segment while the radio goes elsewhere.
zh-CN: 使接收机跟随本电台读数，操作频谱调谐时也改变电台读数。关闭后，接收机停留在当前频率，可固定监听某一段，同时电台调谐到其他位置。

source: Mirror the receiver's span about its centre, for a tap whose oscillator sits above the signal and hands the band over the wrong way round. Leave it off unless the waterfall fills with signals that are all on the wrong side of the dial.
zh-CN: 将接收机频谱关于中心镜像，用于本振高于信号、频谱方向相反的中频抽头。除非瀑布图中的信号均出现在读数错误的一侧，否则保持关闭。

source: Silence receive audio while this radio is transmitting. On by default: with the receiver on the same antenna, or on this radio's I.F., what it hears during an over is your own transmitter. Overs keyed at the radio itself — the microphone's PTT, a foot switch, MOX — count too, as soon as the CAT link says the rig has gone to transmit.
zh-CN: 本电台发射时关闭接收音频，默认启用。共用天线或连接中频时，接收机在发射期间听到的是本站发射机。由电台本身的麦克风 PTT、脚踏开关或 MOX 启动的发射，在 CAT 报告发射状态后也会静音。

source: Stop the panadapter and waterfall while this radio is transmitting. On by default: a transmitter painted across the whole span erases the band behind it. Turn it off to watch the band — or your own signal — through an over, which is worth having with the receiver on a separate antenna. Applies to overs sdroxide keys: one keyed at the radio is received right through, so the picture keeps running whatever this says.
zh-CN: 本电台发射时暂停频谱与瀑布图，默认启用，避免本站发射信号抹掉整个波段画面。使用独立接收天线时，可关闭此项以观察波段或本站信号。只用于由 SDRoxide 启动的发射；由电台本身启动的发射仍连续接收，画面继续更新。

source: Per-mode offsets, for a radio whose I.F. moves with the mode. A mode left empty uses the offset above.
zh-CN: 按模式设置偏移，适用于中频随模式变化的电台。未填写的模式使用上方偏移。

source: Close {} on {where_}? Its configuration stays on that machine; the tab here closes with it, and so does everyone else's.
zh-CN: 关闭 {}（位于 {where_}）？配置保留在该电脑，但此处及其他客户端的标签页都会关闭。

source: One row per box. While the dial is inside a row's band the radio is tuned to dial + offset and that row's transmit rule and drive limit apply; outside every row the radio is on its own bands. Rows are tried top to bottom.
zh-CN: 每台变频收发器占一行。频率读数位于该行的波段内时，电台调谐到“读数 + 偏移”，并应用该行的发射规则和激励上限；在所有行之外，使用电台本身的波段。各行按从上到下的顺序匹配。

source: Off takes this transverter out of the line without losing the row — the band goes back to whatever the radio reaches on its own.
zh-CN: 关闭后，该变频收发器退出工作，但保留本行配置；此波段恢复为电台本身能覆盖的范围。

source: What you call it. Shown in the log when the dial selects it.
zh-CN: 自行命名。频率读数选中此变频收发器时，名称显示在日志中。

source: The radio ends up on dial + offset, so a transverter that brings a band down to an I.F. is negative: 2 m into a 28 MHz I.F. is -116, because 144 - 116 = 28. Drag to trim it a hertz at a time for an oscillator that is slightly off.
zh-CN: 电台实际频率为“读数 + 偏移”。将高频波段变换至中频的变频收发器应使用负偏移：例如将 2 m 变换至 28 MHz 中频时，偏移为 -116 MHz，因为 144 - 116 = 28。拖动可按 1 Hz 微调，以补偿振荡器误差。

source:
Off while converting: receive only — the row is a converter, not a transverter, and nothing is keyed on this band.

Through the same converter: it works both ways, and transmit takes the same offset.
zh-CN:
变频时禁止发射：仅接收，此行作为接收变频器，当前波段不会启动发射。

通过同一变频器：使用双向变频收发器，发射采用相同偏移。

source:
A ceiling on transmit drive while this transverter is selected, as a percentage of full. A transverter's I.F. input takes milliwatts and the drive that is right for the radio's own bands will destroy it, so this is the row's most important field. 100% is no limit.

Your Drive setting is held under this rather than moved, so the number you use on HF comes back when the dial leaves the band.
zh-CN:
选中此变频收发器时的发射激励上限，以满激励的百分比表示。其输入通常只需毫瓦级功率，电台自身波段的激励电平可能损坏它，因此这是本行最重要的设置。100% 表示不限制。

当前激励值只受此上限约束，不会被改写；离开此波段后，原有 HF 激励值恢复。

source: Takes effect on Apply / reconnect, like the converter offset above.
zh-CN: 与上方变频偏移一样，点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。

source: A hard limit the Drive and TUNE controls cannot be taken past, applied after the              band calibration below so nothing can lift the drive back over it. Set it where              the radio makes its rated power and the whole of the Drive control becomes usable              — on a transmitter that modulates its own samples (HPSDR, LimeSDR, PlutoSDR,              HackRF) full drive is the transmitter wide open, which on a high-gain amplifier is              well past what its finals are rated for. Off means the controls reach full drive.
zh-CN: 激励和调谐载波的硬上限，在下方波段校准之后应用，任何校准都不能使激励超过它。请设置在电台达到额定功率的位置，以便使用整个激励调节范围。HPSDR、LimeSDR、PlutoSDR、HackRF 等自行调制采样的发射机，满激励相当于全开，在高增益放大器上可能远超末级额定功率。关闭则允许达到满激励。

source: Per cent of full drive. Key the radio into a dummy load and bring this down                  until the meter reads the power the amplifier is rated for.
zh-CN: 满激励的百分比。请将电台接入假负载，逐步降低此值，直至功率表显示放大器的额定功率。

source: Every amplifier has a different gain on every band, so one Drive setting makes a different power on each. Measure the output on each band, then trim the bands that come out high until they all match: set Drive for the band that needs the most (usually the highest), and take the others down to it. Decibels of output power, applied to voice, digital and TUNE alike. Zero everywhere — the default — changes nothing.
zh-CN: 放大器在各波段的增益不同，同一激励值产生的功率也不同。测量每个波段的输出，降低功率偏高波段的校准值，使其一致：先为所需激励最大的波段（通常是最高频波段）设置激励，再将其他波段降低至同一输出。校准值以输出功率的 dB 表示，同时用于话音、数字模式和调谐载波。默认全部为 0，不改变输出。

source: Back to no calibration: the Drive setting reaches every band whole.
zh-CN: 取消所有校准：各波段均使用完整的激励设置。

source: Applies immediately, and to the band you would transmit on — behind a transverter that is the band on the dial, and the transverter's own drive limit still wins over anything set here.
zh-CN: 立即生效，并以实际发射对应的频率读数波段为准。使用变频收发器时，其自身的激励上限仍优先于这里的设置。

source: Sends an rx_report for each callsign recovered from a RADE End-of-Over frame.
zh-CN: 对每个从 RADE 话轮结束帧恢复出的呼号发送一条 rx_report。

source: Show other reporter stations as spots
zh-CN: 将其他报告台显示为通报

source: Adds them to the panadapter overlay, world map and SPOTS window under the FREEDV filter.
zh-CN: 将其添加至频谱叠加层、世界地图及“通报”窗口的 FREEDV 筛选项下。

source: ⚠ Set your callsign and grid on the General tab. Without both, the connection is view-only: you will see other stations but will not appear yourself.
zh-CN: ⚠ 请在“常规”页设置呼号与网格定位符。缺少任一项时只能查看其他电台，本站不会对外显示。

source: The longwave and shortwave stations labelled on the waterfall. The shortwave schedule is downloaded from eibispace.de for the current broadcasting season and re-downloaded when the season changes.
zh-CN: 标注在瀑布图上的长波与短波广播电台。短波时刻表从 eibispace.de 下载，播出季变化时重新下载。

source: Your own stations and corrections go in this file. sdroxide never writes it, and an entry here replaces a scheduled one with the same name and frequency.
zh-CN: 将自定义电台及更正内容写入此文件。SDRoxide 不会修改它，同名同频率条目会覆盖时刻表中的条目。

source: The broadcast stations labelled on the waterfall come from the list built into this build. Editing them needs the desktop app.
zh-CN: 瀑布图上的广播电台标注来自程序内置列表，编辑需要桌面应用。

source: Ask the service whether these credentials work. Applies the settings above first, and logs nothing: it only reads.
zh-CN: 向服务查询登录信息是否有效。先应用上方设置，仅执行读取，不写入通联记录。

source: Connects whenever enabled. Your station is only shown to others while the radio is in RADE — in any other mode you stay connected but hidden.
zh-CN: 启用后自动连接。仅在 RADE 模式下向其他用户显示本站；在其他模式中保持连接，但隐藏本站。

source: Not yet implemented — FreeDV GUI uses plain ws:// too.
zh-CN: 尚未实现；FreeDV GUI 同样使用普通 ws://。

source: A profile captures the whole working setup — the dials and VFOs, the mode and filters, the gains, drive and antennas, your callsign and message templates, and the per-band registers — and applies it back in one click. The hardware (back end, audio devices, converters) is deliberately left alone: a profile is the way you work the station, not the radio it runs on.
zh-CN: 配置方案保存完整的工作设置，包括频率和 VFO、模式与滤波器、增益、驱动电平和天线、呼号和消息模板，以及各波段记忆，并可一键恢复。硬件后端、音频设备和变频器设置保持不变；配置方案记录操作方式，而非电台硬件。

source: Applies to whatever sdroxide is attached to: dials and VFOs, mode and filters, levels, gains, drive, antennas, the digital identity and the band stacks.
zh-CN: 应用于 SDRoxide 当前连接的电台：频率和 VFO、模式与滤波器、电平、增益、驱动电平、天线、数字通信身份及波段记忆堆栈。

source: No profiles saved yet — name one above and press Save.
zh-CN: 尚未保存配置方案；请在上方输入名称，然后点击“保存”。
配置方案：本站已保存的工作设置

source: Put the station back onto “{name}”: dials, VFOs, mode, filters, gains, drive, antennas, identity and band stacks.
zh-CN: 将本站恢复为“{name}”：频率、VFO、模式、滤波器、增益、驱动电平、天线、身份及波段记忆堆栈。

source: Applied at once, and remembered for the next start.
zh-CN: 立即生效，并保存供下次启动使用。

source: Baud rate is ignored — the port is USB
zh-CN: 此端口使用 USB，忽略波特率设置
修改任一项都会重新打开电台。

source: Crystal/TCXO error in ppm, applied to RX and TX. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 晶体／TCXO 误差，单位为 ppm，同时应用于接收和发射，立即生效。

source: Forget the correction and learn it again.
zh-CN: 清除校正值并重新学习。

source: I/Q mode is switched on at the radio
zh-CN: I/Q 模式已在电台端启用

source: Let the tuner run its own LNA and mixer loops.
zh-CN: 由调谐器自行控制 LNA 和混频器。

未发现 HackRF，请点击“重新扫描”

无电台，请点击“发现设备”

尚未枚举设备，请点击“重新扫描”。
各波段的开集电极输出

source: Powers an active antenna or preamp down the coax.
zh-CN: 通过同轴馈线为有源天线或前置放大器供电。

source: Press Apply to reopen the radio.
zh-CN: 点击“应用”重新打开电台。

source: press Rescan to list the sound cards
zh-CN: 点击“重新扫描”列出声卡
重新连接电台，无需重启。

zh-CN: 使用这些声卡重新打开 CAT 电台，无需重启

source: Reopen the radio with these sound cards — no restart
zh-CN: 使用这些声卡重新打开电台，无需重启
电台控制，仅适用于 FDM-DUO

source:
The radio's separate receiving antenna — RX ANT on the back — switched into the receive path or out of it. Its own setting, the same one as the radio's RX ANT button.

The aerial on the main socket stays on transmit either way: this is an extra input for receiving, a loop or a beverage, not a choice of socket.

Unlike the antenna above, this is *not* remembered here. The radio holds it per band itself, so sdroxide reads it back after every band change and shows what the radio says; ticking this box is the only thing that moves it.
zh-CN:
将后面板 RX ANT 独立接收天线接入或移出接收路径，与电台自身的 RX ANT 按钮相同。

无论此项如何设置，发射均使用主天线接口。此输入用于接收环、Beverage 等独立接收天线，并非切换主天线接口。

与上方主天线选择不同，此项不在 SDRoxide 中保存。电台自行按波段保存状态；每次换波段后，SDRoxide 读取并显示电台状态。只有勾选此项才会改变它。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Waiting for the sound cards on the machine the radio is plugged into.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供声卡列表。

source: The sound card the radio's own audio comes in on — its headphone socket into the computer's line or mic input. Everything on the panadapter and in the decoders arrives here.
zh-CN: 接收电台音频的声卡，即从电台耳机插口接入电脑线路输入或麦克风输入。频谱与解码器的全部数据均来自此处。

source: The sound card that carries the audio the radio must broadcast — the computer's output into the radio's mic socket. The radio keys itself, by VOX, the moment audio arrives here, so this device is silent unless the radio is being transmitted through.
zh-CN: 将电脑输出接入电台麦克风插口，用于发送音频的声卡。音频到达时，电台会通过 VOX 自动启动发射，因此除实际通过此电台发射外，该设备保持静音。

source: This radio has no control cable — it keys itself off VOX, so there is no PTT to command. Transmit is audio into the radio's microphone.
zh-CN: 此电台没有控制线，使用 VOX 自动启动发射，因此没有可发送的 PTT 命令。发射通过向电台麦克风输入音频完成。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: A Protocol 2 board carries several independently tunable receivers (DDCs) on one connection — run this radio on DDC1 and another radio, same address, on DDC2. The transmitter belongs to the DDC1 radio. Protocol 1 boards have DDC1 only.
zh-CN: Protocol 2 板卡可在同一连接上提供多个独立调谐的接收机（DDC）。例如本电台使用 DDC1，另一电台使用相同地址的 DDC2。发射机属于使用 DDC1 的电台。Protocol 1 板卡只有 DDC1。

source: Front-end gain of a Hermes-Lite 2. Takes effect immediately — no reconnect — and is remembered as the level the radio starts at. Too high clips the ADC and the whole band looks distorted; too low and the receiver goes deaf.
zh-CN: Hermes-Lite 2 的前端增益，立即生效，无需重新连接，并保存为下次启动值。过高会使 ADC 削顶，整个波段失真；过低会降低接收灵敏度。

source:
Back the LNA gain off by itself while the board reports its ADC overflowing, and let it back up once it stops.

A Hermes-Lite 2 samples the whole of 0-38 MHz onto one 12-bit converter with no mixer and no preselector in front of it, so a broadcast station a band away can drive it into overflow while the band you are looking at shows nothing wrong at all — the noise floor climbs, everything intermodulates and the decoders stop. The board knows, and this is what acts on it.

Off by default: it moves a control you set. Nothing happens while transmitting.
zh-CN:
板卡报告 ADC 溢出时自动降低 LNA 增益，溢出停止后逐步恢复。

Hermes-Lite 2 将整个 0–38 MHz 直接采样到一个 12 位 ADC，前端没有混频器或预选器。因此，相隔一个波段的强广播台也可能使 ADC 溢出，而当前所看波段并无明显强信号。此时底噪上升、互调增多、解码停止。本功能根据板卡的溢出报告处理。

默认关闭，因为它会改变手动设置的增益。发射期间不动作。

source: Applies on Apply / reconnect. The main window's Gain rail reads the gain the board is actually running, so it follows the loop and you can watch what it does; the slider above is the level the radio starts at, and the loop does not rewrite it.
zh-CN: 点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。主窗口增益滑轨读取板卡实际运行值，会跟随自动控制过程，便于观察。上方滑块仅设置启动增益，自动控制不会改写它。

source: How far the gain moves each time, in dB. One is the step the board's own gain register has.
zh-CN: 每次增益变化的 dB 数。1 dB 为板卡增益寄存器的原生步进。

source:
How often the gain may come down while the converter is overflowing, and how often it may go back up once it has stopped.

The two are deliberately a hundred times apart. Retreat immediately: every millisecond of overflow is a receiver full of intermodulation. Return slowly: whatever caused it — a neighbour keying, a broadcaster coming up at dusk — has usually not gone away, and a loop that recovered as fast as it retreated would spend the evening oscillating across the threshold. 100 ms and 10 s per decibel is what PowerSDR's Auto S-Att and N1GP's HermesIntf have both used.
zh-CN:
ADC 溢出时降低增益的间隔，以及溢出结束后恢复增益的间隔。

两者刻意相差一百倍：溢出每持续一毫秒，接收机就充满互调，因此应立即降低；引起过载的邻近发射机或傍晚增强的广播台通常尚未消失，所以应缓慢恢复，否则增益会反复越过阈值。PowerSDR 的 Auto S-Att 和 N1GP 的 HermesIntf 均使用每 dB 降低 100 ms、恢复 10 s 的设置。

source: The lowest and highest gain the loop may use, in dB. The ceiling is what stops it deciding how sensitive your receiver should be; the floor is where you say that below some point the overload is somebody else's problem and the answer is a filter, not another twenty decibels.
zh-CN: 自动控制可使用的最低及最高增益，单位为 dB。上限限制控制环提高灵敏度的程度；下限表示再降低增益也无法合理解决的过载，此时应增加滤波，而不是继续降低二十 dB。

source: Accessory board on the Hermes-Lite 2's J16 header (or the open-collector outputs of any other openHPSDR board — Protocol 2 included). "N2ADR" picks one relay per band; "Alex / Hermes band code" puts the band number on outputs 1-4, which is what an ANAN's Alex board, a Zeus SDR, a HiQSDR and Quisk expect. "Custom" opens a table below where you state the seven outputs yourself, band by band, on receive and on transmit — for an antenna switch, an amplifier's band decoder or anything else neither preset fits; either preset can be poured into it as a starting point. Leave this at "None" unless something really is fitted: those seven pins are general-purpose open-collector outputs, and operators also wire them to amplifier PTT, antenna relays and transverter switching. Driving them from band data would start operating whatever is connected. Applies on Apply / reconnect.
zh-CN:
Hermes-Lite 2 J16 接头上的扩展板，或其他 openHPSDR 板卡的开集电极输出，包括 Protocol 2。“N2ADR”按波段选择一个继电器；“Alex／Hermes 波段编码”在输出 1–4 上提供波段编号，适用于 ANAN 的 Alex 板、Zeus SDR、HiQSDR 及 Quisk。“自定义”打开下方表格，逐波段设置接收及发射时的七个输出，可用于天线切换器、放大器波段译码或其他用途，也可从任一预设复制后修改。

没有实际扩展硬件时请设为“无”。这些引脚是通用开集电极输出，也可能连接放大器 PTT、天线继电器或变频收发器；按波段驱动会直接操作所连接设备。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。

source: Where an N2ADR HL2IOBoard takes its receive signal from. The board itself is found automatically and needs no setting; this one exists only for operators who have wired its own SMA jacks. Leave it at "Radio's own input" otherwise — selecting the IO board's J9 with nothing connected to it leaves the receiver deaf. Applies on Apply / reconnect. Set to either J9 choice, the inputs also appear on the ANT control and are remembered per band.
zh-CN: N2ADR HL2IOBoard 的接收输入。板卡自动发现，无需设置；此项仅用于连接了其 SMA 接口的用户。其他情况保持“电台自身输入”，否则选择未连接的 J9 会使接收机无信号。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。选择任一 J9 输入后，也会出现在 ANT 控件中，并按波段保存。
使用 Hermes-Lite 2 的板载功放

source: On by default, and what you want unless an external amplifier is driven from the board's low-power RF1 output. With it off the radio still keys — the T/R relay throws and any accessory board follows — but the antenna jack makes no power at all, and the relay is deliberately held in receive. Ignored on boards other than a Hermes-Lite.
zh-CN: 默认启用，除非使用板卡低功率 RF1 输出驱动外置放大器。关闭后仍会启动发射控制，收发继电器及扩展板跟随，但天线接口不输出功率，继电器保持接收状态。非 Hermes-Lite 板卡忽略此项。

source:
Switch the radio itself off, and back on again, over the control link. This is the one true on/off in the program — not sdroxide's own LINK switch, which closes sdroxide's end and leaves the radio running.

For the switch back on to reach anything, the radio's control end has to stay awake while it is off. Over the network that is what Network Control does. Over a serial cable it is the radio's CI-V port, which stays powered from the mains supply on a set that is switched off at the front rather than unplugged; sdroxide sends the wake-up run Icom's own documentation asks for in front of the power-on.

Switching off ends the audio and the meters — there is no radio behind them — and sdroxide keeps the control link open so the switch back on has somewhere to go.
zh-CN:
通过控制连接关闭或开启电台本身。这与 SDRoxide 的连接开关不同；连接开关只断开软件连接，电台继续运行。

若要远程开机，关机后电台的控制端仍需保持运行。网络连接依赖电台的 Network Control 功能；串口连接使用 CI-V，电台从前面板关机而未断开电源时，该接口仍供电。发送开机命令前，SDRoxide 会按 Icom 文档发送唤醒序列。

关机后音频和仪表停止，控制连接仍保持，以便再次发送开机命令。

source: Mirror the board's spectrum about the tuned frequency, on transmit as well as receive. On by default: a Hermes-Lite 2 needs it. Turn it off only if signals show up on the wrong side of the dial and nothing decodes — the giveaway is a waterfall full of convincing traces while SSB lands on the wrong sideband and FT8 returns no decodes at all.
zh-CN: 将板卡频谱关于调谐频率镜像，同时用于接收和发射。默认启用，Hermes-Lite 2 需要此设置。只有所有信号位于读数错误的一侧、无法解码时才关闭；典型表现为瀑布图信号正常，但 SSB 位于相反边带，FT8 完全没有解码结果。

source: How far ahead of real time transmit audio is fed to the board over the network, before sdroxide slows down to match it. The board itself holds no such buffer — this only widens sdroxide's own margin. Raise it on a WiFi link or a VPN, where the low default (right for a direct wired connection) is not enough headroom against jitter and the transmitted audio or PTT stutters; higher costs transmit latency. Takes effect on APPLY, which reconnects to the board.
zh-CN: 通过网络向板卡预先发送发射音频的时间余量，达到此值后 SDRoxide 才减速以匹配实时速率。板卡本身没有这种缓冲，这只增加软件余量。Wi-Fi 或 VPN 抖动导致发射音频或 PTT 断续时，可提高默认值；默认值适合直接有线连接。增大此值也会增加发射延迟。点击“应用”重新连接板卡后生效。

source: Adaptive predistortion: linearise the transmitter from a sample of what it actually emitted, for twenty-odd decibels less intermodulation at the same power. The receiver is the feedback path — the board keeps receiving through an over — so a directional coupler and an attenuator have to put a sample of the amplifier's output into an input the T/R switch does not take away on transmit. On a Hermes-Lite 2 that means the IO board's PureSignal jack, and the receive input above set to match; on a board without one, an ANAN's RX port or an external relay that switches the coupler in for the length of the over. It is this receiver that is read — a board with a second ADC cannot use RX2 as the feedback tap, however its own firmware routes it. With nothing coupled in, the loop never locks and the transmitter is left exactly as it would have been. Applies on Apply / reconnect, and only on the radio that owns the transmitter (DDC1).
zh-CN:
自适应预失真：利用实际发射信号的反馈样本使发射机线性化，在同功率下可将互调降低二十多 dB。接收机作为反馈路径，发射期间继续接收，因此需用定向耦合器和衰减器，将放大器输出样本接入发射时不会被收发开关断开的输入。Hermes-Lite 2 使用 I/O 板的 PureSignal 接口，并选择相应接收输入；其他板卡可使用 ANAN 的 RX 接口，或在整个发射期间将耦合器接入的外部继电器。

反馈读取的是当前接收机。即使固件允许，带第二个 ADC 的板卡也不能用 RX2 作为反馈。未接入反馈时，控制环不会锁定，发射机保持原状。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效，只用于拥有发射机的电台（DDC1）。

source: Correct the transmitter from the receiver's own feedback
zh-CN: 根据接收机自身的反馈校正发射机

source: How finely the amplifier's curve is modelled. More steps follow a sharper knee and take longer to fill in; 32 is a sensible start.
zh-CN: 放大器曲线模型的精细程度。步数越多，越能跟随陡峭拐点，但学习所需时间也越长。建议从 32 开始。

source: How fast the correction follows what the coupler reports. Slow is right — this is averaging an amplifier's curve, which does not move, out of a feedback path that has noise in it.
zh-CN: 校正跟随耦合器反馈变化的速度。通常应选择较慢速度：放大器曲线基本不变，此过程是在含噪反馈中进行平均。

source: Stop adapting and keep the correction where it is — for measuring, and for an operator happy with what it has learned.
zh-CN: 停止自适应，保持当前校正值，适合测量或已满意当前学习结果时使用。

source: A manual IP overrides discovery. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 手动 IP 优先于自动发现。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: One control word per band, as your hardware's documentation states it: bit 0 is output 1, bit 6 is output 7. RX is asserted while receiving on that band and TX while the transmitter is keyed — give them the same value for a filter, and different ones for anything that belongs on one side of the changeover only (an amplifier's key line, a receive preamplifier's bypass). Bands left at 00 assert nothing. Applies on Apply / reconnect.
zh-CN: 按硬件文档为每个波段填写控制字：位 0 对应输出 1，位 6 对应输出 7。接收时使用 RX，发射启动时使用 TX。滤波器可填相同值；放大器启动线、接收前放旁路等只用于某一状态的设备，应填不同值。00 不使任何输出有效。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。

source: Replace the table with what this preset would send on every band, as a starting point to edit. Nothing else in the configuration changes.
zh-CN: 用该预设在各波段的输出值替换表格，作为编辑起点；不改变其他配置。

source: Everywhere outside the amateur bands — short-wave listening, and anything a transverter's dial lands on that no band covers.
zh-CN: 业余波段之外的所有频率，包括短波收听及变频收发器读数落入的未定义波段。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新枚举 USB 总线，不打开任何设备，可在接收期间使用。

source: The RTL2832U's resampler reaches 225–300 kHz and 900 kHz–3.2 MHz, nothing between. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: RTL2832U 重采样器支持 225–300 kHz 及 900 kHz–3.2 MHz，中间区间不可用。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Manual is the setting for measurement and weak-signal digital modes. The tuner and the demodulator have independent automatic loops.
zh-CN: 测量及弱信号数字模式应使用手动增益。调谐器和解调器各有独立自动增益控制环。

source: Applies immediately — no reconnect. The tuner has 29 discrete steps, so the value snaps to the nearest one it can produce. Ignored while the tuner AGC is running.
zh-CN: 立即生效，无需重新连接。调谐器有 29 个离散增益档位，数值会取最接近的可用值。调谐器 AGC 运行时忽略此项。

source: Crystal error in parts per million. Run with RUST_LOG=sdroxide_rtlsdr=debug and the log prints the measured clock error after about 20 seconds — that is the number to enter. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 晶体误差，单位为 ppm。使用 RUST_LOG=sdroxide_rtlsdr=debug 运行时，约 20 秒后日志会输出测得的时钟误差，填写该值即可。立即生效。

source:
The tuner itself starts at 24 MHz. An RTL-SDR Blog V4 upconverts below that in hardware; other dongles reach HF only by sampling the ADC directly, through the V3's HF port. Automatic hands everything below 24 MHz to the ADC and everything above it to the tuner.

Direct sampling covers every HF band, 17 m and 15 m included — they arrive in the ADC's second Nyquist zone, the right way up. Nothing filters the ADC's input, though, so whatever is at 28.8 MHz minus the dial comes with them: 10.7 MHz under 17 m, 7.726 MHz under 15 m.

Switching modes briefly interrupts the stream.
zh-CN:
调谐器最低频率为 24 MHz。RTL-SDR Blog V4 在更低频率自行硬件上变频；其他接收棒需通过 ADC 直接采样才能接收 HF，V3 使用其 HF 端口。“自动”在 24 MHz 以下使用 ADC，以上使用调谐器。

直接采样覆盖全部 HF 波段，包括 17 m 和 15 m，它们位于 ADC 的第二奈奎斯特区，频谱方向正确。但 ADC 输入没有滤波，28.8 MHz 减去读数处的信号也会混叠进来：17 m 对应 10.7 MHz，15 m 对应 7.726 MHz。

切换模式会短暂中断数据流。

source:
Removes the dongle's own DC spike from the centre of the span, and the mirror image every signal leaves reflected about it, by measuring the imbalance in the samples themselves — no calibration, and it applies immediately. The tuner has no offset-tuning mode, so this is the only way to clear the centre.

An AM carrier tuned dead on the dial is at DC too, so it goes with the spike: tune a kilohertz off it, or switch this off.
zh-CN:
通过采样数据测量失衡，消除接收棒频谱中心的直流尖峰及每个信号的镜像，无需校准，立即生效。调谐器没有偏移调谐模式，因此这是清除中心尖峰的唯一方式。

正好调谐在读数中心的 AM 载波同样位于直流处，会被一起消除。请偏离载波约 1 kHz 调谐，或关闭此项。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。此时禁止连接收发机、直流接地的天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，直流电会直接送入馈线。

source: Receive only. The dongle and sample rate take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it.
zh-CN: 仅接收。接收棒和采样率点击“应用”后生效，其余设置在修改时立即生效。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source:
Where rtl_tcp is listening: an address, or an address and port. The port defaults to 1234, which is rtl_tcp's own default.

On the far end, start it as `rtl_tcp -a 0.0.0.0` — bound to 127.0.0.1, which is what it does with no -a, it only accepts connections from that same machine.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
rtl_tcp 的监听地址，可填主机或主机:端口。默认端口为 rtl_tcp 自身的 1234。

远端可用 rtl_tcp -a 0.0.0.0 启动。不指定 -a 时绑定 127.0.0.1，仅接受同一电脑的连接。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Requested of the server, with the same resampler limits as a local dongle — it is the same silicon on the far end.

The figure beside each rate is what it costs on the link: the samples are sent uncompressed, and a rate the network cannot carry makes rtl_tcp drop the connection rather than degrade. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
向服务器请求采样率，限制与本地接收棒相同，因为远端使用相同芯片。

每个采样率旁边显示所需链路流量，采样未经压缩。网络无法承载时，rtl_tcp 会断开连接，而不是降低质量。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Runs on the server's dongle. Manual is the setting for measurement and weak-signal digital modes.
zh-CN: 在服务器的接收棒上运行。测量及弱信号数字模式应使用手动增益。

source: Applies immediately — no reconnect. Sent in tenths of a dB and snapped by the server to a step its tuner has; the protocol has no replies, so what it settled on cannot be read back and this slider keeps showing what was asked for. Ignored while the tuner AGC is running.
zh-CN: 立即生效，无需重新连接。命令以 0.1 dB 为单位发送，服务器取调谐器支持的最接近档位。协议没有响应，无法读回实际值，因此滑块继续显示请求值。调谐器 AGC 运行时忽略此项。

source:
Crystal error of the *server's* dongle, in parts per million — a property of that hardware, so it is set here and not on this machine's dongles. Applies immediately.

The measured clock error the USB interface prints is not available here: over a network what that measurement sees is the buffering, not the crystal, and it is wrong by thousands of ppm. Calibrate the dongle on USB once and carry the number over, or tune a broadcast station of known frequency and adjust until it sits on the dial.
zh-CN:
服务器接收棒的晶体误差，单位为 ppm，这是远端硬件的属性，不影响本机接收棒。立即生效。

网络接口无法使用 USB 接口日志中的时钟测量：网络测得的是缓冲变化，而非晶体误差，可能差数千 ppm。请先通过 USB 校准，再填入所得值，或调谐已知频率的广播台，使其落在正确读数上。

source:
The tuner starts at 24 MHz; below that the far end needs help. A Blog V4 upconverts by itself and Automatic leaves it alone — which is the only thing it can do, since the protocol reports the tuner chip and nothing else, and a V4 is indistinguishable from a plain R828D over the wire.

On a V3 or any other dongle, Automatic switches the server to direct sampling below the tuner's own 24 MHz floor — which covers every HF band, 17 m and 15 m arriving in the ADC's second Nyquist zone with 28.8 MHz minus the dial folded on top. Choose Direct sampling explicitly for a plain R828D that hears nothing on HF. Switching briefly interrupts the stream.
zh-CN:
调谐器最低频率为 24 MHz，更低频率需要额外处理。Blog V4 自行上变频，“自动”不会改变它。协议只报告调谐器芯片，V4 与普通 R828D 无法区分。

V3 或其他接收棒选择“自动”时，会在 24 MHz 以下将服务器切到直接采样，覆盖所有 HF 波段。17 m、15 m 位于 ADC 第二奈奎斯特区，28.8 MHz 减去读数处的信号会混叠其上。普通 R828D 在 HF 无信号时，请明确选择“直接采样”。切换会短暂中断数据流。

source:
Removes the dongle's DC spike and mirror image here, from the samples as they arrive — they are artefacts of the hardware, so they travel over the network with everything else. Applies immediately.

An AM carrier tuned dead on the dial sits at DC too, so it goes with the spike: tune a kilohertz off it, or switch this off.
zh-CN:
在本机对收到的采样消除接收棒的直流尖峰和镜像，这些硬件失真会随数据一起传输。立即生效。

正好调谐在读数中心的 AM 载波也位于直流处，会被一起消除。请偏离载波约 1 kHz 调谐，或关闭此项。

source: Powers a preamp from the far end's dongle. Older servers do not implement the command and ignore it silently — the protocol has no way to say no — so a bias tee that does not come on is not necessarily this end's doing.
zh-CN: 通过远端接收棒给前置放大器供电。旧服务器可能未实现此命令并直接忽略，协议无法返回拒绝信息，因此偏置供电未开启不一定是本机问题。

source: Bias tee is ON, on hardware that is somewhere else. Whatever is on the other end of that feedline — a transceiver, a grounded antenna, a preamp already powered — is not in front of you to check.
zh-CN: 远端硬件的偏置供电已开启。该馈线另一端可能连接收发机、接地天线或已供电的前放，本机无法直接查看，请核实远端接线。

source: An SDRplay server greets exactly like a dongle, so these are shown always rather than when one is detected. Against an ordinary rtl_tcp server they are simply ignored — the protocol has no replies and discards commands it does not know. The Device tab names the server as rsp_tcp once one has identified itself.
