zh-CN: SDRplay 服务器的握手与普通接收棒相同，因此这些选项始终显示。普通 rtl_tcp 服务器会忽略它们，因为协议不响应未知命令。服务器完成身份识别后，“设备”页会显示为 rsp_tcp。

source:
Mirror the panadapter about the tuned frequency, for a rig that carries I and Q the other way round on its sound card. The giveaway is a waterfall full of convincing signals that are all on the wrong side of the dial, with SSB coming out on the opposite sideband — swapping the two cables at the sound card would fix it just as well.

Receive only: transmit hands the radio one real audio signal, which has no sideband to invert.
zh-CN:
将频谱关于调谐频率镜像，用于声卡 I、Q 顺序相反的电台。典型表现是瀑布图中所有信号均位于读数错误的一侧，SSB 也出现在相反边带；交换声卡的两根连接线同样可以修正。

仅影响接收。发射提供单路实音频，不存在需要反转的边带。

source: A step index, not a dB figure: how much each step is worth depends on the RSP model and the band. 0 is the most gain.
zh-CN: 增益档位编号，而非 dB 数值。每档对应的增益取决于 RSP 型号和波段。0 为最大增益。

source: A reduction, so more is less signal. Only obeyed with the RSP's AGC off.
zh-CN: 增益衰减量，数值越大，信号越小。仅在 RSP 的 AGC 关闭时生效。

source: The level the RSP's AGC aims to hold.
zh-CN: RSP 的 AGC 要维持的电平。
仅适用于 RSP2 和 RSPduo。

source: Receive only. The address and sample rate take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it. A dropped connection is retried on its own, so a server that is restarted comes back without touching anything here.
zh-CN: 仅接收。地址和采样率在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。连接中断后会自动重试，因此服务器重启后会自动恢复，无需修改此处设置。

source:
How fast the radio's I/Q sound card is run — and so how much band the panadapter shows, because a quadrature stream spans its whole sample rate: 48 kHz gives ±24 kHz either side of the dial, 192 kHz gives ±96.

The card has the final say. One that cannot do the rate picked here is opened at the nearest it can, and the panadapter is that much narrower — the log says so at startup when it happens.

A faster card is also more work: the machine has proportionally less time to empty it, and one that cannot keep up drops samples. That shows up as audio breaking up while the waterfall still looks perfect, and it too is logged. If you see it, come back down a step.
zh-CN:
电台 I/Q 声卡的采样率决定频谱覆盖宽度：正交数据流的带宽等于采样率，48 kHz 显示读数两侧各 ±24 kHz，192 kHz 则各 ±96 kHz。

声卡决定实际可用速率。无法达到所选值时，会使用最接近的可用值，频谱宽度相应缩小，并在启动日志中记录。

较高采样率需要更多处理能力。电脑来不及读取数据时会丢样，表现为音频断续而瀑布图看似正常，日志也会记录。出现此情况时请降低一级采样率。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source:
Where spyserver is listening: an address, or an address and port. The port defaults to 5555, which is spyserver's own default.

On the far end, check that its config file binds an address other machines can reach — bound to 127.0.0.1 it only accepts connections from that same machine.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
spyserver 的监听地址，可填写地址或地址与端口。默认端口为 5555，与 spyserver 自身默认值一致。

请检查远端配置文件，确保绑定到其他电脑可访问的地址；绑定到 127.0.0.1 时只接受本机连接。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
How wide a slice of the band arrives as I/Q — and so how much of the link this uses. This is the *demodulated* window: it follows the dial, and everything wider than it is the server's FFT in the strip above the panadapter.

Automatic aims at about 96 kHz, which carries every mode here including wide FM and still fits down a cellular uplink. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
以 I/Q 接收的波段切片宽度，也决定链路流量。这是解调窗口，随调谐频率移动；更宽的频谱来自服务器 FFT，显示在全景频谱上方的频谱条中。

自动模式以约 96 kHz 为目标，可容纳本软件包括宽带 FM 在内的所有模式，也适合移动网络上行。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Which stage of the server's own rate ladder to ask for. Every receiver has a different ladder — it is its maximum rate halved stage by stage — so this is stored as the stage rather than as a figure in hertz, and the same setting still means something sensible pointed at a different server.

Automatic aims at about 1 Msps. Press Test connection to see what the stages come to on this server. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
请求服务器采样率阶梯中的哪一级。各接收机阶梯不同，均从最大速率逐级减半，因此保存级数而非 Hz 数值，换用其他服务器后仍有合理含义。

自动模式以约 1 Msps 为目标。点击“测试连接”可查看此服务器各级实际采样率。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Bits per component on the wire, and so what this costs on the link: 16-bit is twice 8-bit, and 32-bit float is four times it for no more information than the receiver's ADC had.

8-bit is what makes a remote receiver work over a domestic uplink and is right for almost everything. A server may override this — some are configured to insist on one format — and says so in the log when it does. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
网络传输中每个分量的位数，也决定链路流量：16 位是 8 位的两倍，32 位浮点是四倍，但不会增加接收机 ADC 原本没有的信息。

8 位使远程接收机能通过家庭上行链路工作，适用于几乎所有情况。服务器可能覆盖此设置，有些服务器强制使用特定格式；覆盖时会在日志中说明。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
The server's gain stage, as an index — not a number of decibels. What each index means belongs to the receiver on the far end and changes with the band, and the protocol never says, so nothing here can turn it into dB without inventing a figure.

The real range is the server's and is only known once connected; an index past it is clamped. Applies immediately — no reconnect.
zh-CN:
服务器增益级的索引，不是分贝数。各索引的含义取决于远端接收机及波段，协议并未提供对应关系，因此无法准确换算成 dB。

实际范围由服务器决定，连接后才能得知；超出范围的索引会被限制到有效值。立即生效，无需重新连接。

source:
How far the server scales its samples up before quantising them for the wire. Automatic watches what actually arrives and holds the peak at half of full scale, which is the only thing that can be right on both a dead band and a crowded one — the two are thirty decibels apart and no fixed figure serves both.

It matters only at 8 bits, where a signal far below full scale loses its lower bits to the quantiser and one above it is clipped flat. Wider formats have room to spare and get the figure every other client computes, from the gain index and the decimation stage. Applies immediately.
zh-CN:
服务器在对样本进行网络传输量化前，将幅度放大的程度。自动模式监测实际到达的样本，将峰值维持在满量程的一半。安静波段与拥挤波段相差约三十 dB，固定值无法兼顾两者。

此项仅在 8 位时有明显影响：远低于满量程的信号会在量化时丢失低位，超过满量程则会削顶。更高位数的格式有充足余量，使用其他客户端同样根据增益索引与抽取级计算的值。立即生效。

source:
The server's own FFT of the whole band, drawn in the strip above the panadapter. In this interface it is the only band view there is — the panadapter itself is only as wide as the I/Q being received.

Switching it off leaves a receiver with no way to see anything it is not already tuned to. Applies immediately, with a short break in the audio while the server changes what it is sending.
zh-CN:
服务器自身的全波段 FFT，显示在全景频谱上方的频谱条中。在此接口上，这是唯一的波段全景视图；下方全景频谱只显示收到的 I/Q 频宽。

关闭后将无法查看接收机当前调谐范围外的信号。立即生效，服务器切换发送内容时音频会短暂中断。

source:
Ask the server for a low-rate FFT of the whole band as well as the I/Q, and draw it in the strip above the panadapter.

It costs almost nothing — a couple of kilobytes a frame, a dozen or so times a second — and it shows the whole receiver rather than the slice being demodulated. Worth switching off only on a link where every byte counts. Applies immediately, with a short break in the audio.
zh-CN:
除 I/Q 外，还请求服务器发送低速率全波段 FFT，并显示在全景频谱上方的频谱条中。

流量很小，每帧几 kB、每秒约十几帧，可查看整个接收机频谱，而非仅当前解调切片。只有需要节省每个字节的链路才建议关闭。立即生效，音频会短暂中断。

source: How much of the receiver the strip covers. The whole band is the widest view there is; narrowing it puts the same number of bins across less spectrum, which is finer detail over a smaller stretch.
zh-CN: 频谱条覆盖的接收机频宽。整个波段提供最宽视野；缩小范围会将相同数量的频点分布在更窄的频谱上，以较小范围换取更精细的细节。

source:
The server quantises its FFT into this window before sending it, one byte a bin — so these decide how finely the strip is measured, not just how it is drawn. The floor and ceiling the strip is *displayed* with are set by the engine's own auto-levelling and are a separate thing.

The default 150 dB is the whole protocol range and needs no attention. Narrowing it around the noise floor buys resolution on a receiver whose signals all sit in a small part of the scale. Applies immediately.
zh-CN:
服务器发送 FFT 前，会在此范围内将每个频点量化为一个字节，因此这些设置决定频谱条的测量精细程度，而不仅是显示方式。频谱条显示的上下限由引擎自身的自动电平控制另行设置。

默认 150 dB 覆盖整个协议范围，通常无需调整。若接收机信号集中在量程的一小部分，可在底噪附近缩窄范围，提高分辨率。立即生效。

source:
How far the radio's I/Q output is centred above its own dial, for a rig whose receive I.F. has been moved off zero — on an Elecraft, MENU:RX SHFT set to 8.0 instead of NOR, which takes the dial off the mixer's DC spike (and stops a strong nearby SSB/AM station being AM-detected).

Not a converter: the radio still displays and transmits on the real frequency, and nothing here is ever sent to it. This only says where the samples on the sound card sit, and the stream is shifted back onto the dial as it arrives.

Leave at 0 unless you have turned such a menu entry on. If signals land twice the offset away, the sign is the other way round.
zh-CN:
电台 I/Q 输出中心相对频率读数的正偏移，用于接收中频偏离零的电台。例如 Elecraft 的 MENU:RX SHFT 设为 8.0，而非 NOR，可使调谐频率离开混频器直流尖峰，并减少附近强 SSB／AM 信号造成的检波干扰。

这不是变频器设置：电台仍显示并发射在实际频率，这里不会向电台发送任何命令。此项只描述声卡采样的中心位置，数据到达时会移回读数中心。

未启用电台相应菜单时保持 0。若信号偏移量变为两倍，说明符号方向相反。

source: Remove the DC spike and the mirror image in DSP, on this side. Whether the receiver on the far end needs it depends on what it is — an Airspy HF+ does not, an RTL-SDR does — and the protocol does not say which it is talking to. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 在本机 DSP 中去除直流尖峰和镜像。远端是否需要校正取决于接收机型号：Airspy HF+ 不需要，RTL-SDR 需要，而协议不会告知接收机类型。立即生效。

source: Connect, read what the server says about its receiver, and disconnect again — without starting a stream, so it is safe to press against a server somebody else is using.
zh-CN: 连接、读取服务器提供的接收机信息，然后断开；不会启动数据流，因此可以在其他人正在使用的服务器上安全执行。

source: Receive only. The panadapter is the narrow I/Q window, which follows the dial; the band view is the server's FFT in the strip above it. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 仅接收。全景频谱显示随调谐频率移动的窄带 I/Q 窗口；上方频谱条显示服务器 FFT 的波段全景。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: Receive only. Wideband I/Q, the same as any local SDR. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 仅接收。与本地 SDR 相同，接收宽带 I/Q。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source:
Where the receiver serves its web page: an address, or an address and port. The port defaults to 8073, which is a KiwiSDR's own.

Note that a receiver reached through the project's proxy (something.proxy.kiwisdr.com — nearly half the public ones) answers on port 80 instead, so give it explicitly. Picking a receiver from "Public SDRs" fills this in correctly.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
接收机网页的地址，可填写地址或地址与端口。默认端口为 KiwiSDR 自身使用的 8073。

通过项目代理访问的接收机（something.proxy.kiwisdr.com，接近半数公共接收机）使用端口 80，需明确填写。从“公共 SDR”选择接收机会正确填写此项。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
The receiver's *user* password, where its operator has set one. Blank on almost every public receiver. Not the admin password.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
接收机管理员设置的用户密码。几乎所有公共接收机都可留空。此处不是管理员密码。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
The name this connection shows up under, which the receiver's owner and everybody else listening to it can see.

Left blank it is your station callsign, which is the network's own convention — some operators do block clients that will not identify. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
此连接显示的用户名，接收机所有者和其他收听者均可看到。

留空时使用你的电台呼号，这是该网络的惯例；部分管理员会阻止不提供身份信息的客户端。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Ask the receiver for its own waterfall as well as its I/Q, and draw it in the strip above the panadapter.

Worth having: the I/Q is only about 12 kHz wide, so without this there is nothing to tune *by*. It is a second connection carrying roughly 20 kB/s at full speed, against the I/Q's 44 kB/s.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
除 I/Q 外，还请求接收机自身的瀑布图，并显示在全景频谱上方的频谱条中。

建议启用：I/Q 频宽只有约 12 kHz，缺少此图时没有宽带视野辅助调谐。它使用第二条连接，最高速度约 20 kB/s，I/Q 则约 44 kB/s。

点击“应用”后生效。
显示接收机的 0–30 MHz 瀑布图

source:
How often the receiver sends a waterfall row, 1 (slowest) to 4. The only setting here that changes what the link costs while running, so turn it down on a metered connection.

Applies immediately.
zh-CN:
接收机发送瀑布图行的频率，范围为 1（最慢）到 4。此处只有这项设置能在运行中改变链路流量，按流量计费的连接可调低。

立即生效。

source:
How much band the receiver's waterfall covers. Its full 0-30 MHz at the left of the slider, halving with each step to the right.

The waterfall is always 1024 bins wide however wide the window is, so this is really a resolution control: the whole band is 29 kHz to a bin, which is a band *map* rather than a picture of anything, while a few hundred kilohertz shows individual stations in a broadcast band. Zoomed in, the window follows your dial.

The whole band is the default and is what makes the strip a thing to tune by; the panadapter below it is the ~12 kHz of I/Q. Applies immediately.
zh-CN:
接收机瀑布图覆盖的频宽。滑块最左端为完整的 0–30 MHz，每向右一步频宽减半。

无论窗口频宽多少，瀑布图始终为 1024 个频点，因此这实际是分辨率设置：整个波段每点约 29 kHz，只能作为波段分布图；缩窄到几百 kHz 后才能看到广播波段中的各个电台。放大后窗口会跟随调谐频率。

默认显示整个波段，用于辅助调谐；下方全景频谱显示约 12 kHz 的 I/Q。立即生效。

source:
The *receiver's* AGC, which is on the far side of the link and ahead of the I/Q — so it acts before anything sdroxide does.

On by default, unlike every local SDR here, because the measured alternative was worse: on a live receiver the manual gain was not monotonic across its range and its top end clipped the I/Q at full scale, while the AGC held about -24 dBFS with 7 dB of headroom.

It does mean the sample amplitude is not a signal level, which is why the S-meter is read from the receiver's own figure instead. Applies immediately.
zh-CN:
接收机自身的 AGC，在链路远端、I/Q 之前起作用，因此早于 sdroxide 的所有处理。

与本软件中的本地 SDR 不同，此处默认启用，因为实测手动增益更差：实际接收机的手动增益在整个范围内并非单调变化，最高端会使 I/Q 满量程削顶，而 AGC 将电平维持在约 -24 dBFS，并留有 7 dB 余量。

因此样本幅度不能直接表示信号电平，S 表改为读取接收机自身报告的值。立即生效。

source: Fixed gain when the receiver's AGC is off, on its own 0-90 scale. Not decibels of anything stated — the protocol calls it manGain and says no more, and it was measured not to be monotonic, so treat it as a dial to find a good spot on rather than a calibration. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 接收机 AGC 关闭时的固定增益，使用自身的 0–90 刻度。协议只称其为 manGain，未说明对应的分贝量，实测也并非单调变化，因此应将它作为寻找合适接收效果的旋钮，而非校准值。立即生效。

source: Read the receiver's status page: what it is, what it covers, how many channels are free, and whether its operator allows connections from apps other than a browser. Takes none of its channels.
zh-CN: 读取接收机状态页，查看型号、覆盖范围、空闲通道数，以及管理员是否允许浏览器以外的应用连接。不会占用接收通道。

source:
Cancel the mirror image of every signal, and the DC spike in the middle of the waterfall.

A radio's I/Q output is two analogue paths that are never quite equal in gain nor exactly 90° apart, and what that leaves is a copy of every signal reflected about the tuned frequency, usually 30-40 dB down — strong enough to look like a station that is not there, and to be decoded as one. Radios with front-panel balance trimmers are adjusting exactly this; here it is measured off the received noise and needs no setting.

Leave it on. Turn it off if you are listening to AM tuned dead on the carrier — the carrier is DC, so it goes with the spike — or to check whether a signal is real by watching whether it survives.
zh-CN:
消除每个信号的镜像，以及瀑布图中心的直流尖峰。

电台的 I/Q 模拟路径难以做到增益完全相同、相位准确相差 90°，因此每个信号通常会在调谐频率另一侧产生低 30–40 dB 的镜像，可能被误认为真实电台并解码。电台前面板的平衡微调即用于校正此误差；这里根据接收噪声自动测量，无需手动设置。

通常应保持启用。若 AM 正好调谐在载波上，载波位于直流处，会随尖峰一起被消除，此时可关闭；也可通过开关此项判断信号是否为镜像。

source: Receive only — this is somebody else's antenna. The panadapter is the ~12 kHz the receiver sends as I/Q, which follows the dial; the band view above it is its own waterfall, and tuning across it retunes the receiver. About {:.0} kB/s while connected. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 仅接收，使用他人的天线。全景频谱显示接收机发送的约 12 kHz I/Q，跟随调谐频率；上方宽带视图为接收机自身瀑布图，在图上调谐会改变接收机频率。连接时约 {:.0} kB/s。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: A rig with two receivers (SunSDR2DX) can serve two radio tabs from one connection — run this radio on RX1 and another on RX2. The transmitter belongs to the RX1 radio.
zh-CN: 双接收机电台（如 SunSDR2DX）可通过同一连接供两个电台标签页使用：此电台使用 RX1，另一电台使用 RX2。发射机属于使用 RX1 的电台。

source: How long the rig's IQ takes to arrive on a new centre after sdroxide moves it. It is the rig's own DSP pipeline, not the network — a server on this machine has one too — and while the panadapter is dragged fully zoomed out, being wrong by this much moves the newest waterfall rows sideways of the history by the error times the speed of the drag. Too high displaces them exactly as far as too low, the other way. Measure it with `cargo run --release -p sdroxide-tci --example retune_latency`; the default is a SunSDR2DX on ExpertSDR3 at 192 kHz.
zh-CN: sdroxide 改变中心频率后，电台新中心频率的 IQ 数据到达所需时间。延迟来自电台自身的 DSP 流水线，而非网络，即使服务器在本机也存在。完全缩小全景频谱并拖动时，延迟设置误差会使最新瀑布图行相对历史图像横向偏移，偏移量为时间误差乘以拖动速度。设置过高与过低造成同样大小、相反方向的偏移。可使用 `cargo run --release -p sdroxide-tci --example retune_latency` 测量；默认值来自运行 ExpertSDR3、192 kHz 采样率的 SunSDR2DX。

source: Wideband IQ receive, audio transmit. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 宽带 IQ 接收、音频发射。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: The address shown on the radio under SET > Network. Network Control has to be on there, and the radio needs a network user name and password set.
zh-CN: 电台 SET > Network 中显示的地址。需在电台上开启 Network Control，并设置网络用户名和密码。

source: 50001 unless it has been changed on the radio.
zh-CN: 默认 50001，除非已在电台上更改。

source: Stored in the clear in radio.json. The protocol obfuscates it reversibly on the wire, so nothing here would make it a secret.
zh-CN: 以明文保存在 radio.json 中。协议只在传输时进行可逆混淆，因此此设置无法使其成为加密秘密。

source: AF: the radio demodulates and sdroxide shows the audio band. 12 kHz IF: the radio sends its DRM intermediate frequency instead and sdroxide demodulates, which brings its own filters, noise reduction and decoders to bear over about ±12 kHz. Either way the wide waterfall is the radio's own scope — no Icom outputs I/Q.
zh-CN: AF：由电台解调，sdroxide 显示音频频带。12 kHz IF：电台发送 DRM 中频，由 sdroxide 解调，可在约 ±12 kHz 范围内使用本软件的滤波器、降噪和解码器。两种方式的宽带瀑布图均来自电台自身的频谱示波器；Icom 电台不输出 I/Q。

source:
Widen the hole taken out of the middle of the span, for a radio whose centre spike is broader than the offset underneath it.

0 leaves the ordinary blocker, which is a few tens of hertz wide and removes the offset without touching anything else. Wind it up and the bottom of the span goes with it: a first-order high-pass, 3 dB down at the figure set here and further in below it.

It is centred where the radio's I/Q is centred, which is the dial unless the offset above has moved it — so anything tuned there goes too. A CW note at 600 Hz is inside a 600 Hz setting.
zh-CN:
扩大频谱中心的抑制范围，用于中心尖峰比普通直流偏移更宽的电台。

0 使用普通直流阻断，宽度约几十 Hz，仅消除偏移。增大此值会同时衰减低频部分：一阶高通在所设频率处衰减 3 dB，以下频率衰减更多。

中心位置为电台 I/Q 中心；未设置上方偏移时即为频率读数。因此，位于该处的有效信号也会受影响，例如 600 Hz 的 CW 音调位于 600 Hz 的设置范围内。

source: A 12 kHz IF needs the 48000 Hz stream — at this rate the radio's demodulated audio is used instead.
zh-CN: 12 kHz IF 需要 48000 Hz 数据流；在当前采样率下改用电台解调后的音频。

source: Which way round the radio's 12 kHz IF runs. "Automatic" uses what the model is known to do — mirrored on an IC-7760, normal on every other Icom. Set it by hand if SSB comes out on the wrong sideband: the giveaway is having to select USB where the band runs LSB while the radio's own mode display agrees with sdroxide throughout.
zh-CN: 电台 12 kHz IF 的频谱方向。“自动”使用已知型号的设置：IC-7760 为镜像，其他 Icom 为正常。若 SSB 出现在错误边带，请手动设置；典型表现是波段通常使用 LSB，却需选择 USB 才能收听，而电台自身的模式显示始终与 sdroxide 一致。

source: Width of the audio-band panadapter, as for a CAT rig. Used in the digital modes and where the radio's scope is off; otherwise the panadapter is the scope, and Scope span sets its width.
zh-CN: 音频频带全景频谱的宽度，与 CAT 电台相同。用于数字模式及电台频谱示波器关闭时；其他情况下全景频谱来自电台示波器，由“示波器频宽”设置其宽度。

source: How the CW panel's keyer transmits. "Rig keyer" puts the radio in CW and hands it the text to send with its own keyer (CI-V 0x17). "Sound card" sends the keyed sidetone over the LAN as audio instead (MCW), a tone at dial + pitch — and because a rig in CW would ignore its modulator input, selecting CW then keeps the radio in plain USB, the same mode the digital modes ride.
zh-CN: CW 面板电键器的发射方式。“电台电键器”将电台置于 CW 模式，并通过 CI-V 0x17 发送文本，由电台自身电键器发射。“声卡”则通过局域网发送带键控的侧音音频（MCW），信号位于调谐频率加音调频率处。CW 模式的电台会忽略调制器输入，因此选择此方式后，软件选择 CW 时电台仍保持普通 USB，与数字模式使用的模式相同。

source: How much audio the radio holds before modulating. More survives a worse network, at the cost of transmit latency.
zh-CN: 电台在调制前缓冲的音频量。增加缓冲可适应较差的网络，但会提高发射延迟。
显示电台的频谱示波器

source: Streams the radio's own 475-bin sweep. On AF it is the panadapter — the audio the radio sends is what came through its filter, not a picture of the band — and on the 12 kHz IF it is the full-band waterfall above one. Either way it is the radio's picture, not sdroxide's DSP: there is no I/Q to compute one from.
zh-CN: 传输电台自身的 475 点频谱扫描。在 AF 模式下作为全景频谱，因为电台发送的音频已通过其滤波器，不能代表整个波段；在 12 kHz IF 模式下则作为全景频谱上方的宽带瀑布图。两者均是电台的图像，而非 sdroxide DSP 计算的结果，因为没有可用于计算的 I/Q。

source: How wide to sweep it. This is the only wide view an Icom has, and the radio keeps whatever span was last chosen on its own screen — often a few kHz, which is why the strip can come up no wider than the panadapter under it. Setting a span here also puts the scope into centre mode, so it follows the dial. It changes the radio's own display too; "As set on the radio" leaves it alone.
zh-CN: 频谱扫描宽度。这是 Icom 唯一的宽带视图，电台会保留自身屏幕上最后选择的频宽，常常只有几 kHz，因此频谱条可能与下方全景频谱一样窄。在此设置频宽也会将示波器改为中心模式，使其跟随调谐频率，同时改变电台自身显示。“按电台设置”则不更改。

source: Transmit audio is only heard when the radio's MOD input is set to LAN. sdroxide can write that on a model whose menu numbering it knows; on any other it says so and leaves the menu alone. It is a loan: whatever the radio held there is read first and put back when the session ends, so a rig used on its own afterwards still hears its own microphone.
zh-CN: 只有电台 MOD 输入设为 LAN 时才能传输发射音频。sdroxide 可为已知菜单编号的型号设置此项；其他型号会给出提示并保持菜单不变。此设置仅临时借用：先读取原值，在会话结束时恢复，保证之后单独使用电台时仍能使用原有麦克风。

source: Copies this radio's last session — its handshake and CI-V trace — to the clipboard, for a bug report. This radio's, not the station's: with two Icoms on the LAN each tab answers about its own address.
zh-CN: 将此电台上次会话的握手和 CI-V 跟踪复制到剪贴板，用于问题报告。报告属于当前电台而非整个台站：局域网内有两台 Icom 时，各标签页报告各自地址的会话。

source: Control, audio and the radio's own scope over one network connection — no serial cable and no sound card. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 通过一个网络连接传输控制、音频和电台自身频谱，无需串口线或声卡。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: That was only a check — press Apply / reconnect below to start using this radio.
zh-CN: 刚才仅为连接检查；点击下方“应用／重新连接”才会开始使用此电台。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Asks the network for IIO devices, and also tries 192.168.2.1 directly — a Pluto on the end of a USB cable is often unreachable by multicast even though the address works.
zh-CN: 在网络中查找 IIO 设备，并直接尝试连接 192.168.2.1。通过 USB 线连接的 Pluto 常常无法通过组播发现，但仍可直接通过地址访问。

source: Overrides the selection above. The USB cable presents the Pluto as a network adapter, not a serial port, so this is an IP address even when the radio is on your desk.
zh-CN: 覆盖上方选择。USB 连接将 Pluto 呈现为网络适配器，而非串口，因此即使电台就在桌上，也需填写 IP 地址。

source: A Pluto+ or a revision-C Pluto unlocked to 2R2T can serve two radio tabs from one box — this radio on RX1 and another on RX2, each on its own antenna. The two chains share the one oscillator, so retuning either radio moves both; what RX2 buys is a second antenna on the same spectrum (diversity), not a second band. The transmitter belongs to the RX1 radio. A stock 1R1T Pluto refuses RX2 when it connects.
zh-CN: Pluto+ 或解锁为 2R2T 的 C 版 Pluto 可供两个电台标签页使用：此电台使用 RX1，另一电台使用 RX2，各自连接天线。两条通道共用振荡器，调整任一电台频率都会同时移动两者；RX2 提供的是同一频谱上的第二副天线（分集），而非第二个波段。发射机属于 RX1 电台。原装 1R1T Pluto 会在连接时拒绝 RX2。

source: Width of the spectrum sdroxide receives. The AD9361 reaches 61.44 Msps; the USB network link does not, which is what this list is scaled to. The lowest rates need a filter configuration loaded into the AD9361, which sdroxide does not do — a stock Pluto runs them at about 2.084 Msps instead and says so when it connects. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: sdroxide 接收的频谱宽度。AD9361 可达 61.44 Msps，但 USB 网络链路无法承载，本列表据此限制。最低的几档采样率需要向 AD9361 加载滤波器配置，sdroxide 不执行此操作；原装 Pluto 会改为约 2.084 Msps，并在连接时提示。点击“应用”后生效。

source: The AD9361's baseband filter. Leave at 0 for automatic, which opens it to nine tenths of the sample rate — wide on purpose, because the receiver parks its oscillator a quarter of a span off the dial to keep signals clear of the DC spike, and a narrow filter would cut off exactly the part it moved them to. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: AD9361 的基带滤波器。保持 0 使用自动设置，带宽为采样率的十分之九。较宽的设置是有意的：接收机将振荡器置于距调谐频率四分之一频宽处，以避开直流尖峰；窄滤波器会恰好切掉移至该位置的信号。点击“应用”后生效。

source: The AD9361 has four modes, not an on/off switch. Slow attack suits SSB and CW; fast attack suits bursty signals; manual is the setting for measurement and weak-signal digital modes. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: AD9361 有四种模式，并非简单开关。慢启动适合 SSB 和 CW；快启动适合突发信号；手动适用于测量及弱信号数字模式。立即生效。

source: Applies immediately — no reconnect. Ignored unless the AGC is set to manual, which is the AD9361's own behaviour, not sdroxide's.
zh-CN: 立即生效，无需重新连接。仅在 AGC 为手动模式时有效，这是 AD9361 自身的行为。

source: Negative because the AD9361 expresses transmit level as attenuation: 0 dB is full output. Applies immediately. The transmitter is set to its quietest before this value is applied on connect, so nothing the previous program left behind can be live.
zh-CN: AD9361 以衰减表示发射电平，因此数值为负，0 dB 表示最大输出。立即生效。连接时先将发射机设为最低输出，再应用此值，避免沿用上一程序留下的输出电平。

source: Reference error in parts per million. Run with RUST_LOG=sdroxide_pluto=debug and the log prints the measured clock error after about 20 seconds — that is the number to enter. Applied by sdroxide, not written to the radio's own persistent trim. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 参考时钟误差，单位为百万分之一（ppm）。使用 RUST_LOG=sdroxide_pluto=debug 运行，约 20 秒后日志会输出实测时钟误差，请填入该值。由 sdroxide 应用，不写入电台的持久校准设置。立即生效。

source:
Leave this off on a Pluto reached over its USB cable. That link cannot carry a megasample per second in both directions at once, and an over that starves the transmit buffer goes out chopped — so by default receive stops for the length of an over.

Turn it on for a board on real Ethernet (a LibreSDR, a Pluto on a gigabit adapter), where there is room for both: you then hear the receiver through your own transmission, which is how a QO-100 station listens to its own downlink.

An over needs twice the sample rate's worth of link — 2.5 Msps is 10 MB/s each way — so lower the rate if the log starts saying the link is not carrying it. The panadapter still shows the transmitted signal during an over; it is the audio that keeps coming.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
通过 USB 线连接 Pluto 时保持关闭。该链路无法同时在两个方向承载每秒百万次采样；发射缓冲区供数不足会使信号断续，因此默认在每次发射期间停止接收。

通过真正的以太网连接（如 LibreSDR、使用千兆适配器的 Pluto）且链路足够时可启用。此时发射期间仍能听到接收音频，可用于 QO-100 电台监听自身下行。

同时收发需要两个方向各承载采样率对应的流量，2.5 Msps 时每个方向为 10 MB/s；若日志提示链路承载不足，请降低采样率。发射期间全景频谱仍显示发射信号，此设置让接收音频继续播放。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Whether the AD9361 runs both directions at once (FDD, which is how a Pluto boots and what sdroxide has always left it in) or one at a time (TDD).

Leave this on FDD unless you want the PTT pins below — TDD is what those key from, and it rules out Full duplex above. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
AD9361 同时运行两个方向（FDD，Pluto 启动时及 sdroxide 以往使用的模式），或每次只运行一个方向（TDD）。

除非需要下方 PTT 引脚，否则保持 FDD。引脚键控依赖 TDD，使用后无法启用上方的全双工。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
The Pluto's four GPO test points can key an external power amplifier, LNA or transmit-receive switch by themselves. Pick a pair and one pin is high the whole time the radio receives, the other the whole time it transmits — no host software in the loop and no serial PTT line to wire.

This puts the radio in TDD whatever the Duplex row says, because the pins follow the AD9361's enable lines and in FDD both of those are asserted the entire session. Full duplex goes off with it, so leave both at their defaults if you work satellites and need to hear your own downlink.

Analog Devices' own note puts an external LNA on GPO0/GPO1, so use GPO2/GPO3 if your board is wired that way. The pins are about 1.3 V at a few milliamps: drive a transistor or an opto-isolator with them, never a relay coil.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
Pluto 的四个 GPO 测试点可直接键控外部功放、LNA 或收发切换器。选择一对后，一个引脚在整个接收期间为高电平，另一个在整个发射期间为高电平，无需主机软件参与或串口 PTT 线。

启用后无论“双工”行如何设置，电台都会使用 TDD：这些引脚跟随 AD9361 的使能信号，而 FDD 中两个使能信号在整个会话中均有效。同时会关闭全双工，因此卫星操作需要监听自身下行时，请将两项均保持默认。

Analog Devices 的说明将外部 LNA 接在 GPO0/GPO1；若你的板卡如此接线，请使用 GPO2/GPO3。引脚约为 1.3 V、数 mA，应通过晶体管或光耦驱动，切勿直接连接继电器线圈。

点击“应用”后生效。

source:
How much the device holds before each transfer, in complex samples. The default of 32768 is about 16 ms at 2 Msps: long enough that the per-transfer round trip is not the bottleneck, short enough that a retune is not visibly late.

Halve it if the log reports the receive socket being replaced. A marginal link — a Pluto reached over its USB cable at a high sample rate is the usual one — stalls part-way through a transfer, and a smaller transfer is both less likely to be caught mid-flight and quicker to make good afterwards. Raise it to trade retune latency for fewer round trips.

Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
每次传输前设备缓冲的复数样本数量。默认 32768，在 2 Msps 时约为 16 ms：足以避免每次传输的往返延迟成为瓶颈，同时让重新调谐不出现明显滞后。

若日志报告接收套接字被替换，可将此值减半。高采样率下通过 USB 线连接 Pluto 等较弱链路，可能在传输中途停滞；较小的传输块更不易中途受阻，恢复也更快。增大则以调谐延迟换取更少的往返次数。

点击“应用”后生效。

source: The AD9361's rf_port_select. A stock Pluto wires one of each, so leave these empty unless you have a board that does not. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: AD9361 的 rf_port_select。原装 Pluto 的收发各只连接一个端口，除非板卡接线不同，否则请留空。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Opens the radio, reads what it says about itself, and reports the tuning range this particular board has. Does not start a stream.
zh-CN: 打开电台，读取其自身信息，并报告此板卡的调谐范围。不会启动数据流。

source: Copies the last session's protocol trace to the clipboard, for a bug report.
zh-CN: 将上次会话的协议跟踪复制到剪贴板，用于问题报告。

source: Wideband IQ receive and transmit. Half duplex — receive stops for the length of an over, because the USB network link will not carry both at once. No SoapySDR and no libiio needed.
zh-CN: 宽带 IQ 接收与发射。半双工：USB 网络链路无法同时承载收发，因此每次发射期间停止接收。无需 SoapySDR 或 libiio。

source: Not yet verified against real hardware. If it misbehaves, please send the diagnostic report — it contains every command exchanged with the radio, and the first bytes of the sample stream.
zh-CN: 尚未经真实硬件验证。如工作异常，请提供诊断报告，其中包含与电台交换的全部命令及样本流最初的字节。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: A FlexRadio announces itself on the local network about once a second. A radio reached through a router or a VPN never broadcasts to you — enter its address below instead.
zh-CN: FlexRadio 约每秒在局域网广播一次自身信息。通过路由器或 VPN 访问的电台无法将广播送达此处，请改为在下方填写地址。

source: Another GUI client has this radio and multiFLEX is disabled. Disconnect that client, or enable multiFLEX on the radio.
zh-CN: 另一图形客户端已占用此电台，且 multiFLEX 已关闭。请断开该客户端，或在电台上启用 multiFLEX。

source: Overrides the selection above. Use this for a radio on another subnet, behind a VPN, or on a non-standard port.
zh-CN: 覆盖上方选择。电台位于其他子网、通过 VPN 访问或使用非标准端口时，请使用此项。

source: Width of the spectrum sdroxide receives. 192 kHz is the radio's maximum for a DAX IQ stream, and so the widest span this interface can show.
zh-CN: sdroxide 接收的频谱宽度。电台 DAX IQ 流的上限为 192 kHz，也是此接口能显示的最大频宽。

source: 192 kHz is the widest DAX IQ stream a FLEX will send, and the radio ties the panadapter's span to it — so that is the whole span, and no setting here widens it.
zh-CN: FLEX 的 DAX IQ 流最大为 192 kHz，电台全景频谱的频宽与其绑定。这就是完整可用频宽，此处无法进一步扩大。

source: The radio has four. Change this only if something else on the network is already using channel 1 — the radio refuses a channel twice over.
zh-CN: 电台提供四个通道。只有网络中的其他应用已占用通道 1 时才需更改；电台不允许重复占用同一通道。

source: Shown against this session in the radio's client list. The radio also remembers a client by it, so renaming makes the radio treat sdroxide as a new one.
zh-CN: 显示在电台客户端列表中的会话名称。电台也以此识别客户端，因此更名后会将 sdroxide 当作新客户端。

source: The identity the radio restores this session's slices and panadapters to. Left empty it is derived from the station name — stable, but the same on every sdroxide that kept the default name, and a radio settles a duplicate by throwing the earlier client off. sdroxide spots that on the wire and falls back to a one-session identity, which costs the restore; put a UUID of your own here to keep it.
zh-CN: 电台用于恢复此会话接收切片与全景频谱的身份标识。留空时根据台站名称生成，虽然稳定，但保留默认名称的所有 sdroxide 实例都会相同；电台遇到重复身份会断开先连接的客户端。sdroxide 检测到此情况后会退回仅当前会话有效的身份，从而失去恢复能力。请在此填写自己的 UUID 以保留恢复功能。

source:
Mirror the radio's I/Q about the centre of the panadapter. Off by default, which is how a FLEX-6600 was verified.

Try it if receive audio is unintelligible on USB *and* on LSB and nothing decodes, while the waterfall looks entirely convincing — that is what a mirrored stream looks like, and it is the one fault with no other symptom (issue #368). If it is not that, turning this on makes it obvious rather than subtle. Applies on Apply / reconnect.
zh-CN:
将电台 I/Q 关于全景频谱中心镜像。默认关闭，此设置已在 FLEX-6600 上验证。

若 USB 和 LSB 接收音频都无法听懂，所有信号均无法解码，而瀑布图看似完全正常，可尝试启用。这正是镜像数据流的表现，也是没有其他明显症状的故障（问题 #368）。若原因不是镜像，启用后会更明显地显示出错误。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。

source: Largest datagram the radio may send. 1450 is what SmartSDR itself asks for. Lower it on a path with a smaller MTU — a VPN or a tunnel — where the fragments are dropped and no spectrum arrives at all.
zh-CN: 允许电台发送的最大数据报大小。1450 为 SmartSDR 自身使用的值。VPN 或隧道等较小 MTU 的链路可能丢弃分片，导致完全没有频谱；此时请调低。

source: Checks the radio answers, without registering as a GUI client — so it will not disturb a SmartSDR session already running.
zh-CN: 检查电台是否响应，不注册为图形客户端，因此不会干扰正在运行的 SmartSDR 会话。

source: Copies the last session's protocol trace to the clipboard, for a bug report.
zh-CN: 将上次会话的协议跟踪复制到剪贴板，用于问题报告。

source: Wideband IQ receive over DAX, audio transmit the radio modulates. Press "Apply / reconnect" to switch without a restart.
zh-CN: 通过 DAX 接收宽带 IQ，由电台调制发射音频。点击“应用／重新连接”即可切换，无需重启。

source: Not yet verified against real hardware. If it misbehaves, please send the diagnostic report — it contains every protocol line exchanged with the radio.
zh-CN: 尚未经真实硬件验证。如工作异常，请提供诊断报告，其中包含与电台交换的全部协议行。

source: Waiting for the machine the radio is attached to, where the modules are installed. Which device it opens is `device_args` in that machine's config.toml, or its --device.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑，该电脑上安装了相关模块。实际打开的设备由该电脑 config.toml 中的 `device_args` 或其 --device 参数指定。

source: Ask every installed SoapySDR module to scan. Nothing is opened, so this is safe while receiving — but it can take a moment.
zh-CN: 请求所有已安装的 SoapySDR 模块扫描设备。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行，但可能需要一些时间。

source: No SoapySDR devices found. Check that the module for your radio is installed and that you may access the device.
zh-CN: 未找到 SoapySDR 设备。请检查是否已安装电台对应模块，以及是否具有设备访问权限。

source: A sound card is listed above as if it were an SDR. It accepts any frequency and ignores it, so opening it shows the sound card's input instead of the band. sdroxide does not pick those automatically — but a device_args line naming one is still obeyed.
zh-CN: 上方将声卡像 SDR 一样列出。声卡接受任何频率但不处理调谐，打开后显示的是声卡输入，而非波段。sdroxide 不会自动选择声卡，但仍会遵循 device_args 中明确指定的声卡。

source: Hardware above is supported directly by sdroxide: {names}. Selecting that interface above gives you its own settings — gain stages, filters and notches SoapySDR cannot express — and needs no SoapySDR module.
zh-CN: sdroxide 可直接支持上方硬件：{names}。选择对应接口后可使用其专用设置，包括 SoapySDR 无法表达的增益级、滤波器和陷波器，且无需 SoapySDR 模块。

source:
host:port of a running Hamlib rigctld — 127.0.0.1:4532 is its own default, on this machine.

Start one with, for example, `rigctld -m 2028 -r /dev/ttyUSB0 -s 38400`, where -m is the Hamlib model number for your radio (`rigctl -l` lists them).

This is the catch-all: it reaches the frequency, mode, PTT, power, S-meter and SWR and nothing else. Where one of the native families above fits your radio it does more — keying from the rig's own text buffer, the receive filter, and per-model meter scales.
zh-CN:
运行中的 Hamlib rigctld 的主机:端口，本机默认地址为 127.0.0.1:4532。

例如可用 rigctld -m 2028 -r /dev/ttyUSB0 -s 38400 启动；-m 为电台的 Hamlib 型号编号，可用 rigctl -l 查看。

这是通用接口，只控制频率、模式、PTT、功率、S 表和驻波比。若上方有适合该电台的原生协议系列，可提供更多功能，例如电台内部文字键控、接收滤波器及对应型号的仪表刻度。

source: Which one opens is set by --device or device_args in config.toml; with neither, the first radio listed wins.
zh-CN: 由 --device 或 config.toml 中的 device_args 决定打开哪个设备；两者均未指定时，使用列表中的第一台电台。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: These controls appear once a SoapySDR device is open — they are the device's own, and it has to be asked.
zh-CN: 打开 SoapySDR 设备后才会显示这些控件。这些是设备自身的设置，需要先向设备查询。

source:
host:port of a running flrig — 127.0.0.1:12345 is its own default, on this machine. flrig serves XML-RPC whenever it is running; the port is under its Config → Setup → Server.

Like the Hamlib option this drives a daemon rather than the radio, but through flrig's own per-model driver — on a number of rigs its power and filter handling is the more faithful of the two. It reaches the frequency, mode, PTT, transmit power (in whole watts), the receive bandwidth, the S-meter, SWR and power-out. CW keys through flrig's own cwio port, which must be configured in flrig itself.
zh-CN:
运行中的 flrig 的主机:端口，本机默认地址为 127.0.0.1:12345。flrig 运行时提供 XML-RPC，端口位于 Config → Setup → Server。

与 Hamlib 类似，此接口通过后台程序控制电台，但使用 flrig 的型号专用驱动，部分电台的功率和滤波器控制更准确。支持频率、模式、PTT、整瓦发射功率、接收带宽、S 表、驻波比和输出功率。CW 使用 flrig 的 cwio 端口，需在 flrig 中配置。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。
覆盖 0–{:.1} MHz，USB 流量 {:.0} MB/s

source: 129.6 Msps needs a SuperSpeed link and a fast host; 64.8 is the safe default. Changing it reopens the receiver automatically, which takes a moment but needs no restart.
zh-CN: 129.6 Msps 需要 SuperSpeed 链路和高速主机；64.8 是稳妥的默认值。修改后会自动重新打开接收机，需等待片刻，无需重启。

source: Below the VHF crossover this is an ordinary width. Above it the tuner's 8 MHz IF cannot be centred in a window this wide, so the live spectrum sits off to one side of the panadapter with nothing beside it.
zh-CN: 低于 VHF 切换频率时，此频宽正常可用。高于切换频率时，调谐器的 8 MHz 中频无法在如此宽的窗口中居中，实际频谱会偏向全景频谱一侧，旁边没有有效信号。

source: How much of the digitised spectrum the panadapter shows at once. The whole DSP chain runs at this width, so wider costs proportionally more CPU — 1/2 is the entire band in the waterfall, and a serious amount of arithmetic. Above the VHF crossover ({:.1} MHz) the panadapter is not looking at the antenna but at the tuner's IF, which is 8 MHz wide and parked at {:.2} MHz — so anything wider than {} cannot be centred on it, and the extra width is dead spectrum beside the signal rather than more of it.
zh-CN: 全景频谱同时显示的数字化频谱宽度。整个 DSP 链以此频宽运行，因此频宽越大，CPU 运算量按比例增加；1/2 表示在瀑布图中显示整个波段，运算量很大。高于 HF/VHF 自动切换频率（{:.1} MHz）时，全景频谱显示调谐器中频而非天线输入；中频宽度为 8 MHz，中心位于 {:.2} MHz。因此宽于 {} 的范围无法以它为中心，增加的是信号旁无用的频谱，而非更多信号。

source: The dial is above the crossover now, so this width is showing the tuner's 8 MHz off-centre with dead spectrum beside it. Narrow the width to fill the panadapter.
zh-CN: 当前调谐频率高于自动切换点，此频宽会使调谐器的 8 MHz 信号偏离中心，并显示旁边无用的频谱。请缩窄频宽，让信号充满全景频谱。

source: AD8370 variable-gain amplifier ahead of the ADC.
zh-CN: ADC 前的 AD8370 可变增益放大器。

source: PE4304 step attenuator, in 0.5 dB steps.
zh-CN: PE4304 步进衰减器，步进为 0.5 dB。

source: Selects the ADC's wider input range: more headroom for strong broadcast signals, fewer counts for weak ones. Off selects the more sensitive 1.5 Vp-p range.
zh-CN: 选择 ADC 的较宽输入量程：为强广播信号提供更多余量，但弱信号占用的量化计数更少。关闭时使用更灵敏的 1.5 Vp-p 量程。

source: Adds a small dither signal ahead of the ADC: costs a little noise floor, buys spurious-free dynamic range.
zh-CN: 在 ADC 前加入微小抖动信号，以略微增加底噪换取更高的无杂散动态范围。

source: The ADC scrambles its output so the digital bus stops radiating into the front end; the driver unscrambles it. Leave this on unless you are debugging. Applies on reconnect.
zh-CN: ADC 对输出进行扰码，避免数字总线向前端辐射干扰；驱动再解扰。除调试外请保持启用。重新连接后生效。

source: R828D RF gain, used above the automatic HF/VHF crossover. 29 discrete steps; the nearest is used.
zh-CN: R828D 射频增益，在高于 HF/VHF 自动切换频率时使用。共有 29 个离散步进，采用最接近的值。

source: Corrects the reference oscillator. Applied when you let go of the value — reopening on every pixel of a drag would restart the receiver hundreds of times.
zh-CN: 校正参考振荡器。在释放数值控件后应用，避免拖动中每移动一个像素都重新打开接收机，造成数百次重启。

source: Receive only. Below the ADC's Nyquist limit the antenna is sampled directly and retuning is instant, because there is no hardware downconverter — the full ADC stream is converted to baseband on the host. Above it the receiver switches to its R828D tuner and the VHF SMA automatically, so both antennas need to be connected. VHF needs an ADC clock of 32.4 Msps or more for the tuner's IF to fit, and at clocks below 48 Msps there is a gap between the two ranges that nothing can reach. Every setting here applies straight away — there is no Apply button to press.
zh-CN: 仅接收。低于 ADC 的奈奎斯特频率上限时直接采样天线信号，调谐立即完成：硬件不做下变频，完整 ADC 数据流在主机上转换为基带。高于此频率时自动切换至 R828D 调谐器及 VHF SMA，因此两副天线都需连接。VHF 需要至少 32.4 Msps 的 ADC 时钟才能容纳调谐器中频；时钟低于 48 Msps 时，两个覆盖范围之间会存在无法接收的频率空隙。此处所有设置立即生效，无需点击“应用”。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source:
The six rates are six different FPGA images, not a register — which is why nothing in ELAD's protocol selects between them, and why what this setting means depends on the model.

FDM-S1 / FDM-S2: a command. Their FPGA is loaded by the computer at every power-up, and sdroxide runs ELAD's own elad-firmware loader to put this rate's image in. Without that loader installed a sampler sends no samples at all, and sdroxide says so on screen.

FDM-DUO: not a command. The radio boots its own FPGA and arrives at whatever rate it powered up in or FDM-SW2 last left it in (192 kHz on a fresh one), and this only says how the stream is READ. Get it wrong and the panadapter is simply the wrong width, with every frequency inside it scaled to match.

The stream's real rate is measured a couple of seconds after it starts, and a mismatch is reported on screen. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN:
六档采样率对应六个不同的 FPGA 镜像，而非寄存器设置。因此 ELAD 协议中没有选择采样率的命令，此项含义也取决于型号。

FDM-S1／FDM-S2：此项是控制命令。每次上电都由电脑加载 FPGA，sdroxide 调用 ELAD 的 elad-firmware 加载器写入此采样率对应的镜像。未安装加载器时，采样器不会发送任何样本，sdroxide 会在屏幕提示。

FDM-DUO：此项不是控制命令。电台自行启动 FPGA，使用上电时或 FDM-SW2 上次留下的采样率（全新设备为 192 kHz）。此处只指定如何读取数据流，设置错误会导致全景频谱宽度错误，其中所有频率也按相同比例缩放。

数据流启动几秒后会测量实际采样率，并在屏幕报告不匹配。点击“应用”后生效。

source: FDM-S: the FPGA image loaded — FDM-DUO: how the stream is read
zh-CN: FDM-S：加载的 FPGA 镜像；FDM-DUO：数据流读取方式

source: The receiver's input pad — one step, in or out. The same control as the main window's Gain slider.
zh-CN: 接收机输入衰减器，只有接入和旁路两档，与主窗口增益滑块控制同一项。

source: The low-pass bank in front of the ADC. Bypassing it gives the widest view and the worst behaviour near strong out-of-band signals — a broadcast transmitter a few miles away will put images across the band. Leave it on unless you are deliberately listening outside the filtered range.
zh-CN: ADC 前的低通滤波器组。旁路可提供最宽视野，但在强带外信号附近表现最差，几英里外的广播发射机也可能让整个波段出现镜像。除非特意接收滤波范围外的信号，否则请保持启用。

source: The transceiver's CAT USB port, which is a separate cable from the receive one. Leave the port unset on an FDM-S1 or FDM-S2, which have none — and on an FDM-DUO you would rather drive through its receive cable alone, where it can still be tuned and keyed but no meter can be read.
zh-CN: 收发信机的 CAT USB 端口，使用与接收端口不同的线缆。FDM-S1 和 FDM-S2 没有此端口，请留空；若 FDM-DUO 只通过接收线缆控制，也可留空，此时仍可调谐与启动发射，但不能读取仪表。

source: With the port set, the radio's display and this dial are the same number in both directions: the FDM-DUO's receive window is built around its VFO, so tuning here moves the front panel and turning the front-panel knob moves the readout here. The panadapter re-centres on the dial as it goes. With no port — or none the radio answers on — there is no VFO to command, and tuning stays inside the window the radio is already sending.
zh-CN: 指定端口后，电台显示与此处调谐读数双向同步：FDM-DUO 的接收窗口围绕其 VFO 建立，此处调谐会移动电台前面板频率，旋转前面板旋钮也会更新此处读数，全景频谱随之重新以调谐频率为中心。未指定端口或电台不响应时，无法向 VFO 发命令，只能在电台已发送的窗口内调谐。

source: Must match menu 70 "CAT BAUD" on the radio, which ships at 38400. The radio has these four rates and no others, and a port opened at any other one is silent both ways — the radio ignores the dial and refuses to key, with nothing to say why.
zh-CN: 必须与电台菜单 70“CAT BAUD”一致，出厂为 38400。电台只有这四档速率；使用其他速率打开端口时，双向通信均无响应，电台不接受调谐和发射命令，也无法说明原因。

source: the radio has no {} baud setting — {ELAD_DEFAULT_CAT_BAUD} will be used instead
zh-CN: 电台不支持 {} 波特率，将改用 {ELAD_DEFAULT_CAT_BAUD}

source: How transmit is keyed. "CAT" sends the radio's own TX command and needs nothing set up on the rig; RTS needs menu 54 "PTT" set to PTT+RTS.
zh-CN: 启动发射的方式。“CAT”发送电台自身 TX 命令，无需在电台上另行设置；RTS 需要将菜单 54“PTT”设为 PTT+RTS。

source:
Where the radio takes its transmit audio from — the rig's TI command, which is menu 32 "TX IN" at the front panel. Asserted when the port opens.

"USB audio" is what makes transmit work here: the FDM-DUO sends what sdroxide puts into its USB sound card. A radio left on "Microphone" sends the room instead, and nothing on screen says so.
zh-CN:
电台的发射音频来源，对应 TI 命令及前面板菜单 32“TX IN”，在打开端口时设置。

“USB 音频”使本软件能够发射：FDM-DUO 发送 sdroxide 写入其 USB 声卡的音频。若电台仍设为“麦克风”，实际发送的会是室内声音，屏幕不会提示这一差异。

source:
Which of the two sockets on the back the receiver listens on — the rig's AN command, which is menu 31 "ANTENNAS" at the front panel and the "ANT 1 2" indicator on its display.

"RTX" is one antenna doing both jobs, on the M-type socket that also carries transmit. "RX only" moves receive to the second socket and leaves transmit on RTX — a receiving antenna, a loop or a beverage, with the beam still on the transmitter.

It moves this whole receiver: the panadapter, the demodulators and the rig's own audio all come from the socket selected here.

Applies immediately, and is read back from the radio when the control port opens — this is the rig's own setting, not a copy of it kept here.
zh-CN:
接收机使用的后面板天线接口，对应 AN 命令、前面板菜单 31“ANTENNAS”及显示屏“ANT 1 2”指示。

“RTX”使用同时收发的 M 型接口。“仅接收”将接收切换到第二个接口，发射仍使用 RTX，可连接接收专用天线、环形天线或 Beverage 天线，同时让定向天线继续用于发射。

此设置切换整个接收机：全景频谱、解调器和电台自身音频均来自所选接口。

立即生效，并在控制端口打开时从电台读回。这是电台自身设置，此处不另存副本。

source: the radio has no {} baud setting — {ELAD_DEFAULT_CAT_BAUD} will be used instead
zh-CN: 此电台没有 {} 波特率选项，将改用 {ELAD_DEFAULT_CAT_BAUD}

source: How often the radio is asked what it is doing — its dial, its mode and its meters. Turn the rig's own VFO knob and the readout follows within one poll. It is also the whole of the control traffic this end generates, so lower it if the radio's audio breaks up.
zh-CN: 向电台查询调谐频率、模式和仪表的频率。旋转电台 VFO 旋钮后，此处读数会在一个轮询周期内更新。这也是本端产生的全部控制流量，若电台音频断续，可降低轮询频率。

source: The FDM-DUO's own USB Audio port. Left on the system default it is almost never the radio — it is the machine's speakers.
zh-CN: FDM-DUO 自身的 USB 音频端口。保持系统默认时，几乎总是电脑扬声器而非电台。

source: Copies the last session's trace to the clipboard, for a bug report: every command exchanged with the device, and the first bytes of the sample stream.
zh-CN: 将上次会话跟踪复制到剪贴板，用于问题报告：包含与设备交换的全部命令及样本流最初的字节。

source: Only receiving on an FDM-DUO has been run on real hardware so far. If anything misbehaves, please attach the diagnostic report to a bug report.
zh-CN: 目前仅在真实 FDM-DUO 硬件上测试过接收。如工作异常，请将诊断报告附到问题报告中。

source: CW is keyed by the radio's own key or paddle: the FDM-DUO has no command that accepts text, so the CW panel cannot key it.
zh-CN: CW 由电台自身直键或双桨键操控。FDM-DUO 没有接受文本的命令，因此 CW 面板无法操控其电键发射。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: Which rates a receiver has depends on the model and the firmware. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 接收机可用的采样率取决于型号和固件。点击“应用”后生效。

source: every rate any HF+ model offers — connect one to see its own
zh-CN: 列出所有 HF+ 型号提供的采样率；连接后可查看该设备支持的采样率

source: The receiver's own gain control. Leave it on for general listening; turn it off to set the attenuator by hand for measurement.
zh-CN: 接收机自身的增益控制。一般收听请保持启用；测量时可关闭，手动设置衰减器。

source: High trades a little sensitivity for headroom against strong neighbours — the right setting on a crowded band at night.
zh-CN: 高模式以少量灵敏度换取对邻近强信号的余量，适合夜间拥挤的波段。

source: Front-end attenuation, as a gain — 0 dB is none. Only obeyed with the AGC off.
zh-CN: 以前端增益形式表示的衰减，0 dB 为无衰减。仅在 AGC 关闭时有效。

source: The HF low-noise amplifier. Buys sensitivity at the cost of intermodulation, so it is off by default — which is usually right on a real antenna.
zh-CN: HF 低噪声放大器，以增加互调的代价提高灵敏度，因此默认关闭；连接实际天线时通常应保持关闭。

source: Parts per billion — this receiver's own unit, a thousand times finer than the ppm an RTL-SDR uses. Nothing here is ever written to the receiver's flash: this overrides the stored value for the session only.
zh-CN: 单位为十亿分之一（ppb），是此接收机自身使用的单位，比 RTL-SDR 的 ppm 精细一千倍。此处不会写入接收机闪存，只在当前会话覆盖已存储的值。

source: Not every HF+ has one; on a receiver without, this does nothing.
zh-CN: 并非所有 HF+ 都有此功能；不具备该功能的接收机上，此项无效。

source: The image balancer, the zero-IF offset and the fine-tuning oscillator. Turn it off only to see raw hardware output — with it off, the mirror image appears on the zero-IF rates and the dial is accurate only to the nearest kilohertz.
zh-CN: 镜像平衡、零中频偏移和精细调谐振荡器。仅在需要查看原始硬件输出时关闭；关闭后，零中频采样率会出现镜像，调谐精度也只有整 kHz。

source: Copies the last session's trace to the clipboard, for a bug report: every command exchanged with the receiver, and the first bytes of the sample stream.
zh-CN: 将上次会话跟踪复制到剪贴板，用于问题报告：包含与接收机交换的全部命令及样本流最初的字节。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。启用时切勿连接收发信机、直流接地天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，因为直流电会直接进入馈线。

source: Receive only. No SoapySDR and no libairspyhf needed. Below the synthesiser's floor the host oscillator does the tuning, which is how this receiver reaches VLF. The receiver and sample rate take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it.
zh-CN: 仅接收。无需 SoapySDR 或 libairspyhf。低于频率合成器下限时由主机振荡器调谐，因此可接收 VLF。接收机选择与采样率在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。

source: Not yet verified against real hardware. If it misbehaves, please send the diagnostic report — it contains every command exchanged with the receiver, and the first bytes of the sample stream decoded as I/Q pairs.
zh-CN: 尚未经真实硬件验证。如工作异常，请提供诊断报告，其中包含与接收机交换的全部命令，以及样本流最初按 I/Q 对解码的字节。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: How transmit is keyed. A network link has no control lines, so DTR and RTS key nothing here — use CAT, which asks the daemon to key the radio, or VOX.
zh-CN: 启动发射的方式。网络链路没有控制线，因此 DTR 和 RTS 无法在此启动发射；请选择 CAT，由守护进程请求电台发射，或使用 VOX。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: an R2 and a Mini offer different rates and cannot be told apart until one is open
zh-CN: R2 与 Mini 提供的采样率不同，打开设备前无法区分

source: This is the rate you get. The receiver's ADC runs at twice it — it digitises a real signal and sdroxide makes complex baseband from it on the host.
zh-CN: 这是实际获得的采样率。接收机 ADC 以两倍速率运行，将实信号数字化，再由 sdroxide 在主机上生成复数基带。

source: A step along the curve above, not a dB figure — the tuner's LNA, mixer and VGA move together, and how much each step is worth depends on the curve and the band. 0 is the quiet end.
zh-CN: 上方曲线中的步进位置，并非 dB 数。调谐器的 LNA、混频器和 VGA 同时变化，每步增益取决于曲线及波段。0 为最低增益端。

source: Hands the LNA to the tuner's own loop, overriding the curve.
zh-CN: 将 LNA 交给调谐器自身控制环，覆盖曲线设置。

source:
What to put the radio in for a mode sdroxide modulates through its sound card. "DIGI" selects the rig's DATA/PKT position, which takes the transmit audio from the USB or ACC input with the microphone path's speech processing out of it; "USB" leaves it on the plain sideband, for a radio already set to modulate SSB from its data input or one with no DATA position at all.

It covers every digital mode — FT8, FT4, PSK, RTTY, SSTV and the rest — and CW sent as "Sound card", and it overrides Mode control for them. SSTV is the one whose sideband follows the band, so there it means the DATA position on that sideband: USB-D above 40 m, LSB-D at and below it. SSTV-FM is not part of it — an FM carrier has no sideband to choose.
zh-CN:
选择 SDRoxide 通过声卡调制时使用的电台模式。“DIGI”选择 DATA／PKT，使用 USB 或 ACC 发射音频输入，绕过麦克风话音处理；“USB”使用普通边带，适用于已将 SSB 发射音频设为数据输入，或没有 DATA 模式的电台。

适用于 FT8、FT4、PSK、RTTY、SSTV 等全部数字模式，以及采用声卡发送的 CW，并优先于模式控制设置。SSTV 的边带随波段变化：高于 40 m 使用 USB-D，40 m 及以下使用 LSB-D。SSTV-FM 不受此项影响，因为 FM 没有需要选择的边带。

source: The same for the mixer stage.
zh-CN: 对混频器级执行同样的自动控制。

source: With a loop running, the gain slider no longer sets the stage it owns — the loop overwrites it.
zh-CN: 控制环运行时，增益滑块不再控制对应增益级，数值由控制环覆盖。

source: A third less USB traffic. Leave it on: this is a USB 2.0 device and the top rate is 30 MB/s packed against 40 unpacked. Applies on reconnect.
zh-CN: USB 流量减少三分之一。请保持启用：这是 USB 2.0 设备，最高采样率下打包为 30 MB/s，未打包为 40 MB/s。重新连接后生效。

source: Turn it off to see raw hardware output. Worth knowing where the spur goes: the offset lands at the edge of the span, not its centre, because the signal is translated by a quarter of the sample rate on the way through.
zh-CN: 关闭可查看原始硬件输出。偏移杂散位于频宽边缘而非中心，因为处理中将信号平移了四分之一采样率。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。启用时切勿连接收发信机、直流接地天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，因为直流电会直接进入馈线。

source: Every command exchanged with the receiver, the sample-rate arithmetic, and the first samples decoded as I/Q.
zh-CN: 与接收机交换的全部命令、采样率计算及最初按 I/Q 解码的样本。

source: Receive only, 24–1800 MHz. No SoapySDR and no libairspy needed. The receiver, sample rate and packing take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it.
zh-CN: 仅接收，24–1800 MHz。无需 SoapySDR 或 libairspy。接收机选择、采样率和打包方式在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。

source: Not yet verified against real hardware. If it misbehaves, please send the diagnostic report — it contains every command exchanged with the receiver, the rate arithmetic, and the first samples decoded as I/Q pairs.
zh-CN: 尚未经真实硬件验证。如工作异常，请提供诊断报告，其中包含与接收机交换的全部命令、采样率计算及最初按 I/Q 对解码的样本。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source:
How the CW panel's keyer transmits. "Rig keyer" puts the radio in CW and hands it the text to send with its own keyer. It uses the rig's keyer speed (set from the panel's WPM), and on Yaesu it sends by way of keyer memory 1, overwriting whatever was stored in it.

It needs break-in on at the radio, which sdroxide turns on itself with each message on Icom, Yaesu and Kenwood — a rig with break-in off takes the message and transmits nothing. It is left on afterwards, and a full break-in is never turned down to semi.

"Sound card" sends the keyed sidetone as audio instead (MCW), a tone at dial + pitch — and because a rig in CW would ignore its sound card entirely, selecting CW then follows the Digimode mode setting (USB, DATA, or Radio controlled) instead of switching the rig to CW. Pick "Radio controlled" there for rigs whose data position can't be commanded over CAT (a Xiegu's U-D) and park the rig on it yourself, as for FT8.
zh-CN:
CW 面板的发射方式。“电台键控器”将电台设为 CW，并把文字交给其内部键控器发送，速度由面板的 WPM 设置。Yaesu 使用键控器存储槽位 1，会覆盖其中原有内容。

电台需启用插入功能。每次向 Icom、Yaesu、Kenwood 发送文字时，SDRoxide 会自行启用插入；关闭插入时，电台只接收文字而不发射。之后保持启用，原有全插入不会被改为半插入。

“声卡”以音频发送键控侧音（MCW），位于频率读数加侧音音高处。电台在 CW 模式下会忽略声卡，所以此时选择 CW 将跟随数字模式设置（USB、DATA 或由电台控制），而不直接切到 CW。对不能通过 CAT 选择数据模式的电台（如 Xiegu 的 U-D），请选择“由电台控制”，并像使用 FT8 一样手动将电台置于相应模式。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: these are the rates this receiver turned out to have
zh-CN: 此接收机实际支持的采样率

source: the receiver only reports three of these; the rest are in the firmware's alternate table and an older build may not carry them
zh-CN: 接收机只报告其中三档；其他来自固件的备用表，较旧固件可能不具备

source: This is the rate you get. The receiver's ADC runs at twice it — it digitises a real signal and sdroxide makes complex baseband from it on the host.
zh-CN: 这是实际获得的采样率。接收机 ADC 以两倍速率运行，将实信号数字化，再由 sdroxide 在主机上生成复数基带。

source: A step along the curve above, not a dB figure — the tuner's LNA, mixer and VGA move together, and how much each step is worth depends on the curve and the band. 0 is the quiet end.
zh-CN: 上方曲线中的步进位置，并非 dB 数。调谐器的 LNA、混频器和 VGA 同时变化，每步增益取决于曲线及波段。0 为最低增益端。

source: Hands the LNA to the tuner's own loop, overriding the curve.
zh-CN: 将 LNA 交给调谐器自身控制环，覆盖曲线设置。

source: The same for the mixer stage.
zh-CN: 对混频器级执行同样的自动控制。

source: With a loop running, the gain slider no longer sets the stage it owns — the loop overwrites it.
zh-CN: 控制环运行时，增益滑块不再控制对应增益级，数值由控制环覆盖。

source: Powers an active antenna or preamp down the coax. Only the ANT socket has one — the two cable ports are plain inputs.
zh-CN: 通过同轴线为有源天线或前置放大器供电。只有 ANT 接口具备此功能，两个有线接口均为普通输入。

source:
How often the radio is asked what it is doing — its dial, its mode and its meters. This is the half of the control link that runs from the radio back to sdroxide: turn the rig's own VFO knob or change its mode on the front panel and the readout, the band and the panadapter follow within one poll.

It is also the whole of the control traffic this end generates, and on a modern Icom that traffic is not free: the CI-V port and the sound card sit behind one USB hub inside the radio, so frames asked for here are bus time the audio does not get — heard as dropouts that look like a DSP fault and are not one. The default of 2 Hz is half a second behind the knob and quiet enough to stay out of the audio's way. Raise it where the control port is its own device (a separate USB-serial adapter, a network rigctld); lower it if the radio's audio breaks up.

An Icom with CI-V Transceive switched on in its own menu needs none of this for the dial: it reports the knob the instant it moves, and sdroxide stands the dial poll down as soon as it sees it do so — and picks it back up again if the radio ever moves without saying so.

The rate is the dial's. The mode rides along with only every fourth poll, since it is a setting that changes a few times in an evening rather than one that follows a knob.
zh-CN:
查询电台频率、模式和仪表的频率。转动电台 VFO 旋钮或在前面板更改模式时，软件读数、波段和频谱会在一次轮询内跟随。

这也是软件向电台产生的主要控制流量。现代 Icom 的 CI-V 和声卡共用机内 USB 集线器，控制帧占用的总线时间会挤占音频，导致类似 DSP 故障的掉音。默认 2 Hz，比旋钮变化最多滞后半秒，也较少影响音频。控制端口为独立 USB 串口或网络 rigctld 时可提高；音频断续时应降低。

Icom 启用 CI-V Transceive 后，会在旋钮变化时立即报告，SDRoxide 检测到后暂停频率轮询；若电台出现未主动报告的变化，会恢复轮询。

所设值是频率轮询速率。模式变化较少，仅每四次轮询查询一次。

source: A third less USB traffic. Leave it on: this is a USB 2.0 device and the top rate is 36 MB/s packed against 48 unpacked. Applies on reconnect.
zh-CN: USB 流量减少三分之一。请保持启用：这是 USB 2.0 设备，最高采样率下打包为 36 MB/s，未打包为 48 MB/s。重新连接后生效。

source: Turn it off to see raw hardware output. Worth knowing where the spur goes: the offset lands at the edge of the span, not its centre, because the signal is translated by a quarter of the sample rate on the way through.
zh-CN: 关闭可查看原始硬件输出。偏移杂散位于频宽边缘而非中心，因为处理中将信号平移了四分之一采样率。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。启用时切勿连接收发信机、直流接地天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，因为直流电会直接进入馈线。

source: One of these boards is on 1d50:60a1, the USB id HydraSDR's prototypes share with the Airspy R2 and Mini. sdroxide checks the firmware after opening and will say so if the wrong interface has been picked, in either direction.
zh-CN: 部分板卡使用 USB ID 1d50:60a1，HydraSDR 原型与 Airspy R2、Mini 共用此标识。sdroxide 打开设备后检查固件，无论误选哪一方向的接口，都会提示。

source: Every command exchanged with the receiver, the sample-rate arithmetic, and the first samples decoded as I/Q.
zh-CN: 与接收机交换的全部命令、采样率计算及最初按 I/Q 解码的样本。

source: Receive only, 24–1800 MHz. No SoapySDR and no libhydrasdr needed. The receiver, sample rate and packing take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it.
zh-CN: 仅接收，24–1800 MHz。无需 SoapySDR 或 libhydrasdr。接收机选择、采样率和打包方式在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。

source: Not yet verified against real hardware. If it misbehaves, please send the diagnostic report — it contains every command exchanged with the receiver, the rate arithmetic, and the first samples decoded as I/Q pairs.
zh-CN: 尚未经真实硬件验证。如工作异常，请提供诊断报告，其中包含与接收机交换的全部命令、采样率计算及最初按 I/Q 对解码的样本。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source:
Which socket on the back the radio is using — its own ANT command, the same setting as the ANT button on the front panel.

Applies immediately, and it is the radio's setting rather than a copy kept here: the socket the radio is on is read back when the session opens.

The choice is remembered per band. Switch to the beam on 2 m and the wire on 40, and each comes back the next time the dial crosses into that band — and the next time sdroxide starts. A memory channel stored here carries its socket too.
zh-CN:
电台后面板使用的天线接口，对应电台自身的 ANT 命令，与前面板 ANT 按钮相同。

立即生效，设置由电台持有；每次连接时会读取电台当前接口。

按波段保存选择，例如 2 m 使用定向天线、40 m 使用线天线，再次进入该波段或重新启动 SDRoxide 时会恢复选择。这里保存的记忆信道也记录天线接口。

source: Re-list Fobos SDRs. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新列出 Fobos SDR。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: Direct sampling — the tuner (and so LNA/VGA gain) is not in the path. The rate below is a target for the software downconverter, not a hardware setting, so the achieved rate can differ from it.
zh-CN: 直接采样：调谐器不在信号路径中，因此 LNA/VGA 增益无效。下方采样率是软件下变频器的目标值，而非硬件设置，实际采样率可能有所不同。
此接收机自身报告的采样率

source: measured on one real unit — connect this receiver and Rescan to see its own list
zh-CN: 来自一台实机测量；连接此接收机并重新扫描，可查看它自己的列表

source:
Which transceiver generation keys the rig, for PTT method "CAT". The two disagree about what the TX parameter means and nothing on the wire tells them apart, so pick the one that matches your radio.

"TS-2000 style (TX;)" — TS-480, TS-570, TS-870, TS-2000: the ordinary send, on the main band.

"TS-590 style (TX1;)" — TS-590S/SG, TS-890, TS-990: DATA SEND, which keys with the ACC2/USB audio input live. On these rigs the plain send selects the microphone instead and mutes the audio sdroxide transmits.

Set wrong, a TS-590 transmits silence — but a TS-2000 transmits on the sub-band, which is another band entirely.
zh-CN:
PTT 方式为 CAT 时，选择收发机的命令代际。两代电台对 TX 参数的解释不同，协议不会自动区分，请按型号选择。

TS-2000 风格（TX;）：适用于 TS-480、TS-570、TS-870、TS-2000，在主波段进行普通发射。

TS-590 风格（TX1;）：适用于 TS-590S／SG、TS-890、TS-990，使用 DATA SEND 并启用 ACC2／USB 音频。这些电台的普通发射命令会选择麦克风并关闭 SDRoxide 的发射音频。

选错后，TS-590 会发射静音；TS-2000 则可能在副波段发射，与主波段完全不同。

source: One tap is a gain and a phase — a null at one frequency that gets worse either side of it, which is all an analogue phaser can do. Each further tap buys one sample period of the path difference between HF1 and HF2 that the filter can equalise, which is what turns that notch into a band quiet all the way across.
zh-CN: 一个抽头只能调整增益和相位，在一个频率产生零陷，两侧效果逐渐变差，与模拟移相器相同。每增加一个抽头，滤波器便可再均衡 HF1 与 HF2 路径之间一个采样周期的时差，从而将单点陷波扩展为整个频带内的抑制。

source: Receive only. RF port (tuner), HF1/HF2 (direct sampling, decoded in software) and HF1+HF2 (both at once, combined by the diversity filter) all work. The receiver, input and sample rate take effect on Apply; gain, clock source and taps apply as you change them — the diversity filter's mode, adapt rate and hold are on the main window's own DIV box once this radio is selected.
zh-CN: 仅接收。RF 端口（调谐器）、HF1/HF2（直接采样，由软件解码）及 HF1+HF2（同时采样，由分集滤波器合成）均可使用。接收机选择、输入和采样率在点击“应用”后生效；增益、时钟源及抽头数随修改立即生效。选择此电台后，分集滤波器的模式、自适应速率和保持设置位于主窗口的 DIV 控件中。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Re-list the USB bus. No device is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 重新扫描 USB 总线。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: Front-end amplifier, in 8 dB steps. This is the stage that changes sensitivity — and the stage that overloads first on a real antenna.
zh-CN: 前端放大器，步进为 8 dB。这一级决定灵敏度，也是连接实际天线时最先过载的一级。

source: Baseband amplifier after the mixer, in 2 dB steps. Turn this up for a weak signal before reaching for the LNA.
zh-CN: 混频器后的基带放大器，步进为 2 dB。弱信号时先提高此项，再考虑 LNA。
接收时使用 {:.0} dB 前置放大

source: One switch, shared with the transmit setting below — the radio applies whichever belongs to the direction it is entering. Off is usually right on a real antenna.
zh-CN: 与下方发射设置共用同一个开关；电台切换收发方向时应用相应设置。连接实际天线时通常应关闭。

source: A HackRF Pro chooses this itself — three quarters of the sample rate, filtered in the FPGA — and ignores anything the host asks for.
zh-CN: HackRF Pro 自行选择此项，为采样率的四分之三，并在 FPGA 内滤波，忽略主机请求的值。

source: Leave on Automatic. Choosing one too narrow does not just soften the band edges — it withdraws the LO offset that keeps the DC spike off your signal.
zh-CN: 保持自动。选得过窄不仅会削弱波段边缘，还会取消本振偏移，使直流尖峰重新落在信号上。

source:
One profile covers the family: the K3 command set, which the KX3, KX2 and K4 all answer. There is nothing to pick here — how many watts the Drive slider spans (12 on a bare KX2 or KX3, 110 with a KPA3 or a KXPA100) is read from the rig's own option-module query when the port opens.

Note the baud rates above: the K3, K3S, KX3 and KX2 go no faster than 38400, and a rig set below the rate chosen here answers nothing at all.
zh-CN:
同一配置覆盖 K3 命令集，以及兼容的 KX3、KX2、K4。无需再选型号；打开端口时，会根据电台的选件查询确定激励滑块对应的功率范围：裸机 KX2／KX3 为 12 W，安装 KPA3 或 KXPA100 时为 110 W。

注意上方波特率：K3、K3S、KX3、KX2 最高为 38400。电台速率低于软件选择值时，不会响应。

source: About 3 V at 50 mA down the coax, for an active antenna or a preamp. A HackRF One or Pro only; the Jawbreaker and rad1o have no such circuit.
zh-CN: 通过同轴线提供约 3 V、50 mA，为有源天线或前置放大器供电。仅 HackRF One 或 Pro 支持，Jawbreaker 和 rad1o 没有此电路。

source: This is a zero-IF radio, so its own LO leakage sits mid-span and the mixer's quadrature error puts a mirror image across it. Turning this off shows raw hardware output, which is the quick way to tell a driver problem from a DSP one.
zh-CN: 这是零中频电台，本振泄漏位于频谱中心，混频器正交误差产生关于中心对称的镜像。关闭可查看原始硬件输出，快速区分驱动问题与 DSP 问题。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。启用时切勿连接收发信机、直流接地天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，因为直流电会直接进入馈线。

source: Off by default. While this is off the backend publishes no transmit channel at all, so nothing can key the radio. Applies on reconnect.
zh-CN: 默认关闭。关闭时后端不提供任何发射通道，因此无法启动电台发射。重新连接后生效。

source: The transmit driver amplifier. Drive is applied digitally before this stage, so leave the drive high and set output level here — turning drive down instead runs the DAC at a fraction of full scale and raises intermodulation.
zh-CN: 发射驱动放大器。驱动电平在此前以数字方式应用，因此应保持较高驱动电平，在此设置输出；改为降低驱动会使 DAC 只利用部分满量程，并增加互调。
发射时使用 {:.0} dB 前置放大

source: The same switch as the receive setting above, applied when the radio changes direction.
zh-CN: 与上方接收设置共用同一个开关，在电台切换收发方向时应用。

source: Transmit is armed. Into a dummy load until you have measured it: a HackRF's harmonics are strong enough to need an external low-pass filter for the band you are on, and it is half duplex, so receive stops for the length of every over.
zh-CN: 已允许发射。完成测量前请连接假负载：HackRF 的谐波较强，需要当前波段的外置低通滤波器；它是半双工设备，每次发射期间会停止接收。

source:
Where the radio takes its transmit audio from — the rig's TI command, which is menu 32 "TX IN" at the front panel. Asserted when the port opens.

"USB audio" is what makes this interface work: the FDM-DUO transmits what sdroxide puts into its USB sound card. A radio left on "Microphone" sends the room instead, and nothing on screen says so.

"Auto" lets the rig choose — the microphone for a PTT press on the microphone, the USB port for a CAT or RTS key-down.

"Leave as set on the radio" sends no TI at all, for an operator who sets this at the front panel.
zh-CN:
电台发射音频来源，对应 TI 命令及前面板菜单 32“TX IN”，打开端口时设置。

选择“USB 音频”才能发送 SDRoxide 输出到 USB 声卡的音频；若保持“麦克风”，电台会发送房间里的声音，界面不会提示这一点。

“自动”由电台决定：麦克风 PTT 使用麦克风，CAT 或 RTS 发射使用 USB。

“保持电台当前设置”不发送 TI 命令，适合从前面板自行设置的用户。

source: Every command exchanged with the radio this session, in order, including the sequence around each key-down.
zh-CN: 按顺序记录此会话与电台交换的全部命令，包括每次电键按下前后的命令序列。

source: DC – 7.25 GHz, half duplex. No SoapySDR, no libusb and no libhackrf needed. The radio and the sample rate take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it. The band edges are the firmware's: a HackRF is specified for 1 MHz – 6 GHz (100 kHz on a Pro) and is heavily attenuated outside that, but it does tune there.
zh-CN: 直流至 7.25 GHz，半双工。无需 SoapySDR、libusb 或 libhackrf。电台选择与采样率在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。覆盖边界来自固件：HackRF 标称为 1 MHz–6 GHz（Pro 下限为 100 kHz），范围外虽可调谐，但信号会大幅衰减。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Serial {} is not among the receivers the SDRplay service reports. Pick one of the listed receivers, or replug this one and press Rescan.
zh-CN: SDRplay 服务报告的接收机中没有序列号 {}。请选择列表中的接收机，或重新插拔此设备后点击“重新扫描”。

source: Ask the SDRplay API service for its device list. Nothing is opened, so this is safe to press while receiving.
zh-CN: 请求 SDRplay API 服务提供设备列表。不会打开设备，因此接收期间也可安全执行。

source: With both tuners running, the API fixes the ADC at 6 MHz and hands back 2 Msps from a low IF — so 2 Msps is the widest span, and the narrower ones are that decimated. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 双调谐器运行时，API 将 ADC 固定为 6 MHz，并从低中频输出 2 Msps。因此最大频宽为 2 Msps，更窄的频宽在此基础上抽取。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Rates below 2 Msps run the ADC at 2 Msps and decimate in the service. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 低于 2 Msps 的采样率仍以 2 Msps 运行 ADC，再由服务抽取。点击“应用”后生效。

source:
Which of the two sockets on the back the receiver listens on — the rig's AN command, which is menu 31 "ANTENNAS" at the front panel and the "ANT 1 2" indicator on its display.

"RTX" is one antenna doing both jobs, on the M-type socket that also carries transmit. "RX only" moves receive to the second socket and leaves transmit on RTX — a receiving antenna, a loop or a beverage, with the beam still on the transmitter.

Applies immediately, and is read back from the radio when the port opens: this is the rig's own setting rather than a copy kept here.
zh-CN:
接收机使用的后面板接口，对应 AN 命令、菜单 31“ANTENNAS”及显示屏“ANT 1 2”指示。

“RTX”通过可发射的 M 型接口共用一副收发天线。“仅接收”将接收移至第二个接口，发射仍使用 RTX，可在发射天线之外连接接收环或 Beverage 天线。

立即生效，并在打开端口时读取电台实际状态，此设置由电台持有。

source: The tuner's analog filter. Auto picks the widest one that fits the sample rate. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 调谐器的模拟滤波器。“自动”选择采样率能容纳的最宽滤波器。点击“应用”后生效。

source: The RSP's own IF-gain loop, run by the API service. Off hands the IF gain slider back to you — the setting for measurement and weak-signal digital modes.
zh-CN: RSP 自身的中频增益控制环，由 API 服务运行。关闭后可手动使用中频增益滑块，适用于测量和弱信号数字模式。

source: Signal level the loop holds the ADC at. Lower leaves more headroom for signals off-channel. How low it may go depends on the sample rate — above 8.064 Msps the converter has less headroom to give, and above 9.216 Msps less still.
zh-CN: 控制环维持的 ADC 信号电平。降低可为通道外信号留出更多余量。可降至的下限取决于采样率：高于 8.064 Msps 时转换器余量减少，高于 9.216 Msps 时进一步减少。

source: The RSP's native gain unit: 20 dB is maximum gain (0 with the extended range below), 59 dB minimum. Applies immediately. Ignored while the AGC is running — the loop owns this value then, and the S-meter shows what it settled on.
zh-CN: RSP 原生增益单位：20 dB 为最大增益（启用下方扩展范围后为 0），59 dB 为最小增益。立即生效。AGC 运行时忽略此值，由控制环调整，S 表显示其最终设定值。

source: Lets the IF gain reduction go below 20 dB, down to 0 — the last 20 dB of gain the receiver has. Off is the API's own default and the right one for ordinary listening, because the bottom of the range is where an RSP is easiest to overload. Worth having on for weak signals with the LNA already at 0. It also lets the AGC set point go up to 0 dBFS. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 允许中频增益衰减低于 20 dB，最低至 0，以使用接收机剩余的 20 dB 增益。默认关闭，与 API 默认一致，适合普通收听，因为范围最低端最容易使 RSP 过载。LNA 已为 0 时，可为弱信号启用。启用后 AGC 目标电平也可提高到 0 dBFS。立即生效。

source: Front-end attenuation in steps: 0 is maximum gain, each step up switches more attenuation in. Some bands have fewer steps — the driver clamps and keeps your choice for when you tune back, and the rail here ends at what the band the radio is on will take. A higher choice made on another band is kept and still shown beside it. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 步进式前端衰减：0 为最大增益，每增加一步接入更多衰减。部分波段步进更少，驱动会限制实际值，并保留你的选择以便调回原波段时恢复；滑轨上限为当前波段支持的值。在其他波段选择的更高值仍会保留并显示在旁边。立即生效。

source: Reference error in parts per million, applied by the device itself. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 参考时钟误差，单位为百万分之一（ppm），由设备自身应用。立即生效。

source: Which of the RSPduo's two tuners this radio listens on. The other one belongs to the radio configured for it — give that one the same receiver and the other tuner. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 此电台使用 RSPduo 的哪个调谐器。另一调谐器属于为其配置的电台；请为另一电台选择相同接收机和另一个调谐器。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Which of the RSPduo's two tuners carries the aerial you are listening to. The other one carries the second aerial. Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 正在收听的天线连接到 RSPduo 的哪个调谐器。另一个调谐器连接第二副天线。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Which of the RSPduo's two tuners to run (one at a time). Takes effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 运行 RSPduo 的哪个调谐器，每次仅运行一个。点击“应用”后生效。

source: Hardware notch over the 88–108 MHz broadcast band, for when a local transmitter overloads everything else. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 覆盖 88–108 MHz 广播波段的硬件陷波器，用于本地发射机使其他频段过载的情况。立即生效。

source:
One profile covers both. There is nothing to pick here — the radio names itself when the port opens.

This is the CAT half only: it drives the dial, the mode, PTT, the S-meter, the SWR and the transmit power over the rig's CAT USB port, and takes audio from its USB Audio port. The FDM-DUO's third USB port carries wideband I/Q, which this interface does not read — select the ELAD interface above for that.

Note the baud rate: menu 70 "CAT BAUD" on the radio must match, and it ships at 38400.

CW is keyed by the radio's own key or paddle. The FDM-DUO has no command that accepts text, so the CW panel cannot key it over CAT.
zh-CN:
同一配置覆盖 FDM-DUO 与 FDM-DUOr，打开端口时由电台自动报告型号，无需选择。

这里只处理 CAT：经 CAT USB 端口控制频率、模式、PTT、S 表、驻波比和发射功率，经 USB Audio 端口获取音频。FDM-DUO 的第三个 USB 端口提供宽带 I/Q，此接口不读取；如需使用，请在上方选择 ELAD 接口。

电台菜单 70“CAT BAUD”需与此处匹配，出厂值为 38400。

CW 由电台自身手键或桨键控制，FDM-DUO 没有接收文字的命令，因此 CW 面板不能通过 CAT 发报。

source: Hardware notch over the 165–230 MHz DAB band. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 覆盖 165–230 MHz DAB 波段的硬件陷波器。立即生效。

source:
The RSPdx's high-dynamic-range path for LF/MF. Applies immediately.

It does not work yet: on the one RSPdx it has been tried against, switching it on silences the receiver — at every centre, filter, port, gain and rate tried. Whatever the mode needs is not on the documented API surface, and finding it is somebody's next job. Leave this off unless you are the one looking.

What is known: it is not a mode that follows the dial. The path has a fixed analog filter, built only at the centres listed under the filter below, so tuning anywhere else could not work even once the rest does.
zh-CN:
RSPdx 用于 LF/MF 的高动态范围通路。立即生效。

此功能尚不能正常工作：在已测试的一台 RSPdx 上，无论尝试何种中心频率、滤波器、端口、增益或采样率，启用后都使接收机无信号。此模式所需条件未在公开 API 中说明，仍需进一步研究。除非参与调查，否则请保持关闭。

已知此模式不随调谐频率移动。该通路具有固定模拟滤波器，仅针对下方滤波器列出的中心频率设计，因此即使其他问题解决，也无法在别处调谐。

source:
The analog filter in front of the HDR path — a different control from the receiver's own bandwidth. Each setting is built at a fixed set of centres and can do nothing elsewhere; this one is built at {}. Applies immediately.

The path itself does not work yet — see the switch above — so this chooses a filter for a mode that is currently silent.
zh-CN:
HDR 通路前的模拟滤波器，与接收机自身带宽不同。各档只针对固定的一组中心频率设计，在其他频率无效；当前档适用于 {}。立即生效。

HDR 通路本身尚不能正常工作，见上方开关说明，因此当前是在为一个没有信号的模式选择滤波器。

source: An RSPduo is two whole tuners on one board, clocked from one reference. Run both and they hear their spans at the same instant from the same clock — which makes two aerials on them coherent, with a relative phase set by the feedlines rather than by chance, and lets the pair be combined. Or leave them apart: the tuners tune separately, so the other one can be a second radio on its own band.
zh-CN: RSPduo 在一块板上提供两个完整调谐器，共用参考时钟。同时运行时，两者以同一时钟在相同时刻接收各自频谱，使两副天线的信号相干，相对相位由馈线决定而非随机形成，因此可以合成。也可分别使用：调谐器能独立调谐，第二个可作为另一波段上的独立电台。

source: Puts the RSPduo in the API's dual-tuner mode, where the ADC is fixed at 6 MHz and the widest span is 2 Msps. Takes effect on Apply, because the mode is chosen when the device is opened.
zh-CN: 将 RSPduo 置于 API 双调谐器模式，ADC 固定为 6 MHz，最大频宽为 2 Msps。模式在打开设备时选定，因此点击“应用”后生效。

source: What the other tuner is for. Takes effect on Apply — like running both at all, this is chosen when the board is opened.
zh-CN: 第二个调谐器的用途。与启用双调谐器一样，在打开板卡时选定，因此点击“应用”后生效。

source: Add a second radio (Settings → Radio → +), give it this same receiver and the RSPduo's other tuner, and set it to run both tuners too — whichever radio opens the board puts it in dual-tuner mode, so both have to be expecting it. The two then tune independently: HF in one tab and VHF in the other, off one board. They share one ADC clock, so both run at the sample rate whichever radio opened the board asked for, and neither can transmit.
zh-CN: 添加第二台电台（设置 → 电台 → +），选择同一接收机和 RSPduo 的另一个调谐器，并同样启用双调谐器。任一电台打开板卡时都会进入双调谐器模式，因此两台必须设置一致。随后可独立调谐，例如同一板卡的一个标签页使用 HF，另一个使用 VHF。两者共用 ADC 时钟，采样率由先打开板卡的电台决定，均不能发射。

source: The second tuner's own front-end attenuation. Set so both aerials show about the same noise floor: this is the adjustment everything else rests on, because combining weights the two branches by their noise, and a second front end driven into overload hands the filter a distorted copy of the interference — which cannot be subtracted from an undistorted one. Applies immediately.
zh-CN: 第二个调谐器自身的前端衰减。请调至两副天线的底噪大致相同，这是后续调整的基础：合成会按两支路噪声加权，第二个前端若过载，会将失真的干扰交给滤波器，无法从未失真的支路中正确相减。立即生效。

source:
One profile covers the range: QRP Labs' own command set, which is a subset of the Kenwood TS-480's with a good deal added. There is nothing to pick here — the radio names itself and its firmware version when the port opens, and the version is what decides whether the SWR-protection read is asked for at all.

Not the Kenwood profile: on a QMX the PC command is the power METER rather than the power control, so a radio driven as a Kenwood would have its meter read written to as if it were a setting, and MD8 — a Kenwood mode — is SWR Tune here.

The transmit power is set at the radio. There is no CAT command for it, so the Drive slider only reaches the level of the audio going into the sound card.

The receive filter is the radio's too: it reports the width its mode implies (3.2 kHz in Digi, 300 Hz in CW) and offers nothing to change it with.
zh-CN:
同一配置覆盖 QRP Labs 系列，它使用 Kenwood TS-480 命令集的子集并增加了其他命令。打开端口时会报告型号及固件版本，无需选择；是否读取驻波保护状态也由固件版本决定。

请勿使用 Kenwood 配置：QMX 的 PC 命令读取功率表，而非设置功率；误用 Kenwood 配置会将它当作设置写入。Kenwood 的 MD8 模式命令在这里代表驻波比调谐。

发射功率需在电台设置，没有对应 CAT 命令；激励滑块只能控制输入声卡的音频电平。

接收滤波器也由电台决定，会报告模式对应的宽度（Digi 为 3.2 kHz，CW 为 300 Hz），不提供修改命令。

source: The second tuner's IF gain, in the RSP's native unit: 20 dB is maximum gain. Ignored while the AGC is running — and a steady gain is what the filter wants, so switching the AGC off is worth it for a null you intend to hold.
zh-CN: 第二个调谐器的中频增益，使用 RSP 原生单位，20 dB 为最大增益。AGC 运行时忽略此值。滤波器需要稳定增益，因此若要保持零陷，建议关闭 AGC。

source: One tap is a gain and a phase — a null at one frequency that gets worse either side of it, which is all an analogue phaser can do. Each further tap buys one sample period of the path difference between the two aerials that the filter can equalise, which is what turns that notch into a band quiet all the way across.
zh-CN: 一个抽头只能调整增益和相位，在一个频率产生零陷，两侧效果逐渐变差，与模拟移相器相同。每增加一个抽头，滤波器便可再均衡两副天线路径之间一个采样周期的时差，从而将单点陷波扩展为整个频带内的抑制。

source: Slow and steady at the left, converging inside a fraction of a second and visibly hunting at the right. Start fast to find the null, then hold it.
zh-CN: 左端缓慢而稳定，右端可在不到一秒内收敛，但会明显来回调整。先用高速寻找零陷，再启用保持。
