source: Stop the filter moving. Reach for this the moment a null appears: a filter left adapting will re-aim itself at whatever becomes loudest, which on a quiet band is the station you are listening to.
zh-CN: 停止滤波器调整。零陷出现后应立即使用：持续自适应的滤波器会转向当前最强的信号，在安静波段上可能就是正在收听的电台。

source: Nothing here can tell a wanted signal from an unwanted one — the filter only knows what the two aerials have in common. In Cancel, the second aerial wants to hear the noise source and as little of the band as possible, or it will dutifully cancel the station too. In Combine, both want to hear the same station. How deep the null is going runs to the log every few seconds.
zh-CN: 此处无法区分所需信号与干扰，滤波器只识别两副天线共有的成分。抵消模式下，第二副天线应主要接收噪声源，并尽量少接收波段信号，否则电台信号也会被抵消。合成模式下，两副天线应接收同一电台。零陷深度每隔几秒写入日志。

source: Not yet verified against an RSPduo: dual-tuner operation here is written from SDRplay's API rather than measured on the hardware.
zh-CN: 尚未经 RSPduo 实机验证：双调谐器功能依据 SDRplay API 编写，未在硬件上测量。

source: Only an RSPduo has a second tuner, and the receiver selected here is an {}, so this will do nothing.
zh-CN: 只有 RSPduo 有第二个调谐器，当前选择的接收机为 {}，因此此项无效。

source: No receiver is listed to check this against — press Rescan, or read the log for what actually opened.
zh-CN: 列表中没有可核对的接收机。请点击“重新扫描”，或查看日志了解实际打开的设备。

source: Bias tee is ON. Never connect a transceiver, a grounded antenna, or a preamp powered from elsewhere while this is enabled — the DC goes straight down the feedline.
zh-CN: 偏置供电已开启。启用时切勿连接收发信机、直流接地天线或由其他电源供电的前置放大器，因为直流电会直接进入馈线。

source: Receive only, 1 kHz–2 GHz. Needs the vendor's SDRplay API service (sdrplay.com/api) — the RSPs after the original RSP1 have no open protocol. Device, sample rate, bandwidth and RSPduo tuner take effect on Apply; everything else applies as you change it.
zh-CN: 仅接收，1 kHz–2 GHz。需要厂商 SDRplay API 服务（sdrplay.com/api），原始 RSP1 之后的型号没有开放协议。设备选择、采样率、带宽及 RSPduo 调谐器在点击“应用”后生效；其他设置随修改立即生效。

source:
A QMX serves its own virtual COM ports over USB, so the rate set above has no effect on either end. It offers up to three of them; if the radio answers nothing, the most likely reason is the wrong one.

One thing does matter about the port: a carriage return sent to it switches the radio into terminal mode for the rest of the session. sdroxide never sends one — but a terminal program left open on the same port will, and CAT stops working the moment it does.
zh-CN:
QMX 通过 USB 提供虚拟串口，因此上方波特率不影响通信。最多可提供三个端口；电台不响应时，最可能是选错端口。

向端口发送回车会使电台在本次会话剩余期间进入终端模式，CAT 随即停止。SDRoxide 不发送回车，但同时打开该端口的终端程序可能会发送。

source: Waiting for the configuration of the machine the radio is attached to.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供配置。

source: Both chains tune together — they share one synthesiser — but they are separate front ends on separate sockets. Pick the one your aerial is on, which is the setting to reach for when one chain has had the HF matching modification and the other is stock.
zh-CN: 两条通道共用一个频率合成器，因此同步调谐，但各自拥有独立前端和接口。请选择天线所接通道，尤其是一条通道做过 HF 匹配改装而另一条保持原装时。

source: One combined figure, which LimeSuite distributes across the LNA, the TIA and the PGA itself. It takes whole decibels, so anything finer is truncated.
zh-CN: 总增益值，由 LimeSuite 自行分配给 LNA、TIA 和 PGA。只接受整数 dB，更精细的数值会截断。

source:
The radio's sound card carries either demodulated audio or the raw I/Q its ADC sees, and sdroxide asserts whichever the Sound format above asks for when the port opens (the radio's Q9 command, the "IQ mode" menu entry).

The centre offset and sample rate above have been set to what a QMX needs: its receiver is a superhet with a 12 kHz I.F., so the synthesiser sits 12 kHz below the dial and everything on the card is 12 kHz above the middle of the span. The card runs at 48 kHz, which makes the panadapter 48 kHz wide.

In CW the radio moves that I.F. by a further ~700 Hz, which one figure cannot follow — add it by hand if you run the panadapter with the radio in CW. In Digi, where a radio used as an I/Q front end normally sits, there is nothing to add.

QRP Labs note that I/Q mode is not suitable for WSJT-X and other programs that expect demodulated audio; here the demodulation happens on this side, so it is.
zh-CN:
电台声卡可提供解调音频或 ADC 原始 I/Q。打开端口时，SDRoxide 按上方“音频格式”选择，对应 Q9 命令及“IQ mode”菜单。

中心偏移和采样率已按 QMX 设置：其超外差接收机使用 12 kHz 中频，合成器位于读数下方 12 kHz，声卡信号位于显示中心上方 12 kHz。声卡以 48 kHz 运行，因此频谱宽度为 48 kHz。

CW 模式还会使中频再偏移约 700 Hz，单一偏移值无法自动跟随；若在 CW 模式使用频谱，请手动加入此偏移。通常作为 I/Q 前端使用的 Digi 模式不需额外偏移。

QRP Labs 提醒 I/Q 模式不适合要求已解调音频的 WSJT-X 等程序；SDRoxide 在本机进行解调，因此可使用。

source: Automatic follows the frequency: LNAL low, LNAH high — unless a LimeRFE is connected below, which is one cable into one socket, and then it is LNAW at every frequency. Name the socket yours is wired to if it is not that one. Which chain the socket belongs to is the picker above.
zh-CN: 自动模式按频率选择：低频使用 LNAL，高频使用 LNAH。但若下方连接了 LimeRFE，它只通过一条线连接一个接口，因此所有频率均使用 LNAW。若实际接在其他接口，请明确选择；接口所属通道由上方选择器决定。

source: 0 follows the sample rate. Worth leaving there: a filter narrower than a quarter of the span silently withdraws the zero-IF LO offset, which puts the LO leakage back on top of the signal you are listening to.
zh-CN: 0 表示跟随采样率，建议保留此设置。滤波器窄于四分之一频宽时，会自动取消零中频本振偏移，使本振泄漏重新落在正在收听的信号上。

source: Adaptive image and DC removal on this side, on top of the chip's own calibration. Turning it off is the one-click way to tell a driver problem from a DSP one.
zh-CN: 在芯片自身校准基础上，于本机进一步自适应去除镜像和直流。关闭可快速区分驱动问题与 DSP 问题。

source: Runs the chip's own DC-offset and image calibration when the radio is opened, and again once the dial has settled on a new band or a different socket. Those numbers are measured at one frequency and are wrong elsewhere, which is what a carrier sitting in the middle of the span usually is. Costs about a second each time.
zh-CN: 打开电台时执行芯片自身的直流偏移及镜像校准，在调谐至新波段或切换接口并稳定后再次执行。校准值只在测量频率有效，其他频率会失准，频谱中心的固定载波通常由此产生。每次约需一秒。

source: Stalls the receiver for the better part of a second.
zh-CN: 会使接收机暂停接近一秒。

source: The board's other receive chain, on the {} sockets. It shares the synthesiser, so it hears the same span at the same instant as the first — which is what lets it carry a second aerial, or a sample of your own transmitter.
zh-CN: 板卡的另一条接收通道，使用 {} 接口。它与第一条共用频率合成器，在同一时刻接收相同频谱，因此可连接第二副天线或采样自身发射信号。

source: Set this LOW. The coupled sample of your own transmitter is a strong signal, and a feedback chain driven into compression measures the amplifier's curve wrongly — it teaches the correction its own distortion. Start at the bottom and use the coupler's attenuator.
zh-CN: 请将此值设低。耦合后的自身发射样本是强信号，反馈通道若进入压缩，会错误测量功放曲线，将自身失真教给校正器。请从最低值开始，并使用耦合器衰减器。

source: Set so both aerials show about the same noise floor. This is the adjustment the whole thing rests on: combining weights the two branches by their noise, and a second chain driven into compression hands the filter a distorted copy of the interference — which cannot be subtracted from an undistorted one.
zh-CN: 调至两副天线底噪大致相同，这是后续调整的基础：合成按两支路噪声加权，第二通道若进入压缩，会将失真的干扰交给滤波器，无法从未失真的支路中正确相减。

source: One tap is a gain and a phase — a null at one frequency that gets worse either side of it, which is all an analogue phaser can do. Each further tap buys one sample period of the path difference between the two aerials that the filter can equalise, which is what turns that notch into a band quiet all the way across.
zh-CN: 一个抽头只能调整增益和相位，在一个频率产生零陷，两侧效果逐渐变差，与模拟移相器相同。每增加一个抽头，滤波器便可再均衡两副天线路径之间一个采样周期的时差，从而将单点陷波扩展为整个频带内的抑制。

source: Slow and steady at the left, converging inside a fraction of a second and visibly hunting at the right. Start fast to find the null, then hold it.
zh-CN: 左端缓慢而稳定，右端可在不到一秒内收敛，但会明显来回调整。先用高速寻找零陷，再启用保持。

source:
HobbyPCB's RS-HFIQ. There is nothing to pick here: the profile is the whole of the radio's command set, and the firmware version is logged when the port opens.

The control link carries two things and no more — where to put the oscillator, and whether to transmit. There is no mode, power, filter, squelch or meter command, because the radio has none of them. Everything else is sdroxide's: what comes off the sound card is complex baseband centred on the dial, so the mode, the filter and the modulation all happen on this side.

The frequency command covers 3–30 MHz. Ask for anything outside that and the radio refuses it and stays where it is; the log says so.

CW is keyed as audio through the transmit chain — this radio has no keyer that takes text. (It has an internal CW generator; sdroxide never uses it, on the firmware's own advice.)
zh-CN:
HobbyPCB 的 RS-HFIQ 无需额外选择；此配置涵盖电台全部命令，打开端口时记录固件版本。

控制连接只设置振荡器频率及发射状态。电台没有模式、功率、滤波器、静噪或仪表命令。声卡输出以读数为中心的复基带，模式选择、滤波及调制都在 SDRoxide 中完成。

频率命令覆盖 3–30 MHz，范围之外的请求会被拒绝，电台保持原频率，并在日志记录。

CW 以音频经发射链键控，电台没有接收文字的键控器。虽然机内有 CW 发生器，但按固件建议，SDRoxide 不使用它。

source: Stop the filter moving. Reach for this the moment a null appears: a filter left adapting will re-aim itself at whatever becomes loudest, which on a quiet band is the station you are listening to.
zh-CN: 停止滤波器调整。零陷出现后应立即使用：持续自适应的滤波器会转向当前最强的信号，在安静波段上可能就是正在收听的电台。

source: How finely the correction follows the amplifier's curve. More steps track a sharper knee, but each one has to be learned from the samples that landed in it — and the top of a speech amplitude histogram is thin. Thirty-two is enough for the smooth curve an HF amplifier actually has. Changing it starts the correction again.
zh-CN: 校正跟踪放大器曲线的精细程度。步数越多，越能跟踪陡峭拐点，但每步都需从落入该区间的样本学习，而语音幅度分布的最高端样本很少。HF 放大器的平滑曲线使用 32 步已足够。修改后会重新学习校正。

source: How hard each block of feedback moves the correction. An amplifier's curve does not change, so there is no need to hurry — the middle averages several overs' worth of noise out of it.
zh-CN: 每块反馈数据改变校正的强度。放大器曲线通常不变，无需快速调整；中间设置可将多次发射中的噪声平均掉。

source: Keep the correction as it is. A curve learned on a clean over is worth holding, and the amplifier will not have changed by the next one.
zh-CN: 保持当前校正。一次干净发射中学得的曲线值得保留，下一次发射前放大器通常不会改变。

source: A directional coupler on the amplifier's output goes into this chain, and the transmitter compares what came back with what it meant to send — then sends the inverse of the difference, so what leaves the amplifier is straight. Twenty-odd decibels less intermodulation on other people's QSOs, with the amplifier keeping its power. The correction stays at unity until the feedback lines up with the transmission, so a coupler that is not connected costs nothing; and it can never ask the converter for more than full scale, so a feedback path reading nonsense cannot over-drive anything. How it is getting on runs to the log while you transmit.
zh-CN: 将功放输出的定向耦合器接入此通道，发射机比较反馈与预期发送信号，再发送差异的逆校正，使功放输出线性化。在保留功放功率的同时，可减少约二十多 dB 的互调，减轻对其他通联的干扰。反馈与发射对齐前，校正保持单位增益，因此未接耦合器不会影响信号；校正也不会要求转换器超过满量程，异常反馈不会导致过驱动。发射时校正状态会写入日志。

source: Nothing here can tell a wanted signal from an unwanted one — the filter only knows what the two aerials have in common. In Cancel, the second aerial wants to hear the noise source and as little of the band as possible, or it will dutifully cancel the station too. In Combine, both want to hear the same station. How deep the null is going runs to the log every few seconds.
zh-CN: 此处无法区分所需信号与干扰，滤波器只识别两副天线共有的成分。抵消模式下，第二副天线应主要接收噪声源，并尽量少接收波段信号，否则电台信号也会被抵消。合成模式下，两副天线应接收同一电台。零陷深度每隔几秒写入日志。

source: With this off the interface publishes no transmit channel at all, so nothing can key the radio.
zh-CN: 关闭时接口不提供任何发射通道，因此无法启动电台发射。

source: The board's two transmit sockets are two different matching networks, not two jacks onto the same one: BAND1 (TX_1) carries 30 MHz to 1.9 GHz and BAND2 (TX_2) is the 13 cm port. Keying an amateur band below 23 cm out of BAND2 puts the over into a matching network that passes almost none of it — every setting reads correct, the drive is whatever you set, and the power meter stays at zero. Leave this on Automatic and it follows the dial.
zh-CN: 板卡的两个发射接口对应不同的匹配网络：BAND1（TX_1）覆盖 30 MHz–1.9 GHz，BAND2（TX_2）用于 13 cm 波段。若从 BAND2 发射低于 23 cm 波段的业余频率，匹配网络几乎无法通过信号；即使所有设置看似正确、驱动电平正常，功率表仍为零。保持“自动”即可跟随调谐频率选择。

source: Sound format, baud and PTT are the radio's, not settings
zh-CN: 音频格式、波特率和 PTT 由电台规定，不能任意选择

source: Transmit gain is {:.0} dB, at the bottom of its range — a few microwatts out of the board, which will read as nothing on a power meter whatever is downstream of it. That is the default so that an armed transmitter cannot surprise you; raise it before you key.
zh-CN: 发射增益为 {:.0} dB，处于范围最低端，板卡仅输出数微瓦，无论后接何种设备，功率表都可能读为零。默认使用此值以避免允许发射后出现意外输出；启动发射前请提高增益。

source: A LimeSDR transmits from about 100 kHz to 3.8 GHz with no filtering of its own. Use a low-pass filter, an appropriate LimeRFE channel, or a dummy load.
zh-CN: LimeSDR 可在约 100 kHz–3.8 GHz 发射，自身没有滤波。请使用低通滤波器、合适的 LimeRFE 通道或假负载。

source:
All three have been filled in and none of them is a preference:

• Sound format is I/Q (stereo) — the card carries complex baseband and nothing else.
• 57600 baud, 8N1 — the firmware's one rate, with no menu to change it. Any other is a silent link, so it is pinned when the port opens.
• PTT over CAT — the *X command is the only transmit switch the interface has.

The centre offset has been set to zero: the synthesiser runs at four times the dial into a quadrature detector, so the middle of the span is the dial. Set the sample rate above to whatever your sound card is actually running at; that is what makes the panadapter as wide as it is.
zh-CN:
以下三项已固定为电台要求的值：

• 音频格式为立体声 I/Q，声卡只传输复基带。
• 57600 波特率、8N1，固件只有这一速率，没有切换菜单。其他速率无法通信，因此打开端口时固定使用此值。
• CAT PTT：*X 命令是此接口唯一的发射开关。

中心偏移设为 0：合成器以读数频率的四倍驱动正交检波器，所以显示中心就是读数。请将上方采样率设为声卡实际速率，以确定频谱宽度。

source: The LimeRFE's own micro-USB port, not the radio's. 9600 baud, fixed by its firmware.
zh-CN: LimeRFE 自身的 micro-USB 端口，而非电台端口。波特率由固件固定为 9600。

source: Switch the filters to match the operating frequency, before any RF appears. Tuning within one band puts nothing on the control link.
zh-CN: 射频输出前，先按工作频率切换滤波器。同一波段内调谐不会产生控制链路流量。

source: Worth having on for any sustained transmitting.

On Automatic the board receives, and is switched to transmit at key-down and back at key-up — on either cabling. Its amateur channels have one filter with a transmit/receive switch either side of it, so a board asked for both at once puts that switch on the transmitter and stops hearing anything. The 30 MHz channel is reachable only through J5, which is one connector for both directions; above it, transmitting from J4 keeps the receive path off the connector the amplifier is driving.
zh-CN: 自动模式下，板卡平时接收，电键按下时切换发射、松开时恢复接收，两种接线均如此。业余波段通道的滤波器两侧都有收发开关，要求同时收发时开关会接向发射机，使接收无信号。30 MHz 通道只能通过收发共用的 J5 访问；更高频率从 J4 发射时，接收路径会避开功放正在驱动的接口。

source:
DL2MAN/PE1NNZ's pocket QRP transceiver and the open uSDX firmware it grew from. It emulates a Kenwood TS-480, but the subset is thin: the dial, the mode, PTT and RIT/XIT clear are all it answers. No S-meter, no SWR, no power control, no VFO B, no split and no CAT keyer, so the Drive slider and the meters do nothing over CAT — the audio level is the only transmit control there is.

CW is keyed as audio (MCW) through the sideband, or with the key or paddle at the radio; there is no command that takes text.
zh-CN:
DL2MAN／PE1NNZ 的口袋 QRP 收发机及其基础 open uSDX 固件，模拟 Kenwood TS-480，但只响应频率、模式、PTT 及 RIT／XIT 清除。没有 S 表、驻波比、功率控制、VFO B、异频收发或 CAT 文字键控，所以激励滑块和仪表不能通过 CAT 控制；发射只能调节音频电平。

CW 可通过边带发送音频键控（MCW），或使用电台手键／桨键；没有接受文字的命令。

source: LimeSDR support has not been verified against hardware. This is the last session's trace, for an issue report.
zh-CN: LimeSDR 支持尚未经硬件验证。此处为上次会话跟踪，用于问题报告。

source: Gains, filters, corrections, the antenna sockets and every LimeRFE control — its connectors, band, relays, attenuator, notch and fan — apply immediately. The board, the receive chain, the sample rate, arming transmit and the LimeRFE's connection take effect on Apply.
zh-CN: 增益、滤波器、校正、天线接口，以及 LimeRFE 的全部控制（接口、波段、继电器、衰减器、陷波器和风扇）立即生效。板卡选择、接收通道、采样率、允许发射及 LimeRFE 连接在点击“应用”后生效。

source:
A (tr)uSDX has no sound card of its own and two ways to be heard, and which is right is a fact about your shack rather than the radio.

"One cable" takes the audio inside the CAT serial link itself — the radio's own 8-bit stream, over the same USB cable as the control, with nothing else to plug in. The catch is the firmware: it cannot take a CAT command while its stream is running (a command sent into the stream does not pause it, it kills it), so this mode never polls. Tuning and mode changes are sent as you make them, each pausing the stream for a moment and starting it again, so expect a brief gap on each change; nothing is sent while you are simply listening. The radio's own dial and mode are not followed either — there is no read to follow them with — so drive it from here.

"USB sound card" takes the audio from an external sound card wired to the radio's 3.5 mm speaker/mic jack, and behaves as any other CAT rig: the dial poll runs, so the radio's own knob and mode are followed. Pick the card under Radio audio below.

Both modes open the port with DTR held high: the serial adapter's DTR is wired to the radio's reset, so opening the port reboots it and the first second or two is quiet while it comes up. DTR is never used to key.
zh-CN:
(tr)uSDX 没有内置声卡，可用两种方式获取音频，请根据台站接线选择。

“单线连接”将电台的 8 位音频流放在 CAT 串口中，与控制共用一根 USB 线，无需其他连接。但固件在音频流运行时不能处理 CAT 命令，直接发送命令会终止音频流，因此此模式不轮询。每次调谐或模式变化时，软件短暂暂停音频流、发送命令再恢复，会有短暂中断；单纯收听时不发送控制命令，也不跟随电台自身旋钮及模式。

“USB 声卡”使用连接电台 3.5 mm 扬声器／麦克风插口的外置声卡，按普通 CAT 电台工作。轮询会跟随电台自身旋钮和模式，请在下方电台音频中选择声卡。

两种方式均在打开端口时保持 DTR 高电平。串口适配器的 DTR 连接电台复位脚，因此打开端口会重启电台，最初一两秒没有音频。DTR 不用于启动发射。

source:
Which Icom, for the two things CI-V does not do the same way on all of them.

The transceiver address below is filled in from it: every model ships with a different one, and a frame sent to the wrong address is simply ignored — a radio that answers nothing, with no error anywhere to say why.

It also decides whether sdroxide can select DATA mode. On CI-V, USB and USB-DATA are the same mode byte and a separate command tells them apart; without it a digital-mode over goes out through the microphone input, with the rig's speech processing and SSB filter in the path.

"Other" leaves the address to you and sends no DATA-mode command at all.
zh-CN:
选择 Icom 型号，用于确定 CI-V 在不同型号上不一致的两项行为。

下方收发机地址根据型号填写。不同型号出厂地址不同，地址错误的帧会被直接忽略，表现为电台完全无响应且没有错误提示。

型号还决定是否能选择 DATA 模式。CI-V 的 USB 与 USB-DATA 使用相同模式字节，由独立命令区分；没有该命令时，数字音频会经麦克风路径、话音处理及 SSB 滤波器发射。

“其他”由用户指定地址，且不发送 DATA 模式命令。

source:
Streams the radio's own scope sweep over the CI-V link and draws it as the panadapter — the only picture of the band a demod-audio rig can give, since the audio it sends is what already came through its filter.

Needs the radio set up for it: CI-V USB Baud Rate to 115200 and CI-V USB Port to "Unlink from [REMOTE]" (both under SET > Connectors > CI-V), and the baud rate above set to match — below {CAT_SCOPE_MIN_BAUD} the sweeps do not fit down the link and the scope stays off.

The sweeps share the radio's internal USB bus with its own sound card. If received audio starts to drop out with the scope on, this box is the first thing to try turning off.
zh-CN:
通过 CI-V 传输电台自身频谱扫描并绘制为频谱显示。已解调音频的电台输出经过接收滤波器，无法从音频恢复全波段，因此只能使用此扫描。

请在电台 SET > Connectors > CI-V 中将 CI-V USB Baud Rate 设为 115200，将 CI-V USB Port 设为“Unlink from [REMOTE]”，并使上方波特率一致。低于 {CAT_SCOPE_MIN_BAUD} 时，带宽不足，频谱保持关闭。

频谱与声卡共用电台内部 USB 总线。开启后接收音频掉音时，请优先尝试关闭此项。

source: How wide to sweep it. The radio keeps whatever span was last chosen on its own screen — often a few kHz. Setting a span here also puts the scope into centre mode, so it follows the dial. It changes the radio's own display too; "As set on the radio" leaves it alone.
zh-CN: 频谱扫描宽度。电台会保留自身屏幕上最后选择的范围，通常仅几 kHz。这里设置范围时也会启用中心模式，使频谱跟随频率读数，并改变电台自身显示。“按电台当前设置”不做修改。

source: Waiting for the sound cards on the machine the radio is plugged into.
zh-CN: 正在等待连接电台的电脑提供声卡列表。

source: This driver publishes no settings of its own.
zh-CN: 此驱动未提供独立设置项。

source: This rig has no software-adjustable gains.
zh-CN: 此电台没有可通过软件调整的增益。
发射（电脑 → 电台麦克风）

source: Zero the filter and find the null again.
zh-CN: 将滤波器归零，重新寻找消零点。

source: LCUS is the four-byte A0-command board sold under a dozen names; KMtronic and Numato can also be asked what they are set to
zh-CN: LCUS 为采用四字节 A0 命令、以多种品牌销售的继电器板；KMtronic 和 Numato 还支持读取当前状态。

source: Pin 3 on every homebrew plan and every commercial board — it is the one at the end of the package that a wire can be tacked to. If the relay does not click, the card is a clone that does not implement these pins at all.
zh-CN: 常见自制电路及商用板卡使用芯片末端可焊接引线的第 3 脚。若继电器不动作，可能是该仿制板未实现这些引脚。

source: Linux only. `gpiodetect` lists the chips on the machine.
zh-CN: 仅适用于 Linux，可用 gpiodetect 列出电脑上的 GPIO 芯片。

source: Starting a program costs an unpredictable amount of time, and none of it is counted in the lead — so leave a wider margin here than you would for a relay board. The contact table's numbers mean nothing for this link: your commands are run once on key-down and once on key-up.
zh-CN: 启动外部程序的耗时不确定，且不计入提前量；请比直接使用继电器板预留更长时间。此连接方式不使用接点表中的数值，发射启动与结束时各运行一次命令。

source: Contact 1 is RTS and contact 2 is DTR.
zh-CN: 接点 1 为 RTS，接点 2 为 DTR。

source: The line's offset on this chip — the BCM number on a Raspberry Pi header, which is not the physical pin number
zh-CN: 此芯片上的线路编号。树莓派填写 BCM 编号，而非接头的物理针脚编号。

source: Decides the default timings and what the log calls it — and, for a band decoder, that the contact follows the band table below
zh-CN: 决定默认时序和日志名称；波段译码接点还会跟随下方波段表。

source:
On: transmitting energises the coil. Off: transmitting releases it.

This is a wiring decision before it is a setting — see the note below.
zh-CN:
开启：发射时线圈通电。关闭：发射时线圈释放。

请先根据接线决定此选项，详见下方说明。

source: How long before RF this contact moves from its band's RX word to its TX word. A retune moves it at once; this is for key-down, when a transmit-only filter has to be in circuit before the power is.
zh-CN: 射频输出前，此触点提前多久从当前波段的接收位状态切换为发射位状态。重新调谐会立即切换；此延迟用于启动发射，确保发射专用滤波器在功率输出前接入。

source: Closed this long before RF. A small coax relay throws in 5 to 15 ms. Transmit waits for the longest of these, so a large value is an audible gap in the receive audio; anything over 250 ms is ignored.
zh-CN: 在射频输出前提前此时间闭合。小型同轴继电器切换约需 5–15 ms。发射会等待各触点中最长的提前时间，因此设置较大会使接收音频出现明显间隙。界面可设 0–200 ms；发射前的等待时间上限为 250 ms。

source: How long after RF stops this contact goes back from its TX word to its RX word.
zh-CN: 射频停止后，此触点延迟多久从发射位状态恢复至接收位状态。

source: Opened this long after RF stops. Longer than the lead on purpose: letting the antenna back a moment late costs nothing, and letting it back early costs a front end. Zero is a real answer, and the right one for an amplifier's key line.
zh-CN: 射频停止后延迟此时间断开。此值有意长于提前时间：天线稍晚恢复不会造成损失，过早恢复却可能损坏接收前端。0 是有效值，也适合功放键控线。

source: Not while the station is on the air
zh-CN: 台站正在发射时不可测试

source: Close this contact for half a second, so you can hear the relay and check the wiring with the transmitter cold
zh-CN: 发射机不输出时，将此触点闭合半秒，以听到继电器动作并检查接线

source: A switch that exists to protect a receiver is not worth having if it silently stops protecting it — so refusing is the default. Choose the other where a loose USB cable ending your contest is the worse outcome.
zh-CN: 用于保护接收机的切换器失效时应明确阻止发射，因此默认拒绝发射。只有在 USB 线松动导致比赛中断的后果更严重时，才选择继续。

source: The order is the timings: the longest lead closes first, and the longest hold opens last. So give the antenna relay the longer lead and the longer hold, and the amplifier the shorter of each — then the antenna is always switched before the amplifier is keyed, and the amplifier always unkeys before the antenna comes back.
zh-CN: 动作顺序由时序决定：提前量最长的最先闭合，保持时间最长的最后断开。天线继电器使用较长提前量和保持时间，放大器使用较短值，即可先切换天线再启动放大器，先停止放大器再恢复天线。

source: When a transceiver keys itself — its own microphone button, foot switch, VOX or keyer — sdroxide finds out by asking over CAT, and that answer arrives a few hundred milliseconds into the over. Wire the rig's SEND line, through an opto-isolator, into a handshake input on this same port and it is seen in a few milliseconds instead. The meter and the transmit interlock get faster with it.
zh-CN: 电台通过自身麦克风、脚踏开关、VOX 或键控器启动发射时，SDRoxide 需通过 CAT 查询，通常延迟数百毫秒。将电台 SEND 信号经光耦接入同一串口的握手输入，可缩短至几毫秒，功率表和发射联锁也会更快响应。

source: Most opto-isolated interfaces pull the line down when the rig keys, so this is usually off
zh-CN: 多数光耦接口在电台发射时拉低线路，因此此项通常关闭。

source: Which radio tab the sensed transceiver is. On a station with one radio this is 1 and nothing depends on it.
zh-CN: 选择被检测的收发机所属标签页。单电台台站使用 1，此项不影响其他功能。

source: Needs a serial port — the handshake lines are on it.
zh-CN: 需要串口，握手信号位于串口接口上。

source: Wiring is the only fail-safe that survives this program.
zh-CN: 可靠接线是程序停止运行后仍有效的故障保护。

source: Choose “TX closes” so that the *de-energised* contact is the state you want when the board is unplugged, the computer is off, or sdroxide is not running. Wired so that de-energised means grounded, a dead relay leaves the SDR deaf — annoying, and safe. Wired the other way, a dead relay plus one transmission is a dead front end. With a real amplifier behind it, take the first.
zh-CN: 设置“发射时闭合”时，应确保板卡拔出、电脑关机或 SDRoxide 停止运行时，继电器失电状态仍能保护接收机。失电时天线接地，故障仅导致无法接收；反向接线时，继电器失效后的一次发射就可能损坏前端。连接真实放大器时，应采用前者。

source: This cannot protect the first instant of an over you start at the radio. Key the rig from sdroxide and the contacts always lead the RF; wire the sense input above and they follow within milliseconds. For a front end genuinely worth protecting, use an RF-sensed hardware T/R switch as well — no program on a computer can be the whole answer.
zh-CN: 此功能无法保护由电台自身启动发射的最初瞬间。从 SDRoxide 启动时，接点先于射频动作；连接上方检测输入后，可在几毫秒内跟随。重要接收前端还应使用射频检测式硬件收发切换器，电脑程序不能独立承担全部保护。

source: Closes a contact while this station transmits — to disconnect and ground the SDR's antenna input, and to key an amplifier or an outboard T/R relay in sequence with it. Works with the cheap USB relay boards (LCUS, KMtronic, Numato), with a serial RTS/DTR line into any interface that wants a PTT closure, and with anything else through a command hook.
zh-CN: 本站发射时闭合接点，以断开并接地 SDR 天线输入，并按时序控制放大器或外置收发继电器。支持 LCUS、KMtronic、Numato 等 USB 继电器板、向接口提供 PTT 闭合信号的串口 RTS／DTR，以及通过命令钩子控制的其他设备。

source: The station is on the air — APPLY will take effect after this over.
zh-CN: 本站正在发射，“应用”将在本次发射结束后生效。

source: One control word per band: bit 0 is contact 1, bit 1 contact 2 and so on, matching the numbering above. RX follows the receive dial's band; TX the band of whichever radio keyed, switched in on each contact's lead before RF and back after its hold — give them the same value for a filter that does not care which way the RF is going, and different ones for a receive-only preamp bypass or a transmit-only LPF bank. Bands left at 0 assert nothing. Applies on Apply / reconnect.
zh-CN: 每个波段使用一个控制字：位 0 对应接点 1，位 1 对应接点 2，依次类推。接收状态跟随接收读数波段，发射状态跟随实际启动发射的电台波段，并按每个接点的提前量在射频前切换、保持时间后恢复。双向滤波器可为接收和发射填相同值；仅接收的前放旁路或仅发射的低通滤波器组填不同值。0 不使任何接点有效。点击“应用／重新连接”后生效。

source: Everywhere outside the amateur bands — short-wave listening, and anything a transverter's dial lands on that no band covers.
zh-CN: 业余波段之外的所有频率，包括短波收听及变频收发器读数落入的未定义波段。

source: Drive an sdroxide running somewhere else — the shack machine, a remote site — over the network. Start it there with --server, and enter its address here. The radio, the decoders and the logbook stay on that machine; this screen gets the waterfall and the audio, and its speakers and microphone are the ones you use.
zh-CN: 通过网络操作其他地点运行的 SDRoxide，例如电台机房或远程站点。在远端使用 --server 启动，然后在此输入地址。电台、解码器和通联日志仍在远端运行；本界面接收瀑布图与音频，使用本机的扬声器和麦克风。
主机名或 IP 地址

source: Open this station as a radio tab of its own
zh-CN: 在独立电台标签页中打开本站

source: The machine running sdroxide --server: a host name, an IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a complete ws:// (or wss://) URL if the server sits behind a reverse proxy — a URL is used exactly as typed and ignores the port and the switch below.
zh-CN: 运行 sdroxide --server 的机器：可输入主机名、IPv4 或 IPv6 地址；若服务器位于反向代理之后，也可输入完整的 ws:// 或 wss:// URL。URL 将按原样使用，忽略下方的端口和安全连接开关。

source: The port that server listens on — server_port in its config.toml. 4950 unless it was given --port.
zh-CN: 服务器监听端口，即 config.toml 中的 server_port。默认 4950；启动时可通过 --port 指定。

source:
The station appears as a tab beside the radios already open here, and the tab strip at the top of the window switches between them (⊞ puts two side by side). Close it from the roster at the top of the Radio tab — that hangs up; nothing on the server is changed.

If the server asks for a username and password, its sign-in screen comes up in the new tab. A plain ws:// link carries none of this encrypted, so across the open internet either put it through a VPN or an SSH tunnel, or terminate HTTPS in front of the server and tick Secure above.
zh-CN:
本站将在现有电台旁新增标签页，使用窗口顶端的标签栏切换；⊞ 可并排显示两台。要关闭连接，请在“电台”标签页顶部的列表中关闭该电台；这只断开本机连接，不修改服务器。

若服务器要求用户名和密码，新标签页会显示登录界面。普通 ws:// 不加密这些信息；经公网连接时，请使用 VPN 或 SSH 隧道，或在服务器前配置 HTTPS 终止代理，并勾选上方的“安全连接”。

source: This client cannot hold a second connection.
zh-CN: 此客户端无法保持第二个连接。

source: Tick this where the server sits behind something that terminates HTTPS for it — a reverse proxy on port 443, which is the usual way a station is reached across the open internet. sdroxide's own server speaks plain ws:// and does not want this.
zh-CN: 服务器位于 HTTPS 终止代理（通常是公网访问使用的 443 端口反向代理）之后时，请勾选。SDRoxide 自带服务器使用普通 ws://，直接连接时不应勾选。

source: 12060 is the port N1MM's documentation recommends
127.0.0.1 reaches clients on this machine; a LAN address or a multicast group (224.0.0.1) reaches others
zh-CN: 127.0.0.1 供本机客户端使用；局域网地址或组播地址（224.0.0.1）可供其他机器接收

source:
Where signals are actually getting through, band by band. Every reception this station takes part in — WSPR, FT8/FT4, JS8, and the logbook — is placed at the midpoint of its path, which is the patch of ionosphere that bent it, rather than at the far station. So this is a map of the sky, not of where radio amateurs live.

It can only show paths this station has been one end of. Oceans light up because the midpoints of long paths fall there; Antarctica stays dark because nobody is transmitting from it. Off by default — it paints the whole planet.
zh-CN:
按波段显示信号实际能够传播到哪些区域。本站参与的每次接收，包括 WSPR、FT8/FT4、JS8 和日志中的通联，均绘制在传播路径的中点，即使信号发生折射的电离层区域，而非对方台站所在地。因此，这是一张天空传播图。

source: The other seven planets, eighteen of their moons, and Saturn's and Uranus's rings. Planet positions come from JPL's Keplerian element set; the moons are circular orbits fitted to JPL Horizons.
zh-CN: 其余七颗行星、它们的十八颗卫星，以及土星环和天王星环。行星位置采用 JPL 开普勒轨道根数；卫星采用根据 JPL Horizons 数据拟合的圆轨道。

source: Award coverage: every DXCC entity painted by what your logbook is still missing. Orange burns where you have never worked the entity, amber where you have but it is unconfirmed, dim green where a QSL has come back. Follows the band filter in the AWARDS window.
zh-CN: 奖状覆盖情况：按日志中仍缺少的通联或确认状态为每个 DXCC 实体着色。橙色表示从未通联，琥珀色表示已通联但未确认，暗绿色表示已收到 QSL 确认。使用奖状窗口中的波段筛选条件。

zh-CN: 在主窗口跟踪此卫星：接收和发射多普勒校正、按转发器映射上行频率，以及天线旋转器控制

source: Paint the globe by what is getting through
zh-CN: 按实际传播情况为地球着色

source: Paints the globe by what is getting through, on each band. Every reception is placed at the midpoint of its path — where the ionosphere did the work — rather than at the far station. Built from what this station hears, plus the world's skimmers when the Reverse Beacon Network is switched on.
zh-CN: 按各波段的实际传播情况为地球着色。每次接收标在路径中点，即电离层起作用的位置，而非远端台站。数据来自本站接收结果；开启反向信标网络后，还会加入全球自动监听站的数据。

source: Every band at once, one hue each, mixing where two overlap. The view for 'what are conditions like' rather than 'is twenty open'.
zh-CN: 同时显示所有波段，每个波段使用一种色调，重叠处混色。用于查看整体传播状况，而非仅判断 20 米波段是否开通。

source: One band, cold to hot: blue, green, yellow, red.
zh-CN: 显示一个波段，由冷到热依次为蓝、绿、黄、红。

source: Contacts in the logbook. A path that was open, with no signal report worth the name — an RST is not an SNR, so these count towards how busy a cell is and never towards its margin.
zh-CN: 日志中的通联记录。这表示路径曾经开通，但没有可用于余量计算的信号报告：RST 不是信噪比，因此此类记录只计入网格活动量，不计入余量。

source: Stations that reported hearing this one, downloaded from WSPRnet. The only feedback a transmitting beacon ever gets.
zh-CN: 从 WSPRnet 下载的接收报告，表示哪些台站收到了本站；这是发射信标获得反馈的唯一方式。

source: Reverse Beacon Network skimmers: what everyone else is hearing, on every band, including the ones this radio is not on. Coarser than the rest — an RBN line carries no locators, so both ends are placed at their country's centre, which is close for a small country and badly out for a large one. Switch on under Settings → Spots.
zh-CN: 反向信标网络自动监听站的数据：其他台站在各波段接收的信号，包括本电台当前未监听的波段。精度低于其他来源，因为 RBN 记录没有网格定位，路径两端均置于各自国家的中心；小国家的误差较小，大国家则可能偏差很大。在“设置 → 接收报告”中开启。

source: Decodes this station made. Each is measured against its own mode's floor, so a WSPR report and an FT4 one are comparable.
zh-CN: 本站的解码结果。每条记录都按自身模式的接收门限衡量，因此 WSPR 和 FT4 的信号报告可以比较。

source: How long a reception takes to count for half as much. The ionosphere's own memory is short — an opening two hours old should not be arguing with one from two minutes ago.
zh-CN: 一条接收记录的权重降至一半所需的时间。电离层状态变化快，两小时前的开通记录不应与两分钟前的记录具有同样的影响。

zh-CN: 按住时发射；单击可锁定发射，再次按下停止发射

source: How many signals the model reads at once. The rest keep their marker but carry no text.
zh-CN: 模型同时读取的信号数量。其余信号保留标记，但不显示文本。

zh-CN: 通联日志、通报、奖项、记忆信道、扫描器、设置和手册

zh-CN: 话音降噪已关闭，点击选择引擎

zh-CN: 每次启动发射时先发送音频脉冲

source: Passband width in hertz — type it, or drag. Click into the field to enter an exact figure.
zh-CN: 通带宽度，单位为 Hz；可以输入或拖动调整。点击输入框可输入精确数值。

source: Public SDRs on the internet — browse the KiwiSDR and SpyServer directories and open one as a radio
zh-CN: 互联网公共 SDR：浏览 KiwiSDR 和 SpyServer 目录，并作为电台打开

source: RDS data is arriving — click to see it
zh-CN: 正在接收 RDS 数据，点击查看

source: RDS — no data on this station. Click anyway for the decoder's diagnostics
zh-CN: 此电台没有 RDS 数据，仍可点击查看解码器诊断信息

source: RDS: {ps}. Click for the station's data
Read this machine and this screen, take the most they can carry, and follow them if they change
zh-CN: 按当前机器和屏幕的能力选择最高可用精细度，并随其变化自动调整

source: Front-end decimation: the receiver is being given the middle 1/{now} of the {:.3} Msps this radio streams — {span} — and the rest is thrown away before any of it reaches the receiver.
zh-CN: 前端抽取：接收机只接收数据流中心的 1/{now}。电台输出 {:.3} Msps，抽取后保留 {span}；其余部分在进入接收机之前被丢弃。

source: Front-end decimation, off: the receiver sees the whole {span} this radio streams.
zh-CN: 前端抽取已关闭：接收机接收电台数据流的全部 {span} 带宽。

source: Front-end RX gain ({}). Too much clips the receiver's ADC and smears spurious signals across the band; too little and it goes deaf.
zh-CN: 接收前端增益（{}）。过高会使接收机的 ADC 削波，并在频段内产生杂散信号；过低则会降低接收灵敏度。

source: Counted in steps, not decibels: what one step is worth is the receiver's own business, and on an SDRplay it depends on the band as well. Right is still more gain.
zh-CN: 此值按档位计数，单位并非分贝：每档的增益由接收机决定，SDRplay 的每档增益还随波段变化。向右调整仍表示增加增益。

source: The PlutoSDR's own AGC is setting this gain, so moving the slider does nothing. Set Settings → Radio → AGC to Manual to control it here.
zh-CN: PlutoSDR 自身的 AGC 正在控制此增益，因此移动滑条不会生效。请在“设置 → 电台 → AGC”中选择“手动”，再在此调整。

source: The passband is at {p:.0} dBFS now.
{label} in each ear — {plo:.0} … {phi:.0} Hz, both sidebands
zh-CN: 每只耳朵的带宽为 {label} — {plo:.0} … {phi:.0} Hz，覆盖两个边带

source: How quickly the spectrum line follows the band. Slower averages more frames into each other: a steadier line, and a weak carrier that stands still long enough to read. The waterfall is not touched by it — those rows get every frame either way.
zh-CN: 频谱线跟随信号变化的速度。较慢时会对更多帧求平均，曲线更稳定，也更容易读取保持在同一频率的微弱载波。此项不影响瀑布图；瀑布图仍使用每一帧。

source: How fast the waterfall scrolls, in lines a second: Slow 5, Medium 28, Fast 56, Faster 112, Fastest 224. The engine clocks these itself, so the two fastest are real detail rather than the same line drawn twice — as far as the receiver can feed them: a line can never show more than one transform, and a narrow front end makes only a few dozen a second. They cost history, since the waterfall keeps a fixed number of lines — 73 seconds at Medium, 9 at Fastest.
zh-CN: 瀑布图滚动速度，单位为行／秒：慢 5、中 28、快 56、更快 112、最快 224。引擎自行控制绘制时序，最高两档显示新的频谱细节，但受接收机的数据供给限制；每行最多对应一次变换，窄带前端每秒只能提供数十次变换。瀑布图保存的行数固定，提高速度会缩短历史时长：中速约 73 秒，最快约 9 秒。

source: One trace per remembered spectrum, in the flat line's own colour, each hiding the ones behind it. The shape without the levels, and the reading to pick when the shape is what you are after — it costs a little more than the solid one rather than less, because it draws the same surface and then strokes every crest on top of it.
zh-CN: 每帧历史频谱绘制一条曲线，颜色与平面频谱线相同，并遮挡后方曲线。侧重显示形状，电平不通过颜色表示。此样式先绘制表面再描绘各条波峰，因此开销略高于实体样式。

source: A filled surface coloured by the waterfall's palette, so the level is in the colour as well as in the height and the two halves of the panadapter agree about what a strong signal looks like. Change the palette in Settings › Display.

Controlled-envelope SSB: more average power for the same peak, without splatter — three or four decibels of apparent loudness at the far end. How many decibels the voice is driven into the processor; 0 is off, 6 is a sensible first try. It does not touch Drive.

Now: {}

受控包络 SSB：在相同峰值下提高平均功率并抑制杂散展宽，对端感受到的响度可提高约三至四分贝。此值表示语音送入处理器时的驱动量，单位为分贝；0 表示关闭，可先尝试 6。此项不改变发射驱动设置。

source:
Deviation: how far this mode's burst swings a radio that modulates it itself. An FM transmitter turns audio level into frequency swing and has no ALC to catch it, so full scale into a data input set for voice over-deviates — which sounds completely normal to a listener and decodes for nobody.

Kept per mode, so a deviation set for 1200 baud packet never lands on FT8.
zh-CN:
频偏：对自行调制所接收音频的电台，此值控制当前模式的突发信号所产生的频率摆幅。FM 发射机把音频电平转换为频偏，且没有 ALC 进行限制；若数据输入按语音设置，满量程音频会产生过大频偏，听起来可能正常，却无法被正确解码。

按模式分别保存，因此 1200 波特分组通信的频偏设置不会应用于 FT8。

source:
Transmit audio: how hard this mode drives the modulator of a radio that modulates what we send it — a CAT rig on its sound card, a FLEX, an Icom on its network port. Bring it down until the rig's ALC is barely moving and set the power at the radio; ALC riding on a constant-envelope digital mode is what splatters.

Drive is not this control: on these radios Drive reaches the rig's power register and never touches its audio.

Kept per mode — FT8, RTTY, PSK and MCW each keep their own.
zh-CN:
发射音频：当前模式送入电台调制器的音频电平，适用于通过声卡连接的 CAT 电台、FLEX 及通过网络端口连接的 Icom 等。降低此值，直到电台的 ALC 几乎不动作，再在电台端设定功率；恒包络数字模式若持续触发 ALC，会产生频谱展宽。

此项与发射驱动分开：对这些电台，发射驱动控制电台的功率寄存器，不改变音频电平。

按模式分别保存，FT8、RTTY、PSK 和 MCW 各有独立设置。

zh-CN: 调谐时按波段规划设置频移。仅在中继输出子频段内生效，其他频率保持单工，因此呼叫频率仍为单工。

source: The radio's own squelch, sent over the control link. This is the gate the audio actually passes through — the software one would only close further on what the rig already let by.

source:
Gate the audio below this power in the receive passband, in dBFS. Left is open.{level} Set it above the noise and below the signal.

A stream that arrives with the radio's own AGC already in it — an Icom's 12 kHz IF, for one — sits far higher on this scale than an SDR's raw baseband does, which is why the rail reaches full scale.
zh-CN:
接收通带内功率低于此值时关闭音频，单位为 dBFS。最左端为开放。{level}请设在噪声之上、信号之下。

若数据流已经过电台自身 AGC（例如 Icom 的 12 kHz IF），其电平会远高于 SDR 原始基带，因此滑轨范围延伸至满量程。

source: Open on any DCS-coded signal. Which of the 104 codes it carries cannot be read reliably here, so there is nothing finer to choose
zh-CN: 任何携带 DCS 编码的信号均可开启静噪。此处无法可靠读取其使用的 104 种编码中的具体一种，因此不能进一步细选。

source:
Which socket on the back the radio is receiving on — its own ANT command, the same setting as the ANT button on the front panel. Click to step to the next one.

The choice is remembered per band, and put back the next time the dial crosses into that band.
zh-CN:
电台后面板的接收天线接口，对应电台自身 ANT 命令，与前面板 ANT 按钮控制同一设置。点击切换至下一个接口。

选择按波段保存，下次调谐进入该波段时恢复。

source:
The radio's separate receiving antenna, switched into the receive path or out of it — its own RX ANT setting. The aerial on the main socket stays on transmit either way.

The radio remembers this per band itself, so sdroxide reads it back after every band change rather than putting back what it last saw: clicking here is the only thing that moves it.
zh-CN:
电台独立接收天线接入或移出接收路径，对应电台自身 RX ANT 设置。无论如何选择，主接口天线仍用于发射。

电台自行按波段保存此项，因此 sdroxide 在每次换波段后读回，而不恢复软件上次看到的值；只有点击此处才会更改。

source:
The radio's own power switch, over the control link, and the one true on/off in the program — not sdroxide's LINK switch, which closes sdroxide's end and leaves the radio running.

For ON to reach anything the radio's control end has to stay awake while it is off: Network Control over the LAN, or a CI-V port still fed from the mains on a set switched off at the front.
zh-CN:
通过控制链路操作电台自身电源开关，是程序中真正控制电台开关机的功能。sdroxide 的 LINK 开关只关闭软件端连接，电台仍在运行。

要远程开机，电台关机时控制端仍需待机，例如局域网 Network Control，或前面板关机后仍由电源供电的 CI-V 端口。

source:
What the second aerial is for — click to swap.

CANCEL subtracts it from the first, in the gain, phase and delay that make a local noise source line up on both: the DSP form of a noise-cancelling phaser. COMBINE adds the two in the phase that reinforces, weighted by how well each hears — diversity reception, which fills in fades.
zh-CN:
第二副天线的用途，点击切换。

抵消模式调整增益、相位和延迟，使本地噪声源在两副天线上的信号对齐，再从第一副中减去第二副，是噪声抵消移相器的 DSP 实现。合成模式按各自接收效果加权，将两路同相增强相加，实现分集接收并减轻衰落。

source: Stop the filter moving. Reach for this the moment a null appears: a filter left adapting will re-aim itself at whatever becomes loudest, which on a quiet band is the station you are listening to.
zh-CN: 停止滤波器调整。零陷出现后应立即使用：持续自适应的滤波器会转向当前最强的信号，在安静波段上可能就是正在收听的电台。

source: How fast the filter chases: slow and steady at the left, converging inside a fraction of a second and visibly hunting at the right. Start fast to find the null, then HOLD it.
zh-CN: 滤波器的跟踪速度：左端缓慢稳定，右端可在不到一秒内收敛，但会明显来回调整。先用高速寻找零陷，再启用保持。

source: Sub receiver passband edges, in Hz
zh-CN: 副接收机通带边界，单位为 Hz

source: Sub receiver level (it plays in the right ear)
zh-CN: 副接收机音量，播放在右耳

source: Trace the highest level each column has reached over the live line, decaying back down — what the band did while you were looking elsewhere
zh-CN: 在实时频谱线上叠加每列达到过的最高电平，并逐渐衰减，显示你未关注时波段上的活动。

source: Draw the spectrum as a receding surface instead of a flat line: the newest spectrum across the front, the ones before it flowing away from you. The last couple of seconds of the band as a landscape — a carrier that comes and goes is a ridge rather than a line that twitches. The grid and the peak hold belong to the flat line and are not drawn on it.
zh-CN: 以向远处延伸的曲面显示频谱：最新频谱位于前端，较早频谱向后流动，将最近几秒的波段活动呈现为地形。时有时无的载波形成山脊，而非一条跳动的线。网格与峰值保持属于平面频谱，此视图不显示。

source: Mark every decoded station on the waterfall with its callsign, at the frequency it was heard on — FT8, FT4 and the other slotted modes. A good opening puts thirty of them across the span twice a minute, over the traces you are reading; switch them off and the waterfall is just the band. The decode list beside it still has every callsign.
zh-CN: 在瀑布图上，于接收到的频率标出 FT8、FT4 及其他时隙模式解码电台的呼号。传播良好时，每分钟两次、每次约三十个呼号可能覆盖正在观察的轨迹；关闭标注后瀑布图只显示波段，旁边解码列表仍保留全部呼号。

source: How the 3D spectrum is drawn. Only the shape differs — both renderings show the same spectra, and both hide what is behind them, so a strong signal in front stands over the band it is covering.
zh-CN: 3D 频谱的绘制方式。两种方式显示相同频谱，仅形状不同，都会遮挡后方内容，因此前方强信号会覆盖后面的波段。

source: How fast the 3D spectrum flows away from you, in rows a second: Slow 6, Medium 12, Fast 24, Faster 48. The surface is a fixed number of rows deep, so this is also how much time it holds. Slower is a longer memory and a surface that crawls; faster is a shorter one that moves. The waterfall keeps its own scroll rate, below.
zh-CN: 3D 频谱向远处流动的速度，单位为每秒行数：慢 6、中 12、快 24、更快 48。曲面深度为固定行数，因此速度也决定保存的时间范围。较慢时历史更长、移动更缓；较快时历史更短、移动更快。瀑布图使用下方独立的滚动速度。

source: How many columns the panadapter and its waterfall are drawn with. Auto reads this machine's renderer and the size of the panadapter and picks the most it can carry — a 4K screen wants 4096. Every column is a byte in every frame, so a client connected to a remote station pays for the detail on its link: 4096 columns at 60 fps is about a quarter of a megabyte a second, twice the standard width.
zh-CN: 全景频谱及瀑布图的绘制列数。自动模式根据本机渲染能力和全景频谱大小，选择可承载的最大列数；4K 屏幕通常需要 4096。每列在每帧占一个字节，因此连接远程台站时，更精细的显示也增加链路流量：4096 列、60 fps 约为每秒四分之一 MB，是标准宽度的两倍。

source: Keep the floor/ceiling set for best waterfall contrast — eased back into place on a band change, after a pan or zoom, and when the levels drift. Switch it on to fit at once; switch it off to keep the levels where you set them.
zh-CN: 持续调整电平上下限，保持瀑布图最佳对比度。在换波段、平移、缩放或电平漂移后，平滑恢复合适设置。启用时立即适配；关闭后保持手动设置的电平。

source: Keep the tuned frequency in the middle of the panadapter: the window slides under the dial instead of the picture jumping a whole span when you tune off the edge. Switch it on to centre at once; switch it off to pan and zoom wherever you like.
zh-CN: 将调谐频率保持在全景频谱中心，窗口随频率平滑移动，避免调谐越过边缘时整个频宽突然跳动。启用时立即居中；关闭后可自由平移和缩放。

source: {}: {v} ({}) — forecast by HAMQSL.com from the solar indices, not a measurement of your own path.
zh-CN: {}：{v}（{}）——由 HAMQSL.com 根据太阳活动指数预测，并非对你的实际传播路径进行测量。

source: The diversity filter: which way it combines the two aerials, how fast it adapts, and holding it where it is
zh-CN: 分集滤波器：两副天线信号的合成方式、自适应速度及保持当前参数

source: The level drawn at the bottom of the spectrum and as the darkest waterfall                  colour. Bring it up until the noise floor just darkens.
zh-CN: 对应频谱底部及瀑布图最暗颜色的电平。调高至噪声底刚好变暗。

source: The level drawn at the top. Bring it down until the strongest signal you                  care about reaches full colour.
zh-CN: 对应频谱顶部的电平。调低至所关心的最强信号达到最亮颜色。

source: The panadapter — its two layers, their speeds and detail, peak hold — plus waterfall contrast, FFT size and the skimmers
zh-CN: 频谱显示：频谱与瀑布图两层的速度和精细度、峰值保持，以及瀑布图对比度、FFT 大小和扫描解码器

source: The second receiver's frequency, mode, filter and level
zh-CN: 副接收机的频率、模式、滤波器和音量

source: The transceiver's own aerial socket, and its power switch
zh-CN: 收发机的天线接口及电源开关

source: The width in force right now, whatever the row above asks for
zh-CN: 当前实际使用的显示宽度，与上方选择值可能不同

source: This radio hands over demodulated audio, so there is no I/Q to record.
zh-CN: 此电台提供解调后的音频，没有可录制的 I/Q 数据。

source: This rig has {} RX gain stages — the rest are in Settings → Device.
zh-CN: 此电台有 {} 级接收增益，其余增益设置位于“设置 → 设备”。

source: Tone squelch {}: nothing matching it is being received
zh-CN: 亚音静噪要求 {}，尚未收到匹配亚音

source: Transmitting {} — click to open the voice keyer
zh-CN: 正在发送 {}，点击打开语音存储键控器

source: Tune, the voice keyer, and the drive and mic levels
zh-CN: 调谐载波、语音存储键控器、驱动电平与麦克风电平

source: Two channels: RX left, TX right — click for one mixed channel
zh-CN: 双声道：左侧接收，右侧发射；点击混合为单声道

source: VFO A/B, split, and the RIT/XIT offsets
zh-CN: VFO A/B、异频收发及 RIT/XIT 偏移

source: Voice keyer: record and transmit stored messages
zh-CN: 语音存储键控器：录制并发送保存的消息

source: Volume, gain, AGC, squelch, the noise controls, and the RDS readout on FM broadcast
zh-CN: 音量、增益、AGC、静噪、噪声处理，以及调频广播的 RDS 信息

source: WFM stereo: automatic, no pilot on this station
zh-CN: WFM 使用自动立体声，当前电台没有导频

source: WFM stereo forced off — click for automatic stereo
zh-CN: WFM 立体声已强制关闭，点击恢复自动立体声

source: WFM stereo: pilot locked. Click to force mono
zh-CN: WFM 立体声导频已锁定，点击强制使用单声道

source: What a capture costs at this sample rate
zh-CN: 当前采样率下录制所需的写入速度

source: What you hear, as an MP3: the receiver in one channel and your own transmit in the other. This is the recording of a QSO.
zh-CN: 将听到的音频录制为 MP3：一侧声道为接收音频，另一侧为本机发射音频，用于记录通联。

source: Where the sub receiver listens. Shift-click the waterfall, or drag inside the sub's passband, to move it.
zh-CN: 副接收机的接收频率。按住 Shift 点击瀑布图，或在副接收机通带内拖动，可移动频率。

source: Zero the filter and find the null again.
zh-CN: 将滤波器归零，重新寻找消零点。

source: No audio: {} is not a secure origin, so this browser withholds audio playback and microphone access. Use HTTPS or an SSH tunnel to localhost. (Click to dismiss.)
zh-CN: 无音频：{} 不是安全来源，浏览器无法提供音频播放和麦克风访问。请使用 HTTPS，或通过 SSH 隧道访问 localhost。（点击关闭提示。）

source: ALC — how hard the transmitter is being driven, as a percentage of the most it can put out. 100 % is full scale, not full power in watts: what that is worth at the antenna depends on the radio and on Drive.
zh-CN: ALC — 发射驱动电平，按满量程百分比显示。100 % 表示满量程，并非以瓦为单位的最大功率；天线端的实际功率取决于电台和驱动设置。

source: Forward power — {w:.1} W, measured by the radio's own sensor.
zh-CN: 正向功率 — {w:.1} W，由电台自身的传感器测得。

source: This radio reports no forward power, so the figure beside ALC is the ALC reading again rather than watts.
zh-CN: 此电台不报告正向功率，因此 ALC 旁的数字仍是 ALC 读数，单位并非瓦。

source: PO — the radio's own power-output meter, at {:.0} % of its full scale. A needle position as the radio reports it, not a calibrated wattage; what to watch is whether it falls while Drive stays put.
zh-CN: PO — 电台自身的输出功率表，当前为满量程的 {:.0} %。这是电台报告的表针位置，并非经过校准的瓦数；请留意驱动设置不变时，此读数是否下降。

source: SWR — {swr:.1}:1, the match the antenna is presenting, as the radio measures it. Under 2:1 is unremarkable; past 3:1 the scale turns red.
zh-CN: SWR — {swr:.1}:1，由电台测量的天线驻波比。低于 2:1 通常无异常；超过 3:1 时刻度变红。

source: No SWR: this radio has no bridge to measure it with, and sdroxide will not invent one — it can only show what the radio itself reports. A rig with an SWR meter (over CAT, TCI or a LAN link) and an HPSDR board both fill this in; a plain SDR transmitter cannot.
zh-CN: 无驻波比读数：此电台没有用于测量的电桥，SDRoxide 只能显示电台实际报告的数据。带驻波比表并通过 CAT、TCI 或局域网报告的电台，以及 HPSDR 板卡可提供此项数据；普通 SDR 发射机无法提供。

source: No signal report yet — the receiver has not delivered a meter reading.
zh-CN: 尚无信号报告 — 接收机尚未提供仪表读数。

source: Received signal strength: S9 + {over:.0} dB ({:.0} dBm in the passband).
zh-CN: 接收信号强度：S9 + {over:.0} dB（通带内 {:.0} dBm）。

source: Received signal strength: S{s} ({:.0} dBm in the passband).
zh-CN: 接收信号强度：S{s}（通带内 {:.0} dBm）。

source: S9 is −73 dBm and each S-unit below it is 6 dB. The dBm figure is only as honest as the front end's calibration — an uncalibrated receiver reports dBFS with a dBm label.
zh-CN: S9 对应 −73 dBm，S9 以下每个 S 单位相差 6 dB。dBm 读数的准确性取决于前端校准；未经校准的接收机可能把 dBFS 读数标为 dBm。

source: OVLD: the converter is into its rails, so the level shown understates the signal. Wind the front-end gain back.
zh-CN: OVLD：模数转换器已过载削波，因此显示电平低于实际信号电平。请减小前端增益。

source: PS — PureSignal is correcting {:.1} dB of compression{} (the feedback matched the transmission at {:.2}).
zh-CN: PS — PureSignal 正在校正 {:.1} dB 的压缩失真{}（反馈与发射信号的匹配度为 {:.2}）。

source: PS −− — PureSignal is switched on but has not found the transmission in the feedback path (best match {:.2}), so the transmitter is going out uncorrected. Check that a sample of the amplifier's output really reaches a receive input the T/R switch does not take away on transmit, and that its attenuator is not swallowing it. The loop listens on this receiver only — a coupler wired to a second receiver (RX2, ADC2) is never read as the feedback.
zh-CN: PS −− — PureSignal 已开启，但尚未在反馈通道中找到发射信号（最佳匹配度 {:.2}），因此发射输出尚未校正。请确认功放输出取样确实送达接收输入，发射时收发切换开关不会切断该输入，且衰减器未使取样电平过低。此环路只监听当前接收机；接到第二接收机（RX2、ADC2）的耦合器取样不会被用作反馈。

source: · no forecast yet — fetching from HAMQSL.com
zh-CN: · 尚无预报，正在从 HAMQSL.com 获取

source: CONDX is a global forecast; the rest is what has actually been heard. An empty row means nothing was decoded — which may mean the band was shut, or only that nobody was on it.
zh-CN: 传播状况来自全球预报；其他列显示实际接收到的信号。空行表示没有解码结果，可能是波段关闭，也可能只是没有台站活动。
NCDXF/IARU · 距下一个信标 {} 秒

source: {} at {} — hearing it means the {} path is open. Each beacon steps up a band every 10 s, so this row changes every slot.
zh-CN: {} 位于 {}；收到它说明 {} 的传播路径已开通。每个信标每 10 秒移至下一个波段，因此此行在每个时隙都会变化。
按纬度 {lat:.0}°、经度 {lon:.0}° 计算辐射点

source:
{} ({}) — {} km/s, parent {}. Peak rate ZHR {} around {}.

A radiant above the horizon means the trails can reach you; a fast shower leaves longer-lived ionised trails for meteor scatter on 6 m and 2 m, and the brief 10 m openings.
zh-CN:
{}（{}）· 速度 {} km/s，母体 {}。峰值天顶每小时出现率为 {}，极大期约在 {}。

辐射点位于地平线以上，意味着流星尾迹可能为本站提供散射路径。高速流星雨留下的电离尾迹持续更久，可用于 6 米和 2 米波段的流星散射，也可带来 10 米波段的短暂开通。

source: Not in DRM. Set the mode to DRM on a digital shortwave broadcast — the dial goes on the channel centre, not on a sideband.
zh-CN: 当前不是 DRM 模式。请在数字短波广播频率上选择 DRM，并将频率设在信道中心，而非边带上。

source: No DRM signal locked. The decoder needs a few seconds on a clean carrier: DRM interleaves over 400 ms or 2 s before any of it can be read.
zh-CN: 尚未锁定 DRM 信号。解码器需要在清晰载波上等待数秒；DRM 使用 400 ms 或 2 s 交织，必须先接收足够数据才能读取内容。

source: This station's audio codec is not decoding here. xHE-AAC needs libfdk-aac on the system — it cannot be built in, because its licence and this program's are incompatible. Install it (Debian/Ubuntu: libfdk-aac2, Arch: libfdk-aac, macOS: brew install fdk-aac, Windows: libfdk-aac-2.dll beside sdroxide.exe) and restart. Everything else on this screen is decoding normally.
zh-CN: 无法在此处解码该电台的音频编码。xHE-AAC 需要系统安装 libfdk-aac；由于其许可证与本程序不兼容，无法内置。请安装后重新启动：Debian/Ubuntu 使用 libfdk-aac2，Arch 使用 libfdk-aac，macOS 执行 brew install fdk-aac，Windows 将 libfdk-aac-2.dll 放在 sdroxide.exe 旁。此界面的其他内容均在正常解码。

source: Audio frames decoding — but this station's codec cannot be decoded here
zh-CN: 正在解码音频帧，但此处不支持该电台的音频编码
采样数据已到达解码器

source: Fast Access Channel — what the transmission is
zh-CN: 快速接入信道：描述传输参数

source: Service Description Channel — what the services are
zh-CN: 业务描述信道：描述各项业务

source: Robustness mode and channel width. A is for a ground-wave path and carries the most; D is for a badly scattered sky-wave one and carries the least.
zh-CN: 抗衰落模式与信道宽度。A 适用于地波传播，容量最高；D 适用于散射严重的天波传播，容量最低。

source: How far the transmission spreads each frame in time. Long rides out deeper fades and takes correspondingly longer to acquire.
zh-CN: 每帧数据在时间上的交织跨度。长交织可抵御更深的衰落，但同步捕获所需时间也更长。

source: Residual sample-clock error against the transmitter. Large and steady means the receiver's reference is off, not the broadcast.
zh-CN: 相对于发射端的残余采样时钟误差。误差较大且稳定时，说明接收机的参考时钟存在偏差，而非广播信号的问题。

source: Doppler and delay spread of the path — how fast it is moving and how far apart its echoes arrive.
zh-CN: 传播路径的多普勒扩展与时延扩展，分别反映路径变化的速度及各回波到达时间的差异。

source: Decode this service of the multiplex
zh-CN: 解码此复用信号中的业务

source: Shade the squares heard on the live decode list, not only the ones in the log — what is on the air now, in cyan under the worked squares.
zh-CN: 同时标记实时解码列表中收听到的网格，而不只显示日志中的网格。当前正在空中的网格以青色显示，位于已通联网格的下层。

source: Drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Amber = worked, green = confirmed, cyan = heard.
zh-CN: 拖动平移，滚轮缩放。琥珀色＝已通联，绿色＝已确认，青色＝已收听。
已恢复 OFDM 帧定时

source: Modulation error ratio of the lower digital sideband.
zh-CN: 下数字边带的调制误差比。

source: Modulation error ratio of the upper digital sideband.
zh-CN: 上数字边带的调制误差比。

source: Channel bit-error ratio after the inner code. Below about 1e-3 the outer code can correct it; above that the audio starts to break up.
zh-CN: 内码解码后的信道误码率。低于约 1e-3 时，外码可纠正这些错误；高于此值时，音频开始出现断续。

source: Residual carrier frequency offset. Large and steady means the receiver's reference is off, not the broadcast.
zh-CN: 残余载波频率偏移。偏移较大且稳定时，说明接收机的参考频率存在偏差，而非广播信号的问题。

source: Primary Service Mode Indicator: which of the FM hybrid service modes the station is transmitting.
zh-CN: 主业务模式指示：电台正在发射的 FM 混合业务模式。

source: Not in HD Radio. Set the mode to HD Radio on an FM broadcast carrying the digital sidecars — the dial goes on the analog carrier's centre, not beside it.
zh-CN: 当前不是 HD Radio 模式。请在带有数字边带的 FM 广播频率上选择 HD Radio，并将频率设在模拟载波中心，而非其旁边。

source: No HD Radio lock. The digital sidebands are transmitted about 20 dB below the analog carrier, so a listenable station can still be too noisy to decode: the decoder needs a few seconds on a clean one.
zh-CN: 尚未锁定 HD Radio 信号。数字边带的发射电平比模拟载波低约 20 dB，因此即使模拟音频能收听，噪声仍可能过大而无法解码。解码器需要在清晰信号上等待数秒。

source: HFDL is selected but decoding is off — press LISTEN above
zh-CN: 已选择 HFDL，但尚未开启解码；请点击上方的“监听”

source: Nothing decoded yet — a ground station's squitter repeats every ~32 s once one is in the channel.
zh-CN: 尚无解码结果。信道中有地面台时，其自动广播报文约每 32 秒发送一次。
没有符合筛选条件的解码记录。

source: Switches the engine's HFDL downconverter and decoder on or off. Decoding costs a 24 kHz lane and a worker thread whether the window is open or not.
zh-CN: 开启或关闭引擎的 HFDL 下变频器与解码器。无论此窗口是否打开，解码都会占用一个 24 kHz 接收通道和一个工作线程。

source: The channel (the assigned frequency) to listen on. Anything in the band works — HFDL stations transmit on 2.8 to 22 MHz — against a fixed 24 kHz lane centred here.
zh-CN: 要监听的信道（指配频率）。HFDL 电台在 2.8 至 22 MHz 发射；此频段内均可接收，接收通道以此频率为中心，固定宽度为 24 kHz。

source: Save the HFDL decode log to a file
zh-CN: 将 HFDL 解码日志保存到文件

source: Riverhead (northern Atlantic/north America) — the default, and the channel the decoder was validated on.
zh-CN: Riverhead（北大西洋／北美洲）：默认信道，也是用于验证解码器的信道。

source: How far a burst must stand above the channel's own noise floor before it is decoded
zh-CN: 突发信号必须高于该信道自身噪声底多少，才开始解码

source: Listen on {label} — tunes the radio there. One band at a time: they are too far apart for any receiver to cover two at once.
zh-CN: 监听 {label}，并将电台调到此频段。一次只能监听一个频段：这些频段相距太远，接收机无法同时覆盖两个。

source: Give each band the width it normally needs — a quarter of a megahertz for the OOK bands at 315, 345 and 433 MHz, a full one for 868 and 915.
zh-CN: 按各频段的通常需求设置带宽：315、345 和 433 MHz 的 OOK 频段使用 250 kHz；868 和 915 MHz 使用 1 MHz。

source: Watch {label}Hz around the band centre, whatever the band would have asked for. Narrower fits a receiver that cannot deliver the band's own width; wider reaches devices sitting further off centre. Your receiver has to hand over about a third more than this.
zh-CN: 在频段中心周围监听 {label}Hz，覆盖范围不受频段默认带宽限制。接收机无法提供默认带宽时可缩小范围；扩大范围则可接收偏离中心更远的设备。接收机实际提供的带宽需比此值多约三分之一。

source: Several hundred more device decoders, from the rtl_433 project, built in. Reads the 433 MHz OOK devices sdroxide's own decoders do not reach at all. Where both can read a device, rtl_433 knows far more variants and takes over.
zh-CN: 内置 rtl_433 项目的数百种设备解码器，可读取 SDRoxide 自带解码器尚不支持的 433 MHz OOK 设备。对于两者均支持的设备，rtl_433 支持的变体更多，因此由它负责解码。
{} 个解码器（{flex}），已解码 {} 次

source: Device decoders registered, how many came from your rtl433_flex.conf, and how many transmissions have been decoded since it started.
zh-CN: 已注册的设备解码器数量、来自 rtl433_flex.conf 的自定义解码器数量，以及启动以来成功解码的发送次数。

source: Re-read rtl433_flex.conf after editing it. The devices already heard stay in the list.
zh-CN: 编辑后重新读取 rtl433_flex.conf。已收听到的设备仍保留在列表中。

source: rtl_433 knows more variants of these than sdroxide's own decoders do, so it reads them while it is listening here. Select another band and sdroxide's own take over again.
zh-CN: rtl_433 对这些设备的变体支持比 SDRoxide 自带解码器更广，因此在此频段监听时由它解码。选择其他频段后，将重新使用 SDRoxide 自带解码器。

source: A decoder in your rtl433_flex.conf was refused. The others still loaded. Fix the line, then press RELOAD DECODERS.
zh-CN: rtl433_flex.conf 中的一个解码器未能加载，其他解码器已正常加载。请修正对应行，再点击“重新加载解码器”。
接收窗口中心 {:.3} MHz，宽度 {:.3} MHz

source: Where the decoder is actually listening. This follows the receiver's hardware centre, not the VFO — on a wide front end the two can be a long way apart, and it is the window that decides which channels are reachable.
zh-CN: 解码器实际监听的范围，跟随接收机的硬件中心频率。宽带接收时，硬件中心与 VFO 频率可能相距很远；可接收哪些信道取决于此窗口。
{} 次突发信号，已解码 {} 次

source: Transmissions the gate opened on, and how many produced a valid frame. Many bursts and no decodes means the band is busy with devices sdroxide cannot read yet. None at all means nothing is reaching the threshold — lower it, or check that the dial is on the band.
zh-CN: 达到门限的发送次数，以及其中产生有效帧的次数。突发信号很多却没有解码结果，表示该频段中有大量软件尚不能解码的设备。两者均为零则表示没有信号达到门限；请降低门限，或检查当前频率是否位于该频段。

source: Click to tune the receiver to it
zh-CN: 点击将接收机调到此频率

source: Needs a wideband IQ source; a CAT rig sends only audio
zh-CN: 需要宽带 IQ 信号源；CAT 电台仅提供音频
确认记录：已下载 {} 条，新确认 {matched} 条

source: Import QSOs from an ADIF (.adi or .adif) file
zh-CN: 从 ADIF 文件（.adi 或 .adif）导入通联记录
查询姓名、台址及网格定位

source: Upload this QSO to configured logs
zh-CN: 将此通联上传到已配置的日志服务

source: no QSOs yet — run FT8/FT4 or add a manual entry
zh-CN: 尚无通联记录；可运行 FT8/FT4 或手动添加
在此设备上记住登录信息

source: Signs in without asking next time, and lets the 3D view's tab in without asking at all. The password is kept in the clear, so leave this off on a machine other people use.
zh-CN: 下次自动登录，3D 视图的选项卡也无需再次登录。密码以明文保存，请勿在与他人共用的计算机上启用。

source: Keeps the password on this device, in the clear.
zh-CN: 在此设备上以明文保存密码。

source: A wrong password shuts the server's door for a few seconds, so this can take a moment.
zh-CN: 密码错误会使服务器暂停接受登录几秒，因此此操作可能需要稍等。

source: RADE: the message is encoded by the digital-voice codec, exactly as a live over would be.
zh-CN: RADE：消息由数字语音编解码器编码，与实时发话的处理方式相同。

source: Edit the name, frequency, mode, antenna and repeater setup
zh-CN: 编辑名称、频率、模式、天线和中继设置

source: The repeater shift, tone and 1750 Hz burst stored with this channel
zh-CN: 随此频道保存的中继频差、亚音及 1750 Hz 启动音

source: Recall this channel without moving the antenna

source:
How hard the FT8 decoder works for weak signals.

Fast — one pass, no signal subtraction: quickest, fewest decodes.
Normal — flat multi-pass subtraction: a little quicker than Deep, a little less thorough.
Deep — the checkpointed multi-pass: the most decodes, and ~1.2 s on a busy slot.
zh-CN:
设置 FT8 解码器搜寻弱信号的力度。

快速：单轮解码，不做信号相减；速度最快，解码量最少。
普通：平坦式多轮信号相减；比深度模式稍快，搜索也略少。
深度：带检查点的多轮解码；解码量最多，繁忙时隙约需 1.2 秒。
